tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed skor gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru badzra ā tsarya mahā mañdzu shrī mañdzu gho ṣa mañdzu badzra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal 'jam dbyangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngang / /ngang der dbyer med bzhugs pa'i gdod ma'i mgon/ /mgon po khyab bdag rang rig bla ma rgyal/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i gzugs/ /ma rig mun pa sel mdzad lhag pa'i lha/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid gdug can bsgral ba'i phyir/ /drag po'i skur bstan khro bo'i dbang por 'dud/ /gang gi zab dang rgya che'i dam chos kyis/ /bdag rgyud tshim par mdzad pa'i bka' drin can/ /kho bo'i rigs kyi cod can rdo rje 'dzin/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa de dag phyag gi gnas/ /khyad par lha mchog dmar 'jigs rnam gnyis kyi/ /yongs rdzogs gdams pa'i bdud rtsi stsol mdzad pa'i/ /ngag gi dbang phyug chos tshul rgya mtsho'i bdag /mkhas pa'i grags dkar srid gsum khyab der bsngags/ /gzhan yang snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras dang / /rgyal kun spro bsdu'i byed po mus pa rje'i/ /rnam thar dran pas lan brgyar phyag bgyi'o/ /log 'dren bdud dgra gshin rje gshed dpal gyi/ /zab yangs dam chos byung tshul legs bshad pa/ /'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'dir spel lo/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir dpal gshin rje gshed skor gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la/ spyi don rnam pa gnyis te/

rgyud sde spyi'i dbye ba mdo tsam bstan pa dang / skabs su babs pa'i don dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir 'o skol gyi ston par mnyam med yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyis gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang / khams dang bag la nyal dang 'tshams par chos kyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad rigs su bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis sam/ yang na rgyu'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'dir theg pa che chung gnyis kyi nang nas theg pa chen po/ rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi nang nas 'bras bu'i theg pa nyid bshad bya'i chos yin no/ /de lta bu'i 'bras bu'i theg pa la grub pa'i slob dpon so so'i bzhed pas rgyud sde'i dbye sgo mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa yin te/ grub chen sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / kun dga' snying po la sogs pas bla med kyi rgyud sde 'ga' zhig kyang rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral nas yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gong na de bas lhag pa'i rgyud sde med cing / rgyud sde thams cad bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang gsum du nges par bzhed/ yang ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las sngags dang / sman dang / sbyin sreg dang / phye ma dang / mig sman dang / rkang byug la sogs pa dngos grub chen po brgyad rab tu spyod pas sgrub par byed pa ni rtog pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /zhes bya rgyud kyi 'og tu rtog pa'i rgyud bya ba gsungs pas/ rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya spyod rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud dang lngar dbye bar rigs so zhes 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras rnams bzhed/ 'on kyang 'phags pas rim lnga sgyu lus kyi skabs su slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid du/ rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi la mkhas pa zhes gsungs pas/ rtog pa'i rgyud bya rgyud kyi nang du 'dus pa la dgongs nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa yin la/

yang bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas grub chen na ro pa dpon slob kyis rgyud sde sgo drug tu bzhed de/ rgyud sde sgo drug gi tha snyad la rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris 'ga' zhig las/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum gyi steng du/ pha bla na med pa/ ma bla na med pa/ ma'i yang ma bla na med pa/ gsang mtha'i rgyud de drug po de la sgo drug ces gsungs/ yang kun mkhyen chen po sogs kyis mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ de bzhi'i steng du rnal 'byor gsang ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud dang drug la rgyud sde sgo drug du bshad/ de ltar bshad tshul mang du yod kyang / grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa dpon slob kyi mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes dang / dpal kha sbyor las/ rgod dang blta ba lag bcangs dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyi rgyud bzhir gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ rtog pa'i rgyud bya rgyud kyi nang du bsdus/ gsang mtha'i rgyud rnams bla med kyi rgyud kyi nang gses kyi dbye ba yin gyi rgyud sde la sogs pa ma yin pas/ rgyud sde thams cad bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud dang bzhir nges pa yin zhes bzhed cing / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brangs nas rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba 'di nyid gtso bor mdzad mod kyang / sa skya pa rnams yo ga 'chad pa'i tshe rgyud sde gsum du dbye ba dang /

'khor lo bde mchog 'chad pa'i tshe rgyud sde sgo drug tu dbye ba 'di 'thad ldan du mdzad nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gam gsang mtha'i rgyud rnams rgyud sde sgo drug pa dang / ma rgyud spyi las ches zab pa'i rgyud sder bzhed pa yin no/ /de ltar na yang spyir rgyud la bya ba'i rgyud sde/ spyod pa'i rgyud sde/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sde/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde dang bzhir dbye ba 'di nyid du dbye ba gzhan rnams kyang 'dus pas 'di nyid grangs nges kyi dbye ba yin te/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis las/ gsar 'gyur ba'i lugs la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i gong na de las lhag pa'i rgyud sde gzhan med pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi rab dbye las/ des na gsang sngags gsar ma la/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i ltag na ni/ /de bas lhag pa'i rgyud sde med/ /bsgom pa'i dmigs pa nyid kyang ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i gong na med/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /'o na rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ 'di la bla ma gong ma rnams kyis phyi rol mu stegs byed la log pa'i spyod pa mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pas de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyud sde bzhi gsungs/ sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi grub mtha' la brjod du med pa'i bdag khas len pa dang / de khas len mi len kyang rdul phran dang shes pa skad cig cha med bden par khas len pa dang / gzung bya'i yul bden par med kyang 'dzin pa'i shes pa skad cig ma'i bden par khas len pa dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis ka bden med du khas len dang bzhir yod pas/ de dag dang lung sgo bstun gyi dbang du byas nas rgyud sde bzhi'i bskyed chog gsungs/ 'dod khams pa la chags pa mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pas/ de dag ma spangs par lam du byas nas byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir du rgyud sde bzhir gsungs par bzhed pas/

de dag gi tshul rgyas par ni gsung rab gzhan du yang 'byung zhing / kho bos kyang bde kye gsang gsum gyi chos 'byung sogs su rgyas par bshad yod pas don du gnyer ba yod na de dag tu blta bar gyis shig des na rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan la/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi bka' gdams do skor ba'i dris lan las/ rgyud sde bzhi yi khyad par ni/ /mi rigs bzhi dang dus tshod bzhi/ /nyon mongs sgo nas gsungs pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud dang mthun par gda'/ /zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ de yang mi rigs dang bstun nas rgyud sde bzhi gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la rten 'dod pa khams kyi lha dang mi nyid gtso bor dgos/ de las kyang las kyi sa pa zhes bya ba 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi nyid gtso bor gsungs la/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams ni mi rigs bzhir 'dus pa yin te/ bram ze'i rigs/ rje rigs/ rgyal rigs/ dmangs rigs dang bzhir 'dus pas so/ /de la bram ze dang bstun nas bya ba'i rgyud gsungs pa yin te/ bram ze de khrus dang gtsang sbra gtso bor byed pa ltar bya ba'i rgyud kyis kyang khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa phyi lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pas so/ /yang rje rigs la phyi khrus dang gtsang sbra yang yod la/ nang ngo tsha dang khrel 'dzem yang yod pa de dang mtshungs par/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyis phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang / nang ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams len gnyis cha mnyam par ston pas na rje rigs dang bstun nas spyod rgyud gsungs/ de bzhin du rgyal rigs rnams phyi lus ngag gi khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs las/ nang gi 'khor dang khang bzang dang rgyan dang bkod pa sogs gtso bor byed pa ltar/ khrus sogs phyi'i brtul zhugs las nang gi gzhal yas khang lha rten dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa sogs nang ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pas na/

rgyal rigs dang bstun nas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs/ dmangs rigs rnams gtsang sbra dang khrus sogs kyi spyod pa gtso bor mi byed par spyod lam ci bder byed pa ltar/ rnal 'byor bla na med par yang dka' thub dang / snyung gnas la sogs pa'i brtul zhugs spangs te/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bsten pa sogs spyod pa bde ba'i 'du shes pyi bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub par byed pas na/ dmangs rigs dang bstun nas rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ bram ze'i rigs dang rgyal rigs dang / /rje rigs gdol pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dag gi /rgyud bzhi so sor bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / bdag nyid chen po'i sdom gsum gyi lung sbyor 'di mkhas pa'i legs bshad du snang / 'og gi tshogs bdag dang grub chen 'dzin gnyis kyi lo rgyus mi 'dra ba mchan bur bkod pa 'di gnyis ma gtogs/ gzhan gong 'og gi mchan thor bu 'di rnams chos 'byung 'di brtsams nas mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang chos grags la gzigs phul nas zhu dag zhus dus mkhan chen nyid kyis 'debs par mdzad pa kho na yin no/ /sdom gsum rab dbye las/ dkar gsum pa sogs kha zas dang / /gtsang sbra la sogs brtul zhugs kyis/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi gsang sngags 'grub/ /spyod dang rnal 'byor rgyud gnyis su/ /las tshogs bsgrub pa 'ga' zhig la/ /gtsang sbra dka' thub bshad pa yod/ /gzhan du dka' thub snyung gnas sogs/ /brtul zhugs khyad par gtsor mi mdzad/ /rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom/ /gla rtsi reng bu la sogs pa'i/ /srog chags yan lag las byung ba'i/ /mchod pa rnams kyang 'dir mi 'gog /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i lhag ma rnams/ /sdig pa spang phyir bza' 'o zhes/ /rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las gsungs/ /'byung po'i gtor ma 'dir mi za/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las/

/a wa dhu ti'i spyod sogs la/ /'byung po'i gtor ma bza' bar snang / /dka' thub la sogs brtul zhugs 'gog /spyod pa bde ba'i 'du shes kyis/ /gsang sngags rgyal po tshe 'dir 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa 'di dag gis kyang mi rigs bzhi dang bstun nas rgyud sde bzhi gsungs pa yin par 'grub bo/ yang rdzogs ldan/ gnyis ldan/ gsum ldan/ rtsod dus te dus bzhi dang bstun nas kyang rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa yin te/ kun spyod las/ dus ni bzhi la dgongs nas ni/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi gsungs pa/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi las bya ba'i rgyud la/ bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang / bya ba so so'i rgyud gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ legs grub kyi rgyud/ dpung bzang gi rgyud/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud rnams te 'di bzhi la bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi zhes grags/ phyi ma bya ba so so'i rgyud la/ rdo rje rigs kyi rgyud/ padma rigs kyi rgyud/ nor bu'i rigs kyi rgyud/ lnga rtsen rigs kyi rgyud/ las kyi rigs kyi rgyud/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud te rgyud sde sgo drug tu yod par bshad cing / nang gses kyi dbye ba ni mtha' yas so/ /spyod pa'i rgyud ni rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud dang / khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud sogs yin la/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum du yod de/ slob dpon padma tsakṣus/ rtsa rgyud shin tu zab cing rtogs dka' ba'i/ /bshad dang cha mthun rgyud kyi rnam par dbye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med kyi rgyud dang gsum du yod cing / dang po ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud sogs la ngos 'dzin par bshad/ gnyis pa ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud sogs so/ /gsum pa zab pa gnyis med kyi rgyud dang /

rgya che ba gnyis med kyi rgyud gnyis su gsungs pa'i snga ma ni dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud sogs dang phyi ma ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud sogs la bshad pa yin la/ yang rnal 'byor bla na med pa la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis/ ma rgyud la sgo drug dang / pha rgyud la sde gsum gyi rnam gzhag kyang bshad/ de'i ma rgyud sgo drug ni/ he ru ka'i sgo/ brtag pa'i sgo/ rdo rje nyi ma'i sgo/ padma gar dbang gi sgo/ rta mchog gi sgo rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo dang drug po la bshad pa las/ dang po he ru ka'i sgo ni/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa bshad cha mthun gyi rgyud rnams dang / 'khor lo bde mchog mahā ma ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs kyi rtsa bshad cha mthun gyi rgyud rnams so/ /gnyis pa brtag pa'i sgo ni/ mi g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud/ gsang ba thams cad pa'i rgyud rnams so/ /gsum pa rdo rje nyi ma'i sgo ni/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud do/ /bzhi pa padma gar dbang gi sgo ni/ 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa'i rgyud dang / ku ru kulle'i rtog pa rnams yin zhing / lnga pa rta mchog gi rgyud ni/ sgrol ma bla med kyi rgyud dang / drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyud ni/ ji bzhin mnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud la ngos 'dzin/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dgongs pa yin par bla ma mkhas pa dag gsungs so/ /pha rgyud sde gsum ni/ zla gsang thig le las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor/ gdul bya zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa gshin rje gshed skor/ gdul bya gti mug can gtso bor 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skor rnams su yod pa yin no/

/de rnams kyis rgyud sde spyi'i dbye ba mdo tsam bstan pa bshad zin nas/ spyi don gnyis pa skabs su babs pa'i don dngos bshad pa la/ gshin rje gshed kyi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams ji ltar byon pa'i tshul/ de dag gi dgongs 'grel dang lam srol mi 'dra ba ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de dag bla ma gong ma rnams las rim par brgyud de rgya bod du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'o na zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i don du gshin rje gshed skor gyi rgyud rnams gsungs pa yin na/ gdul bya zhe sdang can de ji ltar yin/ de nyid 'dul byed kyi ston pa ji lta bu/ des de nyid btul tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'di la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya ji ltar btul ba'i tshul/ btul nas rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir gdul bya la chos sku rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gdul bya dang / longs sku zhi ba'i 'jam dpal gyi gdul bya/ sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gdul bya gsum las/ dang po ni/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad yin/ chos sku rdo rje 'jigs byed ni gnyis med kyi ye shes la bya la/ ye shes des mtshan ma dang rnam rtog thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams te/ longs sku zhi ba'i 'jam dpal ni/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i nges pa lnga ldan gyi 'jam dpal zhi ba'i skur bstan pa de nyid yin par bshad la/ des 'khor sa bcu ba'i byang sems rnams la theg pa chen po'i chos 'ba' zhig bstan pas/ de dag gi thugs rgyud kyi sgrib pa'i bag chags sam sgrib pa phra mo rnams zad nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par mdzad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gdul bya la thun mong dang / khyad par gyi gdul bya gnyis las/

dang po ni gdul bya 'dul dka' ba thams cad yin par bshad la/ gnyis pa ni/ drag po 'jigs byed las kyi gshin rje ste/ de 'dul ba'i ched du rdo rje 'jigs byed dbu dgu phyag sum cu so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa ma he'i zhal can nyid sprul pa yin pas so/ /de yang tshul ji ltar du btul ba yin zhe na/ drag po las kyi gshin rje de nyid sha chen gyi sa gzhi/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ keng rus kyi ri rab brtsigs nas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la 'tshe ba dang 'joms par byed cing gnas pa las/ de'i tshe 'og min du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig pas/ longs sku zhi ba'i 'jam dpal gyi thugs kha nas sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed dbu dgu/ phyag so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa zhig sprul te/ des gzugs med khams du byon nas sku gsung thugs dang / 'phrin las bzhi'i drag shul gyi sgo nas gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i lha rnams btul nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ de nas gzugs khams su drag shul bzhi'i sgo nas bsam gtan rigs bzhi btul nas bka' la nyan cing dam la btags pas srog snying phul nas bran dang pho nyar khas blangs/ de nas yang 'dod khams su byon sngar ltar drag shul bzhis 'thab bral sogs nam mkha' la gnas pa'i 'dod khams kyi lha rigs bzhi 'dul bar mdzad pa yin la/ de ltar yang rgyud rtog bdun las/ de yis lha rnams thams cad la/ /drag shul che zhing 'jigs par byed/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /de nas sum cu rtsa gsum du gshegs te drag shul bzhis ri rab la gnas pa'i lha rnams btul ba yin zhing / de la drag shul bzhi ni/ sku'i drag shul/ gsung gi drag shul/ thugs kyi drag shul/ 'phrin las kyi drag shul dang bzhi yin la/ de'i yang sku'i drag shul ni/ phyag zhabs zhal spyan gyi 'gyur ba rnams te/ de yang phyag dang po gnyis kyi 'gyur ba'am/ drag shul gyis brgya byin pho mo gnyis btul/

phyag lhag ma sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis btul nas dam la btags/ spyan gsum gyis tshangs pa drag po khyab 'jug gsum btul/ de nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i gnas su byon nas der gnas pa'i lha rnams btul dam la btags te srog snying gi sngags phul nas/ hūm̐ phaṭ dang oṃ gyi bar du bcug pas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rtsa ba'i sngags su gyur/ yang phyogs skyong bcus srog gi snying po yi ge bcu pa phul bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis snying por gyur pa yin no/ /de nas yang zhal brgyad kyis lha ma srin sde brgyad btul nas dam la btags/ rtsa zhal gyis thun mong gi lha chen brgyad btul bar bzhed de/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / khyab 'jug dang / gzhon nu gdong drug dang / bya na ya kha dang / tshogs kyi bdag po dang / lang ka mgrin bcu dang brgyad kyi mgo bcad nas zhal du gsol bas/ khrag dang / tshil bu dang / rkang la sogs pa zhal nas 'dzag pa byung / de nas thugs kyi drag shul thugs kha'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba yang btul ba yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs te gzhan don cho 'phrul mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ sku las 'jigs pa'i sprin dang mun nag lta bu ni gtibs/ ljags las ni 'jigs pa'i glog gi 'od zer du ma 'phros/ 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra drag po ni bsgrags/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa spros te drag po 'jigs byed brgyal du bcug de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jigs byed rtsa zhal du bcug sku lus kyi nang du mid 'od gsal du kho bo'i nyon mongs pa rnams sbyangs pas/ kho dran pa rnyed de byang chub tu sems bskyed/ las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i lus 'od gsal gyis bsregs nas thal bar byas nas gshang lam nas bton/ zhal dang phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur/

de nas phyi ma na sangs rgyas thal ba'i dbang po zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan/ 'jigs byed kyis gti mug gi bu legs ldan nag po/ zhe sdang gi bu mgon po nag po/ 'dod chags kyi bu gzhon nu kirti ka dang gsum bka' nyan du phul/ gzhan yang zhe sdang shas che ba dregs pa pho brgyad bzhon pa dang bcas pa zhabs g.yas pa'i gdan du phul/ 'dod chags shas che ba dregs pa mo brgyad bzhon pa dang bcas pa zhabs g.yon pa'i gdan du phul/ gzhan yang bran dang pho nya 'khor du gtogs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung nyan du bcug de nas lho phyogs rgya mtsho bsgral nas las kyi gshin rje'i gnas sgo med lcags mkhar bcu drug tu byon te/ zhabs bcu drug gis lcags mkhar bcu drug brdzis/ thugs ye shes rtse gcig gis mtshon byed mtshan ma rtse gcig gi dbus kyi lcags mkhar chen po brdzis nas/ las gshin chos kyi rgyal po dam la btags/ slar yang shing gcig dang dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas bcu bzhir byon te/ gsung gi drag shul ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ kyi sgra bsgrags pas ma mo mkha' 'gro dang / 'byung po dang / ro langs dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang / nam mkha' lding dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / phra men la sogs pa thams cad btul nas dam la bzhag de tshe dam chen chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa rnams kyis gzir bzhin du/ dpa' bo chen po khyod kyi dgos pa bdag gis bsgrub cing / bdag cag gi srog gi snying po tshul bzhin du 'bul bas dpal bo chen pos bzhes shig ces zhus te/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis srog snying phul ba ni/ gshin rjes ya/ ma mos ma/ srin pos ra/ gnod sbyin gyis kṣe/ mis na/ sa bdag gis sa/ btsan gyis tsa/ bdud kyis da phul nas thams cad kyis bran du khas blangs pa yin no/ /de ltar yang gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa las/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsung thugs/

/rdo rje rnams las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po yis/ /lho phyogs rgya mtsho phar brgal nas/ /de nas gshin rje'i grong khyer ni/ /ga la ba yi gnas su byon/ /mi zad zhabs ni bcu drug gis/ /lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug brdzis/ /ye shes rtse gcig mtshan ma yis/ /dbus kyi lcags mkhar chen po brdzis/ /de tshe bdud chen las rgyal nas/ /ha ha hi hi'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa/ /gzir zhing du ni rab smras pa/ /dpa' bo chen po gang la ci/ /dpa' bo dgos pa bdag gis bgyi/ /bdag cag srog gi snying po rnams/ /tshul bzhin 'bul gyis dpa' bos bzhes/ /zhes pa dang / srog snying phul tshul yang / gshin rjes ya/ ma mos ma/ srin pos ra/ gnod sbyin gyis kṣe/ mis na/ sa bdag gis sa/ btsan gyis tsa/ bdud kyis da phul/ de rnams gcig tu dril ba yis/ /bran du yang ni khas blangs so/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa btul nas rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar drag po las kyi gshin rje sogs btul nas/ de nas gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud rnams gsungs pa yin te/ de yang lha'i bu 'dul ba'i phyir gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud gsungs/ las kyi gshin rje 'dul ba'i don du gdong drug gi rgyud gsungs pa yin par gzhon nu gdong drug gi rgyud las gsungs te/ de nyid las/ 'das pa'i gdug pa btul nas/ glang bu'i bdag po chung ma dang bcas pa zhes pa nas/ mnan par gyur to/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pas rtogs nus/ zhal dgu pa'i rgyud ni/ dbang phyug chen po 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa yin te/ de'i tshul ni/ sngon lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling chags pa dang dus mnyam du ru tra chen po bzhi byung ste/ de yang ma hā ru tra/ ka na ru tra/ thar pa ru tra/ ma tram̐ ru tra'o/ /de ltar bzhi'i mahā ru tra la chung ma lha rnams kyi mdangs las grub pa u ma dang lha ma yin gyi mdangs las grub pa tsaṇḍi ki te nu ste gnyis yod pa las/

u ma la bu mahā kā la dang / bu mo ka li gnyis/ gzhon nu gdong drug dang gsum byung / te nu la bu tshogs bdag byung ba'i ma hā ka li gnyis ni gur mgon lcam dral te 'di gnyis kyi skye rgyud ni gzhan du rgyas par 'byung bas 'dir ma bkod la/ gzhon nu gdong drug gi lo rgyus ni/ dbang phyug chen po dang u ma gnyis snyoms par zhugs dus drang srong gcig yon slong du byung ba na/ u ma khros te/ da lta'i dus su slong ba 'di dang 'brel ba yin zer nas rang gi mtshan ma'i nang nas sa bon drod kyi bdag nyid me stag gi phung po ltar yod pa brus nas de'i khar blugs pas/ drang srong gi kha tshig ste rgya mtsho'i 'gram du phyin te kha bkrus pa las/ sa bon me mdag gi phung por yod pa la/ gzhon nu ma drug gis rgya mtshor khrus byas pas 'khyags nas bsros pa las/ de la yid kyi bu gcig byung ste/ gzhon nu ma zhig na re/ nga'i bu min zer/ gzhan rnams kyis kyang re re bzhin nga'i bu min zer ba la/ drug ka dga' bar bya ba'i phyir gdong pa drug tu sprul pas de la gdong drug tu grags so/ /der dbang phyug gis tshogs bdag 'dzam bu gling gi bdag por bskos pas/ de la ma tram̐ phrag dog skyes pas brtsad pas/ tshogs bdag 'khor bcas pham nas tshogs bdag gi mgo bo ma tram̐ gis bcad de khyer song ba la/ pha dbang phyug gis mngon shes kyis brtags pas sems can gyi mgo bo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa gcig sbyar na gsos par shes nas btsal bas ma rnyed/ skabs shig na glang chen mo gcig phru gu 'phral du skyes pa gcig rnyed nas de'i mgo bo bcad de khrag 'dzag bzhin pa de sbyar nas sngar bzhin du yang tshogs bdag gi lo rgyus kha cig las/ dbang phyug la chung ma gnyis te gcig gaṅgā'o/ /de la bu gcig skyes pa nas u mas bltar phyin te bu ston smras pas/ bu la mgo bo med zer nas ston du ma 'dod pa la/

u ma khros nas mgo bo med par gyur cig ces smras pas/ de nas bu la bltas pas mgo bo med par song 'dug ste/ slar u ma la zhus pas/ mgo byang du bstan pa'i ro gang rnyed pa gcig gi mgo chod la sbyor cig dang bu'i mgo yod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer bas/ der mi'i mgo ma rnyed nas/ der glang po che'i ro gcig dang 'phrad de/ de'i mgo bcad nas sbyar bas glang po'i mgo can du gyur to zhes kyang grag go zhes 'byung ngo / /dbang phyug 'khor bcas pham/ ru tra rgyal te lan ci yang ma lon pa nas re zhig gi tshe na u ma las skyes pa'i bu gdong drug gis ru tra la rtsod par brtsams pa na gdong drug kyang pham par gyur/ der pha dbang phyug chen po ri rab kyi khong seng na yod pas mngon shes kyis brtags pas 'dzam bu gling na bu gdong drug pham par shes nas/ dbang phyug chen po nga rgyal skyes te/ nga'i bu tshogs bdag dang gdong drug gnyis ka ru tra 'dis pham par byas pas/ da ni kho ngas brlags par byed bsams nas sum cu rtsa gsum gnas sa 'og rta'i gnyen po yan gyi lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs bsdus te ru tra dang brtsad pas ru tra 'khor bcas rnams pham par gyur pa dang / ru tras bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la skyabs su gsol bas/ de'i tshe 'jam dpal gyis dbang phyug 'dul ba'i phyir du sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnyen por phyag sum cu rtsa bzhir sprul/ rta'i dgra g.yag gi ma he yin pas de'i dbang du mdzad nas lha ma yin gyi sa 'og gi rta'i gnyen por ma he'i gdong pa sprul/ sa steng gi nad brgyad dang gdon brgyad kyi gnyen por zhabs bcu drug sprul/ dbang phyug chen po nyid kyi gnyen por mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs pa bstan nas btul ba yin te/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ sprul pa'i sku de sku yi mchog /ces pa nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces pa'i bar dang /

gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ khyab 'jug 'dul phyir ma he'i zhal/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po 'dul phyir du/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag mtshan bcas/ /drag po dbang phyug 'dul phyir du/ /gsang ba'i mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs/ /zhes dang / sambu ṭi las/ khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed bshad par bya ste/ gang zhig khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa nas bzung ste/ de thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis thal bar rlog par byed de/ zhes dang / 'jam dpal gsang rgyud las/ de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ni/ /khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje gshed/ /mtshon byed me ltar 'bar bas 'khrigs/ /drag la mthu rtsal drag ldan pa'i/ /de mthong na ni khro bo gzhan/ thams cad kun gyi lag cha 'chor/ /de bzhin du ni 'jig rten pa/ /lha rnams kun gyis 'dud par byed/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /'di la kho bo'i yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhas pa'i dbang po ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsung las/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnyen por phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi 'dod pa ni yid ches kyi khungs gsal po yod na ma gtogs yid ches dka' 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas spyir 'di 'dra'i rigs can la de lta bu'i rgyud rgya gzhung la dngos shugs gang rung gis brten pa'i khungs rnam dag cig dgos par snang yang / 'on kyang rwa chen gyi rjes 'jug dag gis ni rwa chen nyid kyi rtog bdun gyi ṭikkā nag 'grel las/ 'jam dpal gyis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnyen por phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi sprul/ zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di tshad ldan gyi khungs su byed dgos pa 'dra snyam ste da dung dpyad par bya'o/ /de ltar 'jam dpal gyis gdul bya dbang phyug de nyid zhi bas 'dul bar mi nus pas na/ drag po'i cha lugs sam gzugs kyis legs par btul nas/ de nas so ma pu rir 'khor sprul pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje yab yum gyi tshogs dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs du ma 'dus pa rnams la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'bum la sogs pa gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs nas/

yum mchog rdo rje ro langs ma dang / gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje gnyis la bka' rgyas btab nas gnang / de gnyis kyis kyang rtsod dus kyis gdul bya rnams kyi nyams su mi long bar shes nas u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas su gter du sbas so zhes bshad/ yang de ltar gsungs pa'i rgyud 'bum pa de rtsod dus kyi gdul bya rnams tshe thung zhing le lo dang rnam g.yengs che/ shes rab dang brtson 'grus zhan pas rgyud rgyas pa'i tshig don rgya chen spyod yul du mi 'gyur ba la dgongs nas u rgyan gyi yul dharma dzña zhes pa'i chos mdzod na mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis longs spyod cing bzhugs par bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis gdul bya drag po 'jigs byed btul ba'i tshul gyi lo rgyus 'di dag ni 'jigs byed kyi yig rnying 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba ltar bkod pa yin la/ dbang phyug chen po btul nas rgyud 'bum pa gsungs tshul gyi lo rgyus 'di ni/ rwa chen rdo rje grags kyi mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi ṭikka nag 'grel du grags pa de nyid dang / rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi bla ma rgya bal gyi lo rgyus kyi yi ge jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang gis mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi rnam bshad kyi dbu na bzhugs pa'i rgyud gsungs tshul rnams gung bsgrigs nas bkod pa yin no/ /yang gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud byon tshul la rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi gsung rgyun las 'byung ba ltar na/ ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya kha'i tshe/ srod la bdud thams cad kyi 'tshe ba mang po byung ba na thugs kha nas khro bo'i rgyal po dgra nag sprul te/ phyag na rdo rje la/ phyag na rdo rje khyod 'di lta bu'i gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs su bsgyur te/ bdud dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / lha rnams choms shig

chongs shig rtogs shig ces gsungs/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes dgra nag gi tshogs mang po sprul te bdud rnams btul/ de'i tshe phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i gdul bya skal ldan rnams la rtsa rgyud dgra nag le'u bco brgyad pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud gdong drug dang / rtog bdun te rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum gsungs/ de bzhin du dmar po'i rgyud rnams kyang de'i tshe gsungs pas dmar nag gi rgyud rnams bshad de/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i gsung la/ srad pa kun blos zin bris mdzad pa las/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i chos skor rnams ni sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje gdan du bdud btul ba'i tshe/ nyid kyi sku las gshin rje gshed dmar nag rnams sprul nas bdud btul zhing / lag na rdo rje la bka' bsgo ba mdzad de rgyud rnams gsungs so zhes gshin rje gshed pa rnams 'chad pas dmar nag gi rgyud rnams ni mnyam du byung ba yin la zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ rgyas pa rgyud 'bum pa dang khri nyis stong pa sogs ni u rgyan du rang byung he ru ka'i gzhal yas khang du bzhugs par bshad la/ gung ru shes rab bzang pos/ shanti pa'i 'grel pa shes byed du drangs nas rgyud rgyas pa sgra nam mkha' la dengs pa yin pa dges rdor gyi rgyud rgyas pa dang mtshungs pas u rgyan na yang mi bzhugs par bzhed rgyu yin pa 'dra snyam/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'bum pa ni u rgyan gyi yul na bzhugs pa'i rtog pa sum brgya pa de yin par bla chen 'phags pa bzhed pas gung ru gang gsungs kyang rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' la dengs pa med/ de ltar na grub chen la li tas u rgyan gyi yul nas rtog bdun rgyud 'bum pa nas phyung nas yul dbus su spyan drangs pa yin par rtog bdun rang gi mjug tu gsungs shing / gsungs pa ltar rwa skyo zhang gsum sogs gshin rje gshed la mkhas pa thams cad bzhed pa dang gung ru'i 'di 'gal lam snyam pa'i dogs pa 'byung bas dpyod ldan dag gis dpyod rigs so/

/rgyud rgyas pa de dag nas bsdus pa'i rgyud la/ dgra nag le'u bco brgyad pa/ gdong drug gi rgyud/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog bdun te gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud gsum dang / gdong drug gi rgyud/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtogs bdun te gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud gsum dang / dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa dang / nyer gnyis pa gnyis te bod du 'gyur ba'i gshin rje gshed skor gyi rgyud rtsod med ni lnga po de dag yin par bshad pa de'i nang nas dgra nag gi rgyud ni rtsa rgyud dang / gdong drug dang / rtog bdun gnyis bshad rgyud du bzhed de/ gdong drug gi dgra nag gi gtor ma'i cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sogs pa cho ga'i rnam gzhag ma tshang ba kha skong bar byed pa dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi cha mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pas bshad rgyud/ rtog bdun gyi ni dgra nag tu drag po'i las mi gsal ba gsal bar ston pas na bshad rgyud du 'gro ba yin zhes bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed pa yin la/ 'o na rtog gsum dang rtog gcig ma la sogs pa rnams rgyud ma yin snyam na/ rtog gsum ni skyo pa rnams rtog bdun gyi bshad rgyud du bzhed/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun las/ kha cig rtog bdun gyi 'khrul 'khor byed tshul mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa bshad pa'i rgyud rtog pa gsum pa zhes zer nas rtog gsum rgyud du 'dod pa snang na'ang / sngon gyi mkhas pa mang pos rgyud du mi 'dod pa rtsod pa can du snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pas rtog gsum rgyud yin min rtsod pa can rtog gsum la skyo pa sogs kyis rgyud kyi ming btags kyang / las tshogs man ngag ston pa'i bstan bcos shig yin/ de 'dra rgyud du bu ston rin po che yang mi bzhed/ dngos grub kyi rgyud rtog pa bzhi pa rgyud yin par bzhed/ du mdzad/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob dpal gyi rgyal mtshan pa dang /

gung ru sogs kyis rtog gsum gyi dbu zhabs gang na'ang rgyud yin pa'i shes byed dang / rgyud yin zer ba med pas mtha' gcig tu rgyud min par bzhed/ 'on kyang rgya gar gyi slob dpon zhig gis mdzad dam/ rgya gar gyi man ngag yod pa'i bod kyi sngags pa zhig gis brtsams pa yin nam/ bka'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pa'i bstan bcos rnam dag cig yin zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du rwa pa rnams kyang rtog gsum rgyud du mi bzhed ces 'ga' zhig las bshad kyang / rwa chen rdo rje grags kyi rtog gsum rgyud du bzhed dam snyam ste/ rwa chen nyid kyis gsung las/ le'u bco brgyad kun kyi gzhi/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po ston pas gsungs/ /de yi grogs su rtog pa gsum/ /sngags pa'i mtshon char ston pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / bu ston gyi rtog bdun rnam bshad las/ so ma pu rir rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'bum pa gsungs pa mkha' 'gro rnams kyis u rgyan du spyan drangs te chos mdzod du bcug pa las/ slob dpon chen po la li ta badzras rtog pa bdun pa dang / rtog pa gsum pa dang / te'u lo pa'i rtog pa rnams gdan drangs te a mo gha badzra la gsungs/ zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis rtogs nus la/ rtog gcig ma dang / 'khor lo'i rtog pa dang / gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa dang / gshin rje drag dmar gyi rtog pa zer ba rnams ni skyo lugs pa'i sngags pa kha cig gi rang dgar brtsams pa yin pas bstan bcos rnam dag kyang min par bshad/ te'u lo pa zhes pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ te'u lo pa'i pags pa blud bu bshus byas pa la brten nas gsus pa sbos pa'i man ngag cig bshad pa/ ra lugs pa kha cig gis logs su phyung nas te'u lo pa'i rtog pa zhes ming btags pa tsam yin pas bka' las byung ba ni yin/ rgyud rang kha ba min par bshad/ rje ngor chen gyi gsung rgyun las/ gzhan 'di'i rgyud du 'dod pa'i gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa zhes pa dang /

las mkhan te'u lo pa'i rtog pa zhes pa dang / gshin rje drag dmar gyi rtog pa rgyud du 'dod pa rnams ni rgyud yin pa'i don med do/ /zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ rtog gcig ma dang / drag dmar gyi rtog pa sogs ni rgyud ma yin la/ des na gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud bod du 'gyur ba ni sngar bshad pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum po de dag tu nges shing / dmar po'i rgyud la le'u nyer gnyis pa dang / le'u bcu dgu pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngon nas ma 'gyur bar phyis su kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang ldan 'debs mkhan de nyid kyi phyag tu rgyud de'i rgya dpe byung ba bu ston rin po che la phul bas/ bu ston gyis rang bsgyur mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi rgya dpe bod na bzhugs kyang / lung rgyun dang bshad rgyun sogs ni mi bzhugs la/ des na le'u bcu dgu pa gshed dmar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / lha bcu gsum pa ston byed 'di nyid bod du 'gyur ba'i gshed dmar gyi rgyud mchog tu gyur pa yin par bshad do/ /de rnams kyis gshin rje gshed kyi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams ji ltar byon pa'i tshul legs par bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa de dag gi dgongs 'grel dang lam srol mi 'dra ba ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la/ 'phags yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang bod yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la yang nag po'i skor dang / dmar po'i skor gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ gong du bstan pa ltar gshin rje gshed nag po la dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud gsum las/ dgra nag zhal gsum pa'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa la/ grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa dang / slob dpon shinti pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mthong ba'i lam gyi sgron me zhes bya ba dang bzhi las phyi ma 'di legs rgyu med pa zhig yod par bshad/

yang don gyi 'grel pa la/ grub chen la li tas gshin rje gshed 'byung ba zhes bya ba le'u gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ le'u dang pos dgra nag gi sgrub thabs/ le'u gnyis pas 'di'i dkyil chog le'u gsum pa las sbyor ston pa zhig mdzad pa de dang / grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang gnyis/ gdong drug la slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / slob dpon de wa a ka ra tsant+ra'i sgrub thabs dang gnyis ma gtogs 'di la tshig 'grel yod par ma bshad cing / spyir rgyud 'di nas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ sgo ba bzhi/ sgeg sogs brgyad de lha nyer gcig gi dkyil 'khor bstan pa yin cing / bsdu na lha dgu dang bcu gsum du yang bsdur rung bar bshad pas 'di nas gdong drug gi dkyil 'khor gsum bstan pa yin no/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa la slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon dpal chen rdo rje grub pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang gsum/ phyi ma 'di la dpe kha cig las/ so na shrīs byas zer ba dang / kha cig las dges pa'i rdo rjes byas zer ba dang / la lar mdzad byang med par sha ba ri pas bsgyur ces pa dang / nag tshos bsgyur zer ba sogs dpe mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung yang / don gyi ngo bo 'grel pa gcig yin par bshad/ don 'grel sgrub thabs kyi gzhung la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis las/ snga ma la grub chen la li tas mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs/ zhi khro sbrags ma'am zhi khro rnam par rol pa zhes pa dang / slob dpon a mo gha badzras mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i rdo rje 'chang gi rnam bshad rdo rje myu gur 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs tshad thub lngar bshad nas/ gzhan bcu gsum ma dang / snar thang pas byas pa'i lha zhe gcig ma dang /

'jam skyas byas pa'i lha so bdun ma rnams ma dag par bshad/ dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes bya ba dang / slob dpon a mos mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs dang gsum yod par bshad/ phyi ma dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs las/ slob dpon shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa zhig dang / grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ grub chen a mo gha badzras mdzad pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dang bzhi yod par bshad pa yin no/ /yang rwa lugs kyi chos skor gyi dkar chag bla ma gong mas mdzad pa las/ dgra nag la grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dang / gzhan yang sus mdzad med pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi rtog pa zhes pa gcig dang dam rdzas bdud rtsi bza' ba'i rtog pa dang / las rgyud kyi grogs zhes bya ba lo tsā ba rwa chen gyis bsgyur ba/ 'khor lo gsal byed buddha shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa dang / yang 'khor lo'i gsal byed phyi ma zhes bya ba rnams dang / 'jigs byed la shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / a mo gha badzras mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dang sbyin sreg di paṃ ka ras mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg ratna a ka ra shantis mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rgya gzhung du ma dang / bla ma bha ros mdzad pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang / zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rnams yod par bshad cing / de dag phal cher rwa chen nyid kyis gsar bsgyur dang / 'ga' zhig la 'gyur bcos mdzad pa yin te/ rwa lo nyid kyi gsung las/ sgrub thabs dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis/ /mdzad pa 'di la gtso bor bzung / /'khrul 'khor gsal byed buddha shrī'i/ /lus dang snying 'dra'i man ngag yod/

/ces dang / snying po rgyud mchog rtog bdun yod/ /don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i dkyil chog sbyin sreg yod/ /di paṃ ka ra'i sbyin sreg yod/ /ratna a kar shan ti yis/ /mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod/ /bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum yod/ /kha cig gsar bsgyur kha cig bcos/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar gshin rje gshed nag po'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum dang / dgongs 'grel de las lam srol mi 'dra ba ni du ma zhig byung ba yin te/ gtso bo'am rtsa bar gyur ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ro langs mas dngos su byin gyis rlobs pa'i grub chen la li ta badzra'i lugs dang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis paṇḍi ta chen po ye shes zhabs la dngos su gdams pa de nyid/ grub chen dpal 'dzin la gnang ba'i ye shes zhabs lugs sam/ dpal 'dzin lugs gnyis yin la/ de gnyis las so sor brgyud pa'i nang gses gyi dbye ba ni mang du yod pa yin te/ grub chen a mo gha badzra'i lugs/ dzñā na a ka ra'i lugs/ paṇḍi ta shrī bha dra'i lugs/ paṇḍi ta bha liṃ ta ā tsarya'i lugs/ grub chen na ro pa'i lugs/ paṇḍi ta ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta'i lugs te 'phags yul gyi paṇḍi ta'i lugs srol drug tsam dang / bal po bha ro'i lugs dang bdun tsam zhig yod pa yin la/ de dag kyang bsdu na/ la li ta'i lugs dang / dpal 'dzin gyi lugs gnyis po der 'dus pa yin te/ bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum a mo badzra nas brgyud pa yin pas de'i lugs su bsdus kyang chog de yang a mo gha badzra'i lugs ni/ grub chen la li ta'i lugs su 'dus te/ grub chen a mo ghas la li ta'i drung nas gsan pa de nyid kho na rang gi slob ma rnams la yang bstan cing / thugs nyams su bzhes pa yang la li ta'i lugs las gzhan pa'i gshed skor gyi gdams ngag med pas so/ /de bzhin du na ro pa'i lugs ma gtogs gzhan lnga yang la li ta'i lugs las gzhan du med dam snyam ste/

la li tas srol phye ba las gzhan pa'i 'jigs byed kyi chos skor med pa rwa pa rnams bzhed cing / sa lugs la yang nā ro pa nas brgyud pa 'di ma gtogs gzhan thams cad la li ta la ltos pa kho na yin pas so/ /na ro pa la brgyud pa 'di ni la li ta la ltos mi dgos te/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la gnang ngo / /des grub chen dpal 'dzin la/ des na ro pa la brgyud pa yin par bshad la/ de ltar gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor la 'phags yul du lugs srol gyi gtso bo lta bu gnyis dang / de las rim par gyes pa nang gses kyi dbye ba bdun tsam zhig byung ba las/ bye brag tu rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lam srol ni dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / dpa' bo gcig pa'i lam srol gnyis su 'dus shing / dang po yongs rdzogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyis dgongs pa gsum du mdzad nas/ gsum po de dag mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rgyas par gsungs pa las/ 'dir de dag gi snying po bsdus nas bshad na/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa'i dgongs pa grub chen la li tas gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dang / gzhan yang rgyud nas bshad pa'i phyag mtshan rnams/ phyag mtshan de dag 'dzin pa'i lha rdo rje mgo bo la sogs pa rnams dang / lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir phyag mtshan gyi sogs khong nas zhabs g.yas kyi gdan rnams 'don te/ de'ang phyogs re'i phyag mtshan gyi sogs khong nas gdan gnyis gnyis bton nas/ de dag 'dzin pa'i lha dang / ro langs brgyad po ni rgyud nas bshad pa'i ro langs kyi sgrub pa byed na 'god pa yin gyi/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang / mchog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la ro langs mi 'god par/ de'i sar zhabs g.yon gyi gdan rnams bkod nas de dag 'dzin pa'i lhar bskyed de nyams len gyi rim pa ston pa/ 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor lam srol bkral/

yang slob dpon a mo gha badzra gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang / gshin rje gshed spyi'i bshad rgyud/ 'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud ces pa gnyis la brten nas gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dang phyag mtshan rnams 'god pa rgyud kyi dngos bstan bzhin la/ ro langs rnams kyi tshab tu gnod sbyin mo brgyad dang / phyi'i padma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du gshin rje pho brgyad dang bcas pa ste/ 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor bkral/ yang slob dpon a mos gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dang ro langs rnams rgyud kyi rtog pa dang po'i dngos bstan ji lta ba bzhin la/ srung 'khor gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma nas bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gyis kha bskangs te/ gtso bo la ro langs brgyad bskor gyi 'jigs byed lha bcu dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor mdzad pa yin la/ gnyis pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs la/ slob dpon shrī bha dras gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su gtso bo kho na bsgom pa/ de yang bde mchog lū hi pa ltar rten dang brten pa gnyis cig car bskyed pa rus sbal lta bu'i bskyed chog ston pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa zhig mdzad cing / rje btsun sa skya ba chen po kun dga' snying pos rtog bdun gyi ṭikkar yang bskyed chog 'di dang yang mthun par bshad/ yang slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs su gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su 'jigs byed kho na bsgom pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i nyams len bstan pa ste rten dang brten pa rim can du bskyed pa zhig dang / yang slob dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gzhal yas khang dang / dur khrod med pa'i srung 'khor tsam dang bcas pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad/

yang slob dpon a mo gha badzras rten yan lag gsum po gang yang med pa'i 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bkral pa de nyid dang bzhi yod par bshad pas na/ mdor na 'phags yul du byung ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lam srol bdun po de dag tu nges te/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i gsung las/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la gsum dang / dpa' bo gcig pa la bzhi bshad pa'i rjes su/ des na rgya gar nas byung ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gyi sgrub thabs de tsam du nges pa yin la/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /de dag gis ni 'phags yul du gshin gshed rje nag po'i skor gyi dgongs 'grel dang lam srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa dmar po'i skor ni/ gong du bstan pa'i gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa dang / bu ston rin po ches bsgyur ba'i le'u nyer gnyis la ma brten par/ u rgyan na bzhugs pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag gsum pa la brten nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pas gshed dmar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / spros med kyi lam srol 'di phye ba yin te/ de yang rgyud de nyid kyi dgongs 'grel du gshed dmar lha lnga char gyi mngon par rtogs pa las tshogs dang bcas pa ston pa sgrub thabs rgyas pa dang / gtso bo rkyang pa'i mngon rtogs ston pa sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga ste bskyed rim ston pa'i gzhung gsum dang / shin tu spros pa med pa'i man ngag spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang / 'od gsal 'char ba'i cho ga bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga ste rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum dang / yang 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba dang / der mi gsal ba'i sngags btu ba dang / las so so'i sngags gsal bar ston pa gshin rje bsgrub pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba las tshogs ston pa'i gzhung gnyis te brgyad tsam zhig mdzad/

yang grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa la brten nas gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lam srol bkral pa yin te/ slob dpon de nyid kyis gshin rje gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dregs byed me lha'i mchod chog dmar nag thun mong ba'i mchod chog tsaṇa tsi ka phag mo/ dbyangs can ma/ gau ri ste lha mo bzhi'i sgrub thabs re re ste bskyed rim gyi gzhung bcu phrag gcig yang rnal 'byor bzhi'i byin rlabs/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i tshig rkang / 'pho ba'i byin rlabs/ 'pho ba'i man ngag 'khrul 'khor dang phyir bzlog gi man ngag 'od 'dzin ma'i byin rlabs/ de'i sgrub thabs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga ste rdzogs rim ston pa'i gzhung brgyad mdzad/ yang de'i rjes su paṇḍi ta blo zab snying po zhes bya ba des gshed dmar gyi mngon rtogs dang / bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa dang gzhung gnyis mdzad/ gzhan paṇḍi ta darpan a tsarya zhes bya bas 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid bya ba'i gzhung gcig mdzad de/ da lta yongs su grags pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar po'i chos skor gyi rgya gzhung ni de rnams yin la/ des na dmar po'i lam srol yang rgyud 'bum pa la brten nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pas bkral pa'i lha lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa la brten nas dpal 'dzin gyis phye ba'i lha sum cu ma'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis sam/ yang rgyud de la brten nas paṇḍi ta blo zab snying po zhes bya bas mdzad pa'i lha lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor dang gsum du yod par gsungs pa yin no/ /'o na grub chen dpal 'dzin rje btsun birwa pa'i slob ma yin pas birwa pa'i lam srol las logs su bgrangs pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ 'gal ba med de/ grub chen 'dis rnal 'byor dbang phyug la gshin rje gshed dmar po'i chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs pa gsan pa yin mod/

'on kyang phyis su dpal 'dzin rang nyid la yi dam gyi zhal gzigs nas dngos su gdams pa la brten nas gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa rnams byung ba yin pas lugs srol tha dad yin par gsungs pa yin no/ /de dag gis ni 'phags yul du gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi dgongs 'grel dang lam srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ma lus pa bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa bod yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la yang / nag po'i skor dang dmar po'i skor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngar bstan pa ltar 'phags yul du lugs srol gyi gtso bo gnyis dang / de dag las so sor brgyud pa'i lugs bdun dang / khyad par du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lam srol la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / dpa' bo gcig pa gnyis las phye ba'i drug gam bdun du byon pa de rnams las brgyud pa'i bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir ni chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa'am skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma zhig gi sa paṇa grub so so la gsan pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi bka' srol mi 'dra ba mang du byon pa yin te/ zhang cog gru shes rab bla mas/ slob dpon a mo gha badzra chung ba la gsan pa'i zhang lugs dang / skyo ston 'od byung gis zhang la yang gsan/ slar paṇḍi ta de nyid la yang gsan nas dar rgyas su mdzad pas skyo lugs dang / 'gos lo tsā bas shrī bha dra'i man ngag la brten nas mad pa'i 'gos lugs dang / 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyi ratna a ka ra shanti'i man ngag la brten pa 'brog lugs dang / ba ri lo tsā bas paṇḍi ta ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta'i man ngag la brten pa ba ri lugs dang / rwa lo tsā bas bal po bha ro'i man ngag la brten pa rwa lugs dang / mal lo tsā bas bal po pham thing pa dang / bal po thugs rje chen po'i man ngag la brten pa'i mal lugs sam sa lugs dang / gnyos lo tsā bas ba liṃ ta a tsarya'i man ngag la brten pa gnyos lugs dang /

gyi jo lugs la sogs pa dgu tsam zhig byung ba las/ 'gos/ 'brog ba ri/ gyi jo/ gnyos rnams nas brgyud pa'i bka' srol rnams ni deng sang mi bzhugs par bshad la/ da lta'i bar du bka' ma nub par yod pa ni/ zhang lugs/ skyo lugs/ mal lugs sam sa lugs/ rwa lugs dang bzhi po yin pa las/ dang po zhang lugs ni/ zhang cog gru shes rab bla mas paṇḍi ta a mo gha chung ba la gsan nas dar rgyas su mdzad pa ste/ lugs 'di pa lha zhe dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor la gtso bor mdzad pa yin la/ skyo ston lugs ni skyo 'od 'byung gis grub chen a mo gha badzra chung ba la gsan nas 'phel ba 'di nyid de/ brgyud pa 'di lha bcu bdun ma la thugs dam gyi mthil yang mdzad 'chad nyan yang 'di la gtso bor mdzad cing / 'di pa rang gis mdzad pa'i rtog gsum gyi 'grel pa/ rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa sogs 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs sogs yig 'jog du ma yod par snang ngo / /gzhan yang chos rgyal 'phags pas zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs zhi khro rnam rol/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi khrid yig rnams yod cing / mal lugs sam sa lugs ni mal lo nas sa skya pa chen po la brgyud pa ste/ lugs 'di la rtog bdun gyi dngos bstan ro langs brgyad bskor gtso bor mdzad cing / sa chen gyis rtog bdun gyi ṭikka dang mchan mdzad/ rje btsun sku mched kyis 'jigs byed la bstod pa re las yig cha cher ma mdzad/ phyis kun mkhyen chen pos 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi sgrub dkyil yang mdzad/ zha lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog gtor ma'i cho ga bkra shis kyi cho ga rnams mdzad la/ gzhan yang lugs 'di la rjes 'jug gi mkhas pa du mas mdzad pa'i yig cha mang du yod cing de dag la brten nas lugs 'di'i dbang bka' dang bshad bka' sogs ma nub cing dar rgyas su bzhugs pa yin no/ /rwa lugs ni rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bal po bha ro la gsan nas 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa 'di nyid de/

'di la rwa rdo rje grags kyis rtog bdun gyi dka' 'grel/ nag 'grel man ngag bcud kyi thig pa ste rgyud kyi yig cha gsum/ yang sgrub thabs la dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi sgrub thabs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin gter mdzod/ dpal 'dzin gyi ma he'i zhal gyi sgrub thabs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas gtso bo'i sgrub thabs dri med snang ba/ bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs nas zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs khams gsum za byed/ zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs dri med chu rgyun/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen don bsdus rnams mdzad/ gzhan yang smin byed la dbang gi chu rgyun/ lam gyi yan lag la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ha la nag po'i shog dril gsum/ bsnyen bsgrub dgra srog dbang bsdud/ dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa sogs yig cha'i rnam grangs/ rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rwa pod kyi dkar chag nang bzhin sogs mang du mdzad nas dar rgyas su mdzad pa la 'jigs byed rwa lugs zhes grags shing / deng sang gi bar du yang rgyun ma chad cing dar rgyas su bzhugs pa yin zhing / lugs 'di la gtso bor thugs rtsis mdzad pa ni ro langs brgyad bskor dang lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis po yin la/ rwa lugs 'di la chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sgrub dkyil dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi ro langs brgyad skor gyi sgrub thabs dang / bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs sogs kyang yod pa yin no/ /yang rje ngor chen gyi gsung las/ bod du gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor la thog mar mkhas pa rwa skyo zhang gsum/ tha mar mkhas pa mgar ldong gnyos gsum ste mkhas pa sgo drug gi bshad srol dang ngos bzung ba zhes gsungs pa'i rwa skyo zhang gsum ni gong du bshad ma thag pa de dag yan la/ tha mar mkhas pa mgar ldong gi mgar ni/

mgar rdo rje snying po dang rong zom chos bzang rnams yin kyang zhang pa'i khongs su 'du bar bshad la/ ldong ni ldong ston shes rab dpal te/ drag po sngags gter la sogs pa mdzad cing gdams pa yang du yod kyang rwa lugs kyi rjes 'brangs yin par bshad/ gnyos ni gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags te lugs 'di la ba ling ta ā tsarya'i man ngag yin zer ba'i 'jigs byed lha bcu dgu ma dang / ro langs brgyad bskor min pa'i dkyil 'khor zhig bzhugs pa rje rdo rje 'chang gis 'thad ldan yin min rtsod pa can du gsungs la/ yang gung ru shes rab bzang pos 'jigs byed la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / dpa' bo gcig pa gnyis yongs rdzogs la rnam dag gsum/ bod kyi man ngag gis bzos pa gnyis/ rtog btags kyi dkyil 'khor gsum dang brgyad du gsungs nas/ rnam dag gsum la ro langs brgyad bskor dang / zhe dgu ma dang / bcu bdun ma dang gsum po 'dren par mdzad/ rwa lugs kyi bcu gsum ma dang / gnyos lugs kyi dgu ma gnyis po la bod kyi man ngag gis bzos pa zhes bshad/ rtog btags kyi gsum ni bo dong 'jam ral sogs 'dod pa'i zhe gcig ma dang / mi tra dzu kas mdzad par grags pa'i mi tra brgya rtsa'i nang gi lha lnga ma dang / dge lugs pa'i bcu gsum ma dang gsum po yin par gsungs shing / de dang mthun pa rje rdo rje 'chang gis kyang / yang bo dong 'jam ral dang zhang ston rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bzhi bcu zhe gcig ma'i sgrub thabs byas pa rnams la ni/ de ltar ston byed kyi rgyud gang yang med pas rang bzo 'ba' zhig tu zad do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dga' ldan pa'i bcu gsum ma la dgag sgrub rgyas par mdzad pas na zhe gcig ma dang / dge lugs pa'i bcu gsum ma gnyis 'thad ldan min par bzhed pa yin no/ /des na bod 'dir 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la rnam grangs brgyad tsam zhig yod kyang /

rtsod med ni ro langs brgyad bskor sogs gsum po der nges pa yin la/ yang bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis rwa lugs bcu gsum ma yang lung rigs du mas 'thad ldan du bsgrub par mdzad nas dkyil 'khor rnam dag bzhi'i ro langs brgyad bskor la sa lugs dang / rwa lugs gnyis su phye nas lngar yod par yang gsungs so/ /de dag las ro langs brgyad bskor gnyis dang / zhe dgu ma dang / rwa lugs bcu gsum ma dang / skyo lugs bcu bdun ma dang lnga la ni deng sang yang bka' ma nub par bzhugs pa yin no/ /'o na rwa lugs bcu gsum pa dang dge lugs bcu gsum ma gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gang yod ce na/ 'di gnyis la khyad par shin tu mang ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal 'gyed mi mthun pa dang / phyag mtshan 'dzin tshul mi mthun pa dang / 'di nyid kyi ras bris dkyil 'khor bri tshul mi mthun pa dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul mi mthun pa dang / bsrung 'khor 'bri tshul mi mthun pa dang / bzlas pa byed tshul mi mthun pa dang / gtso bo la yum yod tshul mi mthun pa sogs mang du gsungs pa yin la/ de ltar na'ang dge ldan pa rang gi bzhed pas/ rwa lo'i bcu gsum ma dang gcig pa'i khul gyi khong rang bzhed pa'i bcu gsum ma 'thad pa'i lung rigs mang du 'god par mdzad pa'i snying po drag shos la 'di ltar gsungs te/ gtso bo 'jigs byed la gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs lha bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba 'di/ rtog bdun gyi bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las bshad pa yin te/ de nyid las/ 'khrul 'khor gyi sngags kyi yi ge bsre ba'i skabs su/ ling tshe dgu pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ ya kṣe ma me da dang lnga/ de'i phyi rol re mig bcu gnyis pa la lha lhag ma brgyad/ thod pa bzhi ste bcu gnyis kyi sa bon 'god par bshad pa gang zhig sa bon de rnams rim bzhin lha so so dang thod pa bzhi'i ngo bor brjod pa'i phyir te/

dgra nag las/ yi ge kṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /yi ge ma ni phra mar gsungs/ /yi ge me ni 'dod chags nyid/ /yi ge da ni phrag dog 'gyur/ /yi ge 'joms pa lnga ru grags/ /yi ge ya ni tho bar grags/ /yi ge tsa ni dbyug pa gtso/ /lag na padma ni yig las/ /yi ge ya ni ral grir ldan/ /yi ge dza ni sems mar brjod/ /yi ge ba ni phag mor grags/ /yi ge do las dbyangs can grags/ /yi ge ru ni go rir brjod/ /ṇa yo ni rwa mtshams bzhi ru/ /thod pa bzhi ru grags pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa las shes so/ /de ltar rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa dpal chen grub pa dang / so na shrī gnyis kas mdzad pa las/ yi ge bcu bdun de dag lha bcu bdun gyi rang bzhin can du rnam par bsgom la rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis gshin rje gshed/ lha bcu bdun gyi bdag nyid kyi ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol la/ mchod yon la sogs pa phul la sngar bris pa'i 'khor lo la tho ba la sogs pa'i sbyor bas bcug la/ de nas las dang mthun par gsungs pa'i rim pas bdag nyid rnam par bsgom la sngags yongs su bzlas te las bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor la brten nas las bsgrub pa'i skabs su ya la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu bdun lha'i rnam pa bcu gsum dang / lha'i ngo bor thod par bskyed pa la rang 'dra'i ye shes pa bcug nas las bsgrub par gsal bar gsungs pas/ gtso bo 'jigs byed la 'khor lha bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i bcu gsum ma grub ste/ 'jigs byed kyi dbang du byas pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi lha bcu gnyis kyi las bsgrub pa'i skabs su gtso bo 'jigs byed rang yong ba ma gtogs/ gshin rje gshed gzhan 'byung ba don med pa'i phyir/ des na gtso bo 'jigs byed la 'khor dgra nag nas bshad pa'i lha bcu gnyis dang / thod pa bzhis bskor ba shin tu gsal ba yod pas rgyud dang /

'grel pa la brten pa'i lugs rnam par dag pa ma rtogs bzhin du skur pa gdab par mi bya'o/ /zhes dge ldan pa rang gi rtsal ston gyi lugs su bshad la/ de la rje rdo rje 'chang gi slob rgyun rnams kyis dgag sgrub kyi rim pa mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs mod kyang / 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bkod la/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa bla ma mkhas pa dag gi gsung rgyun las kyang shin tu rgyas pa zhig gsungs pa'i snying po bsdus te brjod par bya ste/ khyod 'dod pa ltar na gtso bo 'jigs byed lha brgyad la lha gzhan du mas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor rigs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig khas len dgos 'byung ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ khyod kyis 'dod pa'i rtog gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor 'bri tshul ltar na/ re mig bcu gnyis pa'i phyi rol tu re mig bcu drug pa'i nang du hriḥṣṭi yi ge bcu bzhi'am/ bcu pa 'bri dgos la/ de ltar na gtso bo 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la sa bon hriḥṣṭi sogs pas bskyed pa'i phyogs skyong gi dkyil 'khor gcig kyang khas len dgos 'byung ste/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa las/ de nas sa bon hriḥyig rdzogs par dbang po yi'o/ /sa bon ṣṭi yig rdzogs par gshin rje'o/ /sa bon wi yig las rdzogs pa chu lha'o/ /sa bon ta yig las rdzogs pa dbang lha'o/ /sa bon a yig las rdzogs pa me lha'o/ /sa bon na yig la rdzogs pa bden bral lo/ /sa bon ṣa yig la rdzogs pa rlung lha'o/ /sa bon hūm̐ yig la rdzogasapa zla ba'o/ /sa bon hūm̐ yig la rdzogs pa tshangs pa'o/ /sa bon phaṭ yig la rdzogs pa nyi ma'o/ /sa bon phaṭ yig rdzogs pa nor 'dzin ma'o/ /zhes sogs hriḥṣṭi yi ge bcu bzhi pa las phyogs skyong bcu bzhi bskyed par gsungs pa'i phyir zhes pa dang / gzhan yang gtso bo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la bdag med lha mo bco lnga nyis 'gyur gyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor zhig kyang khas len rigs par thal/

rtog gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor gyi ling tshe bcu drug pa'i phyi rol tu re mig sum cu so gnyis pa gnyis yod pa'i rim pa dang po la a l̥ bcu drug pa phrag gnyis 'god pa gsungs pa gang zhig he badzra las kyang / a l̥ bcu drug las bdag med lha mo bco lnga bskyed par gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rigs pa ni stobs mtshungs kyi gnod lan gyis bzlog mi nus pa gnam lcags kyi thog lta bu shin tu bzod par dka' ba yin no/ /yang chos rje ri bo dge ldan pas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor lung rigs kyis bsgrubs nas/ des na rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yang yod pa yin gsungs te/ de'i sgrub byed kyi gtso bo gsum bkod nas/ ma he'i zhal 'di la yum yod par khas len te/ de yang dge ldan pa rang gi bzhed pas/ spyir yum yod par bsgrub pa la/ dbang gong ma la brten nas bsgrub pa/ dgra nag gi gzhung la brten nas bsgrub pa/ kyai rdo rje la brten nas bsgrub pa dang gsum du mdzad nas/ dang po ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yod de/ 'di'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe gsang dbang gi rdzas bsgrub pa la/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed nas yum la brten nas bsgrub dgos pa dang / dbang gsum pa'i tshe slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed rig ma lha mor bskyed pa dang snyoms 'jug byas pa las shes rab ye shes kyi dgos pa bsgrub dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang / gnyis pa ni lha'i bskyed chog gi sgo nas kyang yum yod par grub ste/ gtso bor 'jigs byed la 'khor dgra nag nas kha bskangs pas bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor 'grub pa gang zhig 'di'i tshe 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo yab yum gyi mngal nas 'byin pa 'thad pas de la yum dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang / gsum pa kyai rdo rje la brten nas kyang 'jigs byed la yum yod par grub ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bdag med ma bsgom pa'i tshe mo'i rtags bsgyur nas pho'i rtags dang ldan par bsgoms nas snyoms 'jug byed par bshad pa gang zhig

lha mo rtags dang ldan pa la pho rtags su bsgyur dgos na/ lha pho rtags dang ldan pa la phyag rgya ma gzhan bskyed nas snyoms 'jug byed dgos pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang gsum yod pa'i shes byed du bkod/ rtog bdun sogs rgyud rgya gzhung las 'jigs byed la yum ma bshad pa'i 'gal spong la/ rtog bdun sogs yod par ma bshad kyang mi 'gal te/ yum yod par ma bshad pa dang / med par bshad pa don mi gcig pa'i phyir zhes gsungs/ de la rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun las/ lung rigs kyi gnod byed mang po zhig gsungs pa'i snying po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang la gsang dbang dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba yod phyin de'i gtso bo la yum dang dngos su sbyor ba yod dgos na/ rdo rje phreng ba nas bshad pa'i phag mo sngon mo sogs yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la yum dgos pa dang / de nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo de la yang yum 'dod dgos par 'gyur te/ de rnams la gsang dbang dang dbang gsum pa bskur ba yod par phreng ba mkhan po nyid kyis bshad pa'i phyir/ de dag la 'dod na bla med kyi yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor mi srid pa khas len dgos pa dang / sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la yum yod par 'dod pa ni/ a bha ya ka ra nyid kyi zhal nas/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs padma'o/ /de'i ze'u 'bru la ro'i snying khar nyi ma'i gdan la shes rab ma dang / bcom ldan 'das sku mdog la sogs pa ni phyi nas 'chad pa'i 'khor lo gsum la gnas pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thod pa bzhin no/ /zhes gtso bo yum med du bshad pa dngos su 'gal bar gsungs pa dang / 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gyi gnas skabs su gtso bo la yum nges par yod dgos pa yang mi 'thad de/

de nges par dgos na de ston byed kyi rgyud dang / dgongs 'grel tshad ldan rnams nas de yod par bshad dgos pa'i phyir te/ de yod na de rgyud 'grel rnams kyi brjod bya yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di rnams 'jigs byed la yum yod pa'i sgrub byed dang po 'gog byed du gsungs 'dug pa 'di dag gi rtags gsal khyab pa gsum po gang la yang dge ldan pas lan don dang mthun pa mi thob ste/ rigs pa snga ma'i rtags ni rang gis khas blangs/ 'dod na ni yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor gtan nas med pa zhig khas len dgos byung / rigs pa gnyis pa yang shin tu bzang ba'i gnod byed yin te/ ji ltar zhe na/ dge ldan pa rang gi rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas yod par ma bshad pa dang / med par bshad pa gnyis don mi gcig pa'i phyir zhes rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa nas yod par ma bshad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi yum yod pa zhig khas blangs byung ba de la/ 'o na de 'dra'i 'jigs byed kyi yum de rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas ma bstan par thal/ de rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas yod par ma bshad pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs/ 'dod na/ de rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas bstan par thal/ de rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i bstan don yin pa'i phyir dang / de dag gi brjod bya yin pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs ma grub na/ der thal/ de rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor pa'i lha yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa grub ste/ rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas ma bstan pa'i 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'dra yod na yi dam gyi lha yin dgos pa las/ de 'dra de yi dam gyi lha ma yin pa'i phyir/ gal te de yi dam gyi lha yin zer na/ de 'dra'i yi dam bsgoms pa'i byin rlabs las byung ba'i rnam dpyod kyi spobs pa ni chos rje ri bo dge ldan pa'i rnam dpyod du 'dug pas shin tu ngo mtshar che'o/

/yang rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun las/ dge ldan pa'i sgrub byed gnyis pa'i gnyen por 'di ltar gsungs te/ gnyis pa dgra nag la brten nas yum yod par 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ rtog gsum dang dgra nag gi rgyud la brten nas/ gtso bo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mdzad pa la/ dgra nag nas bshad pa'i 'khor bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma bsgrub cing / de ltar na 'khor gyi lha bcu gnyis po de dag gtso bo yab yum gyi mngal nas 'byin pa shin tu 'grub ste/ zhes sogs kyi gtan tshigs rnams kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed la dngos yum yod par bsgrub pa ni bzhad gad kyi gnas te/ zhes sogs dang / des na dgra nag gi bskyed chog gi rigs pa 'dir sbyar ba ni/ btsas ma la bu yod pa'i rigs pa mo gsham la sbyar ba dang khyad par ci yod/ ces sogs gsungs pa yang thugs shin tu mad par snang ste/ dgra nag gi 'khor bcu gnyis po gtso bo 'jigs byed la sbyar bas lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor rang 'thad ldan min pa'i rgyu mtshan gong du bkod nas/ de mi 'thad phyin de shes byed du byas nas 'jigs byed la yum yod par bsgrub pa ni/ khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos dang / dgra nag gi 'khor 'jigs byed la sbyar zhing / dgra nag gi mngal 'byin gyi bskyed chog 'jigs byed la sbyar ba ni mo gsham la bu yod par thal/ btsas ma la bu yod pa'i phyir zhes par song 'dug pas so/ /yang yum sgrub byed gsum pa la gnod byed ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gi zin bris las/ gsum pa kyai rdo rje la brten nas yum yod par 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ brtag gnyis kyi nye rgyu'i spyod pa ston byed kyi lung drangs nas/ 'jigs byed la dngos su sbyar ba'i yum yod par bsgrub pa yang thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa yin te/ 'di gnyis la 'brel ci yang med pa'i phyir/

zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa yang lan gyis ldog par mi nus pa'i rigs yin no/ /de yang ji ltar zhe na/ dge ldan pa'i 'dod pa de la 'brel gtan nas ma byung ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag gnyis las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshig bcad gcig gi dogs pa bkod nas/ de'i lan du/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /zhes pa nas/ dga' chen he ru ka yi gzugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ni nye rgyu'i spyod pas 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul ston byed yin par mnga' bdag me tri pas gsungs pa ma gzigs par/ rgyud tshig 'di dag mthong ba tsam rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas gang gi skabs yin ma phyed par gya tshom du smras 'dug pas so/ /gzhan yang chos rje ri bo dge ldan pas bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i tshe mo rtags bsgyur nas pho rtags dang ldan par bsgom dgos zhes bzhed pa la/ rje btsun e waṃ pas/ 'o na de'i tshe rnal 'byor pa de bdag med ma bsgom pa yin nam ma yin/ dang po ltar na de lta bu'i pho rtags can gyi bdag med ma gang nas bshad smros shig gnyis pa ltar na mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rten du bdag med ma'i bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dus mi srid par 'gyur te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bdag med mas mdzad pa las mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i dus su ni/ lha mo'i rtags rnams bsgyur nas pho rtags dang ldan pa nges par bsgom dgos shing / de lta bu pho rtags can gyi lha de ni bdag med ma ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa yang rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog tu mtshon byed yin pa dpyod ldan gyi skyes bu yod na dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /yang jo gdan mkhan chen nam lhun pas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma 'di 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'bum pa na bzhugs yod pa/ la li ta sogs bla ma rim pa bzhin brgyud nas bha ros rwa chen la gnang ba la brten/

rwa chen gyis lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs yid bzhin gter mdzod mdzad pa yin gsungs pa yang 'thad par ma mthong ste/ rgyud 'bum pa na yod pa'i shes byed tshad thub 'god rgyu mi 'dug pa'i phyir dang / rgyud 'bum pa nas bshad pa yod du zin kyang / grub chen la li tas u rgyan du byon pa'i rtog bdun dang / skyo pa'i lugs la rtog gsum yang spyan drangs pa tsam ma gtogs/ de las gzhan spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus tshad ma gtan nas mi snang bas so/ /der ma zad mkhan nam mkha' lhun bzang gi bzhed pa de ni rwa chen gyi dgongs pa dang yang mi mthun te/ bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di 'jigs byed rang gi rgyud dang sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung gcig na yongs su rdzogs pa mi bzhugs pa'am yongs su rdzogs par ma bshad kyang / rgyud gzhan dang sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung nas kyang kha bskangs te/ mdor na 'thor ba bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bkod pa yin par rwa chen rang gis bshad la/ jo gdan ni rgyud 'bum pa na yongs su rdzogs pa bzhugs pa de grub chen la li ta sogs rim pas brgyud rwa chen la bka' babs la brten bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs slar mdzad par bzhed pa'i phyir/ 'thor ba bsdus nas bkod pa rwa chen bzhed de/ sgrub thabs yid bzhin gter mdzod las/ don bsdus rgyud 'di gsal bar byed pa'i yang gsal 'di/ /bdag dang phyi ma'i phyi la yang phyi ma sogs don du 'gyur snyam nas/ /'jigs mdzad bla mar bcas la gsol ba yang yang btab byas nas/ /rgyud dang sgrub thabs gcig na rdzogs min 'thor ba bsdus nas bkod/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /des na 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma 'thad pa'i sgrub byed bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsungs pa 'di nyid rwa chen gyi dgongs pa yin par snang ste/ de yang mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang chog dri ba'i rang lan las/

mngon rtogs yid bzhin gter mdzod 'di'i rten gzhi ni/ rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang / la li ta sogs kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs snga ma rnams dang / der ma thus pa'i kha 'gong dgos pa rnams dgra nag gi rgyud dang / dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rnams la brten pa yin te/ de yang rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / mgo bo la sogs pa'i gtso bo'i phyag mtshan so gnyis bkod pa rnams ni rtog bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rtog pa dang / 'jigs byed rang gi sgrub thabs rgya gzhung gi gzhal yas khang rnams bskyed pa'i skabs la brten/ rgyu'i 'jam dpal dang / 'bras bu'i 'jigs byed bskyed tshul ni/ rtog bdun gyi bsgom pa'i skabs dang / sgrub thabs rgya gzhung gi rgyu 'bras kyi lha bskyed pa'i skabs rnams la brten/ gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i 'khor lha bcu gnyis ni dgra nag gi rgyud dang / dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs la rten/ yum ni dgra nag gi yum de 'dir ma sbyar bas dgra nag la rten pa ma yin zhing / gang la rten na sngar bshad pa ltar/ mnyam nyid rnam rgyal gyi rgyud la rten gzhi byas la legs so/ /zhes gang la brten pa'i gzhi ngos bzung nas/ de dag la brten pa'i rgyu mtshan ston pa la/ de rjes de ma thag par de dag gi rgyu mtshan ni gzhal yas khang bskyed cing der phyag mtshan 'god tshul rnams rtogs pa dang po sgrub thabs na dngos su gsal ba dang / rgyu 'bras kyi lha bskyed pa yang bsgom pa'i rtog pa na dngos su gsal zhing sgrub thabs rnams su yang de bzhin 'byung bas rtog bdun dang rgya gzhung gi sgrub thabs rnams la brten pa'i shes byed de ltar yin la/ de bzhin du 'khor gyi lha dgra nag la brten pa ni/ rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyis kyang gsal bar bya/ /zhes mkhas pa la grags pa ltar 'jigs byed rang du rigs gzhan bzhi dang khro bo bzhi rnams dngos su ma bshad pa'i ma tshang ba de dgra nag nas kha bskangs pas rigs lnga sogs gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs su 'gyur zhing /

yum gyi mkha' nang du 'khor bskyed pa sogs bskyed chog gi chings dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi sgrub thabs nas kha bskangs te ma tshang ba rnams 'thor ba bsdus nas bkod pa yin pas rwa chen gyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs gcig na/ rdzogs min 'thor ba bsdus nas bkod/ /ces gsungs pa'i dgongs don rma med pa de 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de dag dang rwa chen gyi bzhed pa mthun pas so/ /de ltar na dge ldan pa 'dod pa'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma ni su dang yang mi mthun pas mi 'thad pa'i gnas kho na yin la/ rwa chen bzhed pa'i bcu gsum ma 'di ni 'thad ldan yin min rtsod pa can du gsungs pa yin te/ rwa chen gyi bzhed pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa ltar las 'os med kyang / rwa chen rang nyid kyi bla ma bha ro'i man ngag yin gsung rgyur snang bas/ man ngag yin kyang rgyud kyi dngos bstan la med na'ang don thob kyis rgyud dang mthun pa zhig dgos te/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ lag len thams cad sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung dang mthun na bstan pa yin/ /zhes dang / snyan brgyud dang ni chig brgyud du/ /grags pa'i chos lugs mang du yod/ /rgyud dang mthun pa blang du rung / /min na rdzun gyi sdebs phyogs yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rgya gzhung na bcu gsum ma'i tha snyad gsal ba zhig ma byung bas dag dug bsdus pa'i gos la ni/ /chen po rnams kyi chas mi rung / /de bzhin thun tshegs bsdus pa yi/ /chos kyis dad can 'tshang mi rgya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsra bsre byas pa'i chos su gyur dogs nas rje rdo rje 'chang gis rtsod pa can du gsungs pa yin no/ /yang 'jigs byed la yum yod med la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ mnyam nyid rnam rgyal gyi rgyud las/ khyab 'jug phyir ma he yi zhal/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pa dang / /rang gi 'khor lo'i dbus bzhugs te/

/lha mo rdo rje bde ba ma/ /gnyis su med par gnas pa'o/ /de nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dren par mdzad nas rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yod par bzhed de/ rdo rje 'chang gis lha 'di la mtshan ma bsgrengs pa 'byung ba'i gnad kyis gnas skabs kun tu dngos yum med pa yin gsungs pa 'di shes byed bcar rgyag ma shin tu bzang ba zhig 'dug kyang / kho bo cag rwa pa'i rjes 'brang du khas 'che ba dag gis khas len mi nus la/ zhes gsungs nas ngor chen gyi bzhed pa de zhal gyis mi bzhes pa lta bu mdzad cing / 'di'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan la yum ma gsungs pa rnams dpa' bo gcig pa la dgongs pa yin zhes gsungs/ de la rang gi rtog pa'i 'char lugs tsam brjod na/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis lha 'di la gnas skabs thams cad du yum med par bzhed pa ma yin snyam ste/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun gcig las/ de la skabs 'ga' zhig tu yum bsgom pa yod na yang / gnas skabs thams cad du yum sbyor dgos pa'i nges pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas 'di rang gi gsang dbang bskur ba'i tshe slob dpon 'jigs byed du bskyed de yum dang snyoms 'jug byas pa'i mkha' nang nas dbang rdzas sbyin dgos pas/ de lta bu'i gnas skabs su yum yod dgos pa dang / yang lha'i rnal 'byor bskyed rim gyi gnas skabs su yum med pa nyid mtha' gcig tu bzhed pa yin te/ de'i dgongs bzhed kyang rtog bdun gyi lha'i rnal 'byor ston pa'i skabs su gcer bu'i gzugs mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs pa zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid rnam par bsgom na zhes pa'i bar dang / yang de'i bris sku'i rtog pa las/ shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa bri bar bya ste/ ri mo mkhan dang sgrub pa pos mthong ba las/ 'jig rten gzhan gyis mi mthong ba bri bar bya ste/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/

zhal dgu pa/ gcer bu kha dog nag po/ g.yas bskums pa/ g.yon brkyangs pa/ 'jigs pa chen po yang 'jigs par mdzad pa'i rnam pa can/ mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs pa'i thad ka bri bar bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa rnams dang / 'di nyid rgya gzhung tshad ldan kun las mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs zhes gsungs pas na/ yum yod na mtshan ma yum gyi padmar nub nas gyen du bsgrengs pa phyi rol tu mi mngon pas mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs pa zhes gsungs pa la rnam dpyod ma byung bas/ des na bskyed rim bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su yum med pa nyid zhal gyis bzhes/ de'i gnad kyis bris sku rnams la yang yum med pa kho na 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes bzhed rgyu yin nam snyam mo/ /bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs bzhed ni/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i gtso bo'i yum 'di dgra nag gi yum ma yin gyi/ mnyam nyid rnam rgyal las/ 'jigs byed la yum zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gcig bshad pa de/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i tshe sbyar ba 'di yin pas bcu gsum pa lta bu 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom pa la yum yod pa nyid zhal gyis bzhes pa yin par snang la/ mdor bsdu na 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di 'thad na/ 'jigs byed la yum yod pa dang / 'di 'thad ldan min na 'jigs byed la yum yod pa yang mi 'thad pa gzhir bcas yin nam snyam ste/ bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs 'di ma gtogs gzhan zhe dgu ma dang / bcu bdun ma dang / ro langs brgyad bskor sogs tshad thub kyi dkyil 'khor gang gis kyang rgya gzhung las bshad pa med pa'i gnad kyis so/ /da dung dpyod ldan rnams kyis legs par dpyod cig de dag ni cung zad 'phros pa'o/ /gzhan yang dge ldan pa 'dod pa'i bcu gsum ma 'di dang / rwa lugs kyi bcu gsum ma gnyis gtso bo'i zhal 'gyed lugs sogs mi mthun pa'i tshul rnams paṇa chen gung ri'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul ltar bshad na/

rwa lugs la brtsegs zhal dang / dge lugs la 'khor zhal du 'dod la/ rwa lugs la glang lpags phyag tha ma gnyis kyis 'dzin pa dang / g.yon bcu bzhi pa sdigs mdzub mdzad par bshad cing / dge lugs la phyag dang po gnyis kyis glang lpags 'dzin pa dang / g.yon bcu bzhi pas sdigs mdzub kyi lag mgo gcig 'dzin par 'dod pas phyag mtshan 'dzin tshul yang mi mthun la/ yang ras bris kyi le tshe dgu la shar du mgo bo sogs phyag mtshan rnams ling tshe nang gi lha so so'i gdan khri la bri bar bshad pa la/ dge lugs pas de rnams bcad nas ma bris/ 'bri tshul kyang mi mthun/ rwa lugs pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i tshe ro langs kyi lha phyag mtshan rnams rdza'i thod pa bkab nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i tshe de bsal ba sogs kyi rnam gzhag mdzad la/ dge lugs pas de mi byed pas rdul tshon 'bri tshul mi mthun zhing / rwa lugs la rtog gsum nas bshad pa'i 'khrul 'khor kho na ma yin pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhig bzhed la/ dge lugs pas rtog gsum gyi dngos bstan kho na 'thad ldan du 'dod pas 'khrul 'khor 'bri tshul mi mthun/ rwa lugs la bzlas pa byed pa'i tshe dngos yum med pa'i rang 'dra'i 'jigs byed mdun du bsgoms nas bdag mdun gnyis kyi zhal las sngags phreng 'khor ba'i bar du dgra bgegs btsir ba'i dmigs pa mdzad cing / dge lugs pa dngos yum nges par yod pa'i bzlas tshul byed pas bzlas pa byed tshul mi mthun/ yang rwa lugs pa slob dbang bskur ba'i tshe rang 'od kyi yum zhig bzhed/ dge lugs la rnam pa thams cad du dngos yum 'dod pas yum 'dod tshul yang mi mthun zhes gung rus bshad do/ /de dag gis ni bod yul du gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor gyi dgongs 'grel dang lam srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa dmar po'i skor ni/ gong du bkod pa ltar 'phags yul du lugs 'di la lam srol gsum tsam zhig byung ba las/
