lam srol de nyid bod du nam byon zhing / de ltar byon pa'i lam srol de la rnam grangs ji ltar yod ce na/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i skor 'di rnams rjes btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku tshe stod yan la ni ma byon la phyis rjes btsun rin po che'i sku tshe'i smad bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi sku tshe'i stod tsam la dpyal lo chos bzang gis paṇḍi ta ni ka lang ka de wa zhes bya ba la gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ birwa pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'khrul 'khor chung ba dang / blo zab snying po'i bskyed rim kyi gzhung gi gsham du rdzas sbyor 'khrul 'khor/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong la lha dbang du sdud byed/ me tog dmar po la brten pa'i sbyin sreg sogs ston pa bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa zhes pa yod pa de dang / 'dis byas med pa'i maṇḍal mchod chog gi gzhung bzang po gcig dang / byang chub bzang po'i snying pos mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor bri ba'i gzhung dus 'khor dang mthun par bshad pa'i las tshogs rnams bsgyur te de'i srol dang por dod pa yin la/ lo tsā ba 'di nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' 'di rgyal po'i gnod 'tshe'i rigs sogs la byin rlabs che bar grags/ de'i rjes su chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal du grags pa des/ bal mo ra went+ra bha dra zhes bya ba la gshed dmar lha lnga ma dang / lha bcu gsum ma gnyis char gyi dbang zhus/ sngar dpyal los bsgyur ba rnams la 'gyur bcos mdzad/ sngar ma 'gyur ba'i birwa pa'i gtor chog dang / blo zab snying po'i gzhung rnams dang / grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi lha bcu gsum ma'i gzhung bcu gsum po dang / mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyi gzhung zur du bkol te bsgyur nas chag lugs su grags/ 'di nyid 'gyur legs shing / lo chen 'di gshed dmar la mkhas par yang bshad cing / 'di skor la lo tsā ba gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha yang mang du yod pa yin no/

/de nas yang paṇḍi ta na da shī la la g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang pos gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ lha lnga'i bir gzhung la paṇḍi tas rang bsgyur mdzad de gnang / 'khrul 'khor phreng ba'i gzhung rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa la brten nas mdzad pa yang bsgyur/ gzhan yang lugs 'di la 'khrul 'khor phreng ba'i gsal byed dang / bcu gsum ma gtso bor byas pa'i dbang chog rdo rje phreng ba zhes pa gnyis la rang 'gyur byas pa sogs yig cha du ma yod cing / lugs 'di brgyud thag nye zhing byin rlabs che bar grags te/ 'di grub chen birwa pa nas shar phyogs nag po pa la brgyud pa'i srol de yin par bshad do/ /yang de'i rjes su glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis paṇḍi ta chen po dar paṇa a tsarya la gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang / lo paṇa gzhan la ma grags pa'i rdzogs rim shin tu spros med kyi gdams pa zab mo yang gsan nas dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung bcu gsum po phal cher bsgyur/ spros med rdo rje'i tshig skang sogs gzhan yang rgya gzhung du ma bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ lo tsā ba 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i spros med kyi khrid yig dang / byin rlabs la sogs pa yig cha mang du yod cing / lugs 'di khungs btsun zhing khyad par du 'phags par gsungs so/ /de'i phyi nas gshong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas paṇḍi ta bi ma la shrī la lha lnga'i dbang gsan nas/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa yang bsgyur te/ mdor na bod yul 'dir gshed dmar gyi lam srol cha tshang ba lnga byon pa yin la/ de dag la smin byed dbang gi lugs la dpyal lo/ chag lo/ dha na shi la gsum gyi lugs 'di gtso bor mdzad/ grol byed lam ni bshad ma thag pa'i lugs lnga char la smin grol cha tshang ba re yod mod/ 'on kyang shin tu spros pa med pa'i man ngag gi khrid zab mo ni glo bo lo tsā ba la paṇḍi ta darpan a tsaryas legs par stsal pa 'di ma gtogs lugs gzhan rnams la yod par ma bshad pa yin pas/

'di la yang smin grol gnyis las/ smin byed dbang gi rtsa ba'i gzhung ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa 'di yin la/ de dang der cung zad mi gsal ba rnams grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog la brten nas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis lha lnga'i dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun mdzad/ de la lhan thabs rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa zhig dang / bya btang chos rjes mdzad pa zhig dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i zur 'debs sogs gzhan yang du ma yod do/ /grol byed bskyed rim la gtso bor rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs che chung gnyis la brten nas rje rdo rje 'chang gi lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi bum pa lung sbyor dang bcas pa mdzad cing / gzhan yang phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mang du yod pa rnams la brten nas nyams len dang 'chad nyan sogs kyi rgyun da lta ma nyams par bzhugs/ yang rdzogs rim la rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang sogs gsum dang / de dag gi gsal byed glo bo lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i khrid yig la brten nas rje btsun kun dga' bzang pos spros med mdzes rgyan mdzad/ gzhan yang rdzogs rim zab mo 'di ston byed la/ theg chen rin po che kun dga' bkra shis kyis rdo rje tshig rkang gi rnam bshad dang / spros med kyi khrid yig sogs yig cha mang du mdzad/ de'i rjes su sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa dang / 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis dang / rje mkhyen brtse ba sogs kyis kyang khrid yig mdzad la/ yang mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po mang du thos pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i spros med kyi khog phub dang / khrid yig sogs shin tu gsal zhing legs pa'i yig cha mang du yod do/ /de rnams kyis gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams bod yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang /

'phags yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gnyis sogs kyi sgo nas de dag gi dgongs 'grel dang lam srol mi 'dra ba ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bstan zin to/ /gsum pa de dag gi bla ma gong ma rnams rim par brgyud de rgya bod du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ 'phags yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang / bod yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la yang nag po'i skor ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang / dmar po'i skor ji ltar dar ba'i gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'o na de lta bu'i gshin rje gshed kyi lam srol de dag rgya bod du dar tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ bshad par bya ste/ de yang 'di'i srol 'byed kyi gtso bo ni grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po la li ta badzra ste/ bod skad du rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba de nyid de/ 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ grub chen 'di 'khrungs pa'i yul ni rgya gar lho phyogs yin la/ de yang yab nor sbyin grags dang / yum bram ze mo sgrol ma mtsho gnyis kyi sras su 'khrung te/ yab yum de gnyis la ming sring lnga yod pa'i grub chen 'di bar pa yin zhing / yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i dus su yum gyi rmi lam du/ nyi ma sna bug g.yas nas zhugs g.yon nas thon nas nam mkha'i ngos la shar nas 'jig rten gyi khams gsal bar byas pa rmis/ 'khrungs nas lo kha yar nas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod 'don pa dang / gshin rje'i sngags hriḥṣṭi sogs 'dren pa yum gyis thos nas yab la smras pas/ gang yin shes dka' bas su la yang mi smra ba gsang na legs/ 'on kyang 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa zhig yin thag chod/ nged rang gnyis dkon mchog mchod pa dang / sbyin pa mang po btang ba'i 'bras bu yin pas bstan pa la phan pa yong srid/ ma gsang na mu stegs ngan pas rdzas ngan gyi sbyor ba byed dogs pas/ gang yin shan ma phyed kyi bar du gsang zer/ de nas zla ba tshang ba na khye'u blta na sdug pa zhig byung /

mtshan mkhan la bstan pas/ skyes bu mtshan dang ldan pa gcig yin thag chod 'dug 'on kyang phyi pa byas na legs zer yab yum gnyis kyis lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ bram ze na re/ mtshan brjod 'don na nang pa yin srid/ sngags 'di 'dra phyi pa la'ang yod/ gang ltar btsas ston chen po gyis shig kho bos ming 'dogs zer/ yab yum la gtogs pa'i rgyal po gnyen tshogs rnams bsdus nas ston mo rgya cher mdzad/ de nas bram zes 'di'i pha la nor sbyin grags/ ma la sgrol ma mtsho zer bas/ 'di la ming nor sgrol mtsho thogs zer/ mi gzhan gyis 'di mngal na gnas pa'i tshe yab yum gnyis la nor mang po dang 'bru mang po 'phel bas nor 'phel thogs zer/ de nas zla ba gsum tsam nas a l̥ ka l̥ dang mtshan brjod kyi tshig 'ga' re ngag nas 'don pa byung / lo gnyis nas ma bzung bar mtshan brjod tshang bar ston pa dang / yab kyis 'di su la bslabs dris pas/ skye ba mang po nas shes zer/ yab kyis he he ngo mtshar che zer nas mnyes/ de nas lo bcu lon pa na yab la/ da nga mtshan brjod shes pa'i bla ma gcig la rab tu byung na dga' ba la zhus pas yab kyi zhal nas paṇḍi ta mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mtshan brjod shes pas/ de la rab byung zhus la legs zer/ yum gyis da dung na so gzhon pas ci drag zer ba la/ yab kyis the tshom med par phul na legs gsungs nas rdo rje gdan pa la rab byung dang / sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin nges/ rmi lam kyang bzang ba cig byung gsungs nas rab tu byung ba'i ming dge ba dpal du thogs gsungs/ des smras tshad snyan ngag la mkhas pa zhig byung bas kun gyis paṇḍi ta bde ba dpal zhes thogs zer/ de nas rdo rje gdan la bskor ba byed kyi yod tsa na/ dge tshul shin tu mdzes pa cig gis mtshan brjod 'don cing 'dug pas/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /zhes pa nas/

yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang / /zhes pa'i bar dang / gnyis su med dang gnyis med ston/ /yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed nas/ thams cad thams cad khyed la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bar mnyan pas thugs rgyud la rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ dge tshul de la khyod kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed ces pa de shes sam gsungs pas/ ngas mi shes zer/ de ma thag bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i drung du phyin nas lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ngas rdo rje 'jigs byed ces pa'i chos thos ma myong / rdo rje gdan na yang de 'dra thos pa su yang med dam gsungs/ der paṇḍi ta mkhas pa rnams la dris pas/ la la de 'dra'i chos med dam zer/ la las de 'dra'i chos yod srid de sngar ma tshor zer/ la las nub phyogs u rgyan na bzhugs thag chod/ sngon chad de 'dra dbus na ma 'gyur zer/ dur khrod na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la dris pas/ gcig na re/ nub phyogs u rgyan na bzhugs thag chod/ de snga dbus su de 'dra'i chos mthong thos gang yang med zer bas/ slar log nas bla ma la bdag u rgyan du chos 'tshol du 'gro gsungs pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas u rgyan na bzhugs thag chod do/ /der sa thob pa min pas bgrod mi nus/ chu dang gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa chen po yod/ phyin na yang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gtad byed cing / der ma zad brda dang brda'i lan ma shes na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis kyang grogs mi byed pas mi legs gsungs/ cis kyang 'gro zhus pas/ 'o na do nub ngas lha la brtags pa bya yi gsungs/ bla mas yi dam sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ tho rangs ka bud med sngon mo zhig byung nas/ de na re/ grong khyer gyi mtha' pha gi na bud med rgan mo gcig yod/ de la dris/ 'on kyang de la gtad cher mi yong gsungs pa zhig byung ba na/ der bla mas bu zab chos 'di 'dra gdan drang ba dka'/

'on kyang thabs la mkhas pa gyis la song gsungs pas/ paṇḍi tas chos gos gsum dang ldan par byas/ lus la sindha ra'i thig le byas nas song pas/ bla ma'i lung bstan ltar grong khyer na rgan mo zhig 'dug pa dang 'phrad nas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams dris pas/ de na re/ ngas ni de 'dra'i chos mi shes/ u rgyan na bzhugs pas lon dka'/ khyod kyi cha lugs de phyi nyan thos/ nang gsang sngags/ mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag gis thig le byas nas gda'/ de 'dra ma byed gtad yong zer/ khyod kyi kha la ci med/ nga 'dra ba'i paṇḍi tas spyan 'drongs thag chod gsungs nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyin pa/ u rgyan gyi shar phyogs grong khyer gyi mtha' na phar slebs pas/ 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro rnams dang 'phrad nas/ de rnams na re/ cha lugs 'di la 'di 'dra'i rgyan 'dogs ci zer nas mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis sdigs mdzub bstan byung bas cung zad zhig brgyal/ de nas yang sngar gyi rgan mo de byung nas/ ngas bslabs pa la ni mi nyan/ 'di 'dra 'ongs nyen yod ka smras pa zer nas/ sa zhig blangs nas sngags btab ste mgo la gtor byung nas brgyal ba sangs/ de nas de na re/ da khyod kyi rgyan 'di phyis 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la brda 'di ston/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la 'di gyis gsungs nas brda re gnang / de nas u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du phyin pas mkha' 'gro ma 'ga' re dang mjal ba la/ phyag btsal gser bag tsam yod pa phul nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ mkha' 'gro ma la las mig btsum/ la las rna ba dgag la las mgo bo bsgril/ la las lag pa g.yugs te sngon chad de 'dra'i chos thos ma myong zer zhing 'jigs pa'i rnam pa ston pa'i tshe/ yud tsam nas sngar gyi rgan mo de byung ba la mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa 'bul/ bskor ba byed cing gsol ba 'debs kyis/

mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ lus ngag yid gsum mi dge'i las rnams kyi/ /nga rgyal dregs pa log lta'i dbang song bas/ /rang gzhan 'gyod pa'i sems kyi mthol bshags na/ /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos sbyin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / la las gar byed/ la las mchod pa dang rdo rje'i glu len/ bro 'khrab/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis las can gyi skyes bu ngo mtshar che'o zer ba na/ paṇḍi ta yid dga' ste lus kyis phyag 'tshal/ ngag gi yig brgya bgrangs/ yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ nged rnams dang khyod las 'brel yod/ khyad par ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ro langs ma 'dis khyed skye ba mang por rjes su bzung ba yin/ 'on kyang khyod kyis bka' bcag pa'i nyes pa chen po byung 'dug pas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po shoms bshags pa gyis/ yi ge brgya pa bgrongs/ bya'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad la u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas rgyud thams cad dga' ba'i tshal gyi rdo 'di'i steng du gdan 'dren tshes bco lnga'i bar la tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po bshams nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mchod pa byed pa yin/ de dus khyed kyi blo la gang zin pa de khyed rang dbang ba yin zer ba na/ der paṇḍi ta'i thugs la zhag bdun la blo la cher mi zin dgongs tsa na/ mkha' 'gro gcig na re/ skal ldan las can gsol ba thob cig zer nas song / de'i tshe chos gos rgyud rnams kyi gdan du bting nas gsol ba btab pas/ mkha' 'gro gcig byung nas zhag gcig song zer/ de bzhin zhag re la mkha' 'gro ma re re byung nas blo la ci zin zer zhing song ba na/ blo la ni gcig kyang ma zin ci drag dgongs tsa na/ zhag bdun gyi tho rangs kyi cha la 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis zhal dngos su bstan nas/ khyod kyi ngo skal gyi rgyud de yin gsungs nas/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'bum pa nas rtog pa bdun pa dang /

'khrul 'khor gyi rtog pa gsum pa/ dgra gdong gnyis kyi rgyud dang bcas pa so sor phye nas gnang byung ba la bltas pas thams cad blo la zin 'dug de nas rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ de dag tu ma tshang ba'i dbang dang gdams ngag rnams mkha' 'gro ma rnams la zhus/ skal ldan gyi 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa yong gsungs nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin song / de nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ro langs mas dbang bskur/ gdams ngag las tshogs cha lag dang bcas pa gnang nas/ mkha' 'gro ma kun gyis u rgyan mkha' 'gro gling nas paṇḍi ta la skyel ma mdzad de/ de'i tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas rdo rje'i glu tshig du ma dang / khyod rgyud man ngag 'di rnams khyer la song / lam du bdud dang mu stegs dam nyams kyi lag tu ma shor ba gyis la/ rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs thod pa can gyi dur khrod du rtse gcig tu sgrub pa gyis/ las kyi rdo rje'i mtha' can gcig gi gtso byas skal ldan 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs yong / mthar 'ja' lus chos sku thob nas nga dang 'bral med du dag pa mkha' spyod du 'gro gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur/ de dus dbang bskur ba'i gsang mtshan la li ta badzra/ bod skad du rol pa'i rdo rje zhes btags/ de nas slob dpon gyis myur du byon pas nyin zhag mang po'i bar du lam la 'jigs pa sogs gtan nas ma byung / de nas rim bzhin byon pa'i lam bar na mtsho chen po zhig gi 'gram na chu glang sngon po 'jigs su rung ba zhig gis 'jigs pa'i tshul ston pa byung bas thugs shin tu skrag pa zhig byung nas mkha' 'gro la gsol ba btab pas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ro langs ma dngos su byon nas/ ma 'jigs ma 'jigs skal ldan khyod/ /'jigs mi dgos pa'i las lha yin/ /tshe rabs kun gyi bsrung ma yin/ /las 'brel yod pas gsol ba thob/ /mchod bstod gtor ma'i las la brtson/ /'jigs pa med pa'i gnas na sleb/

/ces gsungs nas mkha' 'gro rang gnas su gshegs/ chu glang gi gnod pa zhi nas 'dud pa'i rnam pa byas byung pa na/ de ma thag nam mkha' las sgra gcig byung / brtags pas rgyab tu bzhon zer bar go nas rgyud kyi po ti khur/ bzhon pa tsam gyis thod pa can gyi dur khrod du byon/ byang phyogs phar bltas pas rdo rje gdan mthong shin tu dga' ba zhig byung nas thal mo sbyar phyag 'tshal nas bla ma la gsol ba mang du btab pas byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags mang du byung / der thugs dgongs la sgrub pa bya dgongs nas mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i dur khrod 'dir sgrub pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du gnas gzhan du 'phos na chos skyong gis mgo bo khos zhes dam bcas so/ /de ma thag sngar gyi chu glang de las kyi gshin rje nag po chu glang gi gdong pa can rus pas brgyan pa/ thod dbyug dang zhags pa 'dzin pa gcig tu gyur nas/ khyod kyi rgyud dang man ngag rnams kyi bdag po nga yin/ khyod kyi 'phrin las ngas byed pa yin zer nas dur khrod du song / de nas slob dpon gyis dur khrod kyi gnas su ro zos/ ro gos gyon nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas lus ngag yid gsum la nyams rtogs ci rigs pa byung / de nas re zhig na sngar gyi chu glang gi gdong can des bram ze'i khye'u kha na ma tho bas shi ba'i ro gcig khyer byung nas/ 'di la the tshom ma byed par tshogs chas gyis la zo dang phung po lhag med du mkha' spyod du 'gro/ khyod dang nga gnyis skye ba thams cad 'bral med du gnas pa yin zer nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas slob dpon gyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i chas rnams bsags nas longs spyad pas skye ba mang po dran pa dang / shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa la mkhyen pa thogs pa med pa 'khrungs/ de nas mthar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas spyan drangs nas phung po lhag med du mkha' spyod du gshegs par grags/

kha cig dur khrod du gshegs nas sku gdung bzhus pas ring bsrel mang po byon/ thugs la 'jigs byed yongs rdzogs 'khrungs zer/ 'ga' zhig rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa la zhugs nas da lta yang 'gro don mdzad gyin yod kyang zer ro/ /gang ltar slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'dis de lta bu'i dka' ba dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor rnams u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling nas spyan drangs nas/ sngon mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan la/ las kyi rdo rje'i mtha' can gcig la ston gsungs pa de/ a mo gha badzra yin pa mkhyen te 'jigs byed kyi dbang gi las mdzad nas dbang du bsdus te/ 'di'i dbang rgyud man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa gnang nas spel ba yin te/ de yang grub chen a mo gha badzra ni/ bod skad du/ don yod rdo rje ste/ 'di la rdo rje gdan pa che 'bring chung gsum las/ 'di 'bring po yin pa rgya ston gyi bla ma rgya bal gyi lo rgyus las bshad/ 'ga' zhig las chung ba la bshad kyang / 'di ni a mo gha che ba'am bar pa gang rigs la 'thad dam snyam ste/ chung ba ni bod du byon nas skyo ston 'od 'byung dang mjal nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor stsol ba po de nyid yin pas dus cung zad mi 'grig la/ gang ltar grub chen 'di ni 'khrungs yul rgya gar shar phyogs pa bram ze'i rigs yin zhing / rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bla ma ni dze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba yin la/ gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor ni grub thob la li ta la gsan pa yin te/ de yang slob dpon 'di 'khrungs nas lo 'ga' 'das pa na rig byed kyi rtsis bslabs pas mkhas par mkhyen/ de'i dus su skabs shig na rnal 'byor pa zhig byung nas/ khyod 'dir ma sdod/ dze ta ri na dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i grub chen bzhugs pas/ de khyed kyi skye ba mang po'i bla ma yin de'i drung du song la rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyis dang skye ba mang po la phan thogs yong zer ba ltar/

yab yum la zhus nas dze ta rir byon pas/ bla ma'i dgon pa thag ring po nas mthong / de'i mod la bla ma dgra las rnam rgyal yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs du mthong nas rgyang ring po nas phyag 'tshal/ gur gum mdog can tsha zer stong gi 'od/ /mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams gti mug mun sel ba/ /ye shes ral gri glegs bam 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas byon pas bla ma dang mjal dus nor bu'i rigs me shel 'od dang ldan pa gcig phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas rten 'brel bzang / khyod kyi las bsags pa'i lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal yin gsungs nas de'i sgrub skor cha lag dang bcas pa gnang / mtshan brjod kyi bshad lung tho re ba zhig kyang bstsal te/ da khyod rang rdo rje gdan du song 'phrin las dar zhing rgyas pa 'ong gsungs/ 'byon khar bsnyen rdzogs zhus mtshan don yod rdo rjer btags/ las kyi rdo rje yin gsungs/ de nas rdo rje gdan du byon mu stegs ston pa dgu dang rtsod pa mdzad thams cad las rgyal bar gyur te rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por mnga' gsol rdo rje gdan pa zhes grags/ de nas de'i tshe tho rangs kha zhig ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas bzhugs yod pa'i tshe/ lho phyogs thod pa can gyi dur khrod du me 'od chen po 'bar ba'i nang du rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gis ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ gi sgra bsgrags pas srid gsum thams cad 'dar khri li li yong ba gcig gzigs/ dngangs shing dred nas mnal sad pa na/ kye ma chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la srin po ma rung ba'i gzugs can 'di lta bu mthong ba ma legs dgongs nas bla ma mya ngan med pa'i dpal la zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas sems can rang rang gi blo snang la ci yang 'char/ khyod 'jigs mi dgos/ nga la yang de 'dra yong gi yod/ sngon nga'i slob ma yin pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po gcig nub phyogs u rgyan du song ste 'jigs byed kyi rgyud man ngag rnams spyan drangs nas da lta sgrub pa byed kyi yod/

khong gi rnam sprul yin srid/ khong skabs re nga can du yang 'ong gi yod/ khong gi ming la mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis la li ta badzra ste rol pa'i rdo rjer btags gsungs pas/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ba spu g.yo ba la sogs pa dad gus dpag med 'khrungs/ bla ma la mjal du 'gro zhus pas bla mas kyang gnang ste/ bla ma'i zhal nas khong gis sprul ba cir yang ston nus pas su 'gro 'gros dngos su mthong gi med/ khyed 'gro na nga'i nye gnas 'di dang 'grogs nas song la dur khrod der dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i sprul pa du ma yod pas srin po sogs sems can su mthong yang ma dad pa ma byed/ gzhan yang dur khrod de na spyir sgrub pa po mang par yod kyang / khong 'dug sa nga'i nye gnas kyis shes gsungs/ de nas slob dpon 'dis nye gnas dang bsdebs nas lho phyogs kyi dur khrod du song pas/ der grub chen la li ta ga na bzhugs snyam nas phyogs thams cad du bltas pas gzhan su yang mi snang / glang chen po gcig gis dur khrod kyi sha dang rus pa rnams bza' yi 'dug pa mthong ba na/ paṇḍi ta'i thugs dgongs la sems can dud 'gros dur khrod kyi sha dang rus pa rnams bza' ba dgongs nas bag tsam log lta skyes/ nye gnas des phyag 'tshal bstod pa byas nas/ paṇḍi ta la khyed phyag mi 'tshal ba ci yin byas pas/ paṇḍi ta na re/ nga rig pa'i gnas lnga la la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta zhig gis dud 'gro la phyag 'tshal ba mi yong gsungs/ yang nye gnas kyis snang ba thams cad lhar shes par gyis gsungs na dam tshig dang mi 'gal lam zhus pas/ 'o khyed bden gsungs nas phyag btsal bshags pa mang po byas nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pas/ sngar gyi glang de rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs sku mdog sngon po rus pa'i rgyan can gcig tu gyur nas tshogs dpon byas te/ rwa dung zhig nam mkha' la gtad nas bus pas tshogs zhing gi yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin 'thib pa bzhin 'byung ba la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa phul nas/

slar de rnams kyang rnal 'byor pa rang la thim/ de nas rnal 'byor pa des zhal nas/ nga la ye shes mkha' 'gro mas las kyi rdo rje'i ming can gcig la gshin rje gshed kyi dbang rgyud man ngag 'di rnams ston cig bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs 'ong gsungs pa'i lung bstan de khyod yin gsungs nas/ de ma thag slob dpon skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du sprul nas dbang rgyud man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa gnang / paṇḍi ta la khyod 'di rnams khyer la rdo rje gdan du song dang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa dpag med 'byung / khyad par ma ga dha na ye shes kyi ming can zhig yod pa la bstan na/ de bas kyang phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung gsungs/ de nas paṇḍi tas rdo rje gdan du phebs te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad cing / khyad par rdo rje gdan du du ru ka'i dmag byung ba'i dus paṇḍi ta 'dis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgo nas zhi ba/ dbye ba/ rengs pa/ bskrad pa'i las rnams mdzad pas du du ru ka'i dmag rnams la la rengs/ la la bskrad/ la la dbye nas phal cher yul du log ma thub nas phyis 'byung gi bar du rdo rje gdan du ru ka'i dmag ma byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod do/ /slob dpon 'dis rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung ba ni slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa ste/ 'di 'khrungs yul ni ma ga dha'i grong khyer lho phyogs pa/ rigs ni nor bu len pa'i tshong dpon gyi rigs yin pa las/ yab kyi ming la ded dpon brtson 'grus go cha/ yum gyi ming la 'bum sgron ma zhes bya/ lhums su zhugs dus yum gyi rmi lam du gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa gcig spyi bo nas zhugs pa rmis/ 'khrungs dus ngag nas dhiḥdang a ā sogs 'don pa zhig byung bas yab yum gnyis thugs dgyes nas rigs bzang ba gcig yin thag chod pas mtshan mkhan la bstan na legs zer bstan pas/

'di la ded dpon mi 'ong / sngon nas tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags pa yin pas mkhas la grub pa'i paṇḍi ta zhig yong zer/ de nas yab kyang ded dpon byed pa la dga'/ yul mi rnams kyis kyang 'di ded dpon byas na legs zer ba la/ yum gyis nged rang la bu mang du yod pas ded dpon gzhan rnams kyis 'ong / khye'u mtshan ldan 'di rab tu byung ba 'thad zer/ 'di'i yum la ming po phyi rol pa'i sgra tshad la mkhas pa zhig yod pa des/ nga'i drung du bzhag na sgra tshad la mkhas pa zhig 'ong srid de zer ba la/ yab kyis 'di btsas ma thag a dang dhiḥsogs 'dren pa zhig yod pas/ nang pa'i paṇḍi ta rig pa'i 'byung gnas la rab tu zhus na legs zer/ yum gyi re zhig zhang po la sgra tshad bslab/ slar paṇḍi ta'i drung du rab byung zhus na mi legs sam gsungs pas/ yab paṇḍi ta la zhus na 'thad zer nas zhus pas/ paṇḍi ta'i zhal nas/ de ka legs phyi rol pa'i sgra tshad la mkhas pa nang pa'i bstan pa la zhugs pa mang po yong / 'on kyang 'di ni nang pa'i bstan pa la shin tu phan thogs che ba zhig yong gsungs/ de nas paṇḍi ta gsungs pa ltar re zhig zhang po'i thad du sgra tshad bslabs pas phul du phyin pa mkhyen nas phyi rol pa'i sgra tshad mkhas pa rnams dang brtsad pas thams cad las rgyal te sus kyang 'gran zla ma byung nas phyi pa la nga bas mkhas pa med/ da nang pa'i paṇḍi ta mang po dang brtsad nas mkhas grags thon pa gcig bya dgongs nas/ paṇḍi ta mkhas pa mang po dang brtsad pas nang pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi sgra tshad la 'gran gtan nas ma bzod/ de nas sngar chad yod pa ltar paṇḍi ta rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi drung du phyin te rig pa'i gnas lnga char la sbyangs/ de'i tshe shing gi ri na sngon sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten gcig yod pa de'i drung na rgan mo rgas gog nyam chung ba gcig 'dug pa de la snying rje'i bsam pa gang yang ma byung bar/

nga rgyal gyi rnam pas sgra tshad kyi tshig brjod cing bskor ba byas pas/ re zhig nas rgan mo des lto zhig slongs zer ba la/ khong gis nga la ster long mi 'dug rig pa'i gnas la sbyong dgos pa 'dug gsungs pas/ de ma thag rgan mo de lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can gcig tu gyur nas/ de na re/ snying rjes rgyud ma sbyangs pa'i sgra tshad dang / /nga rgyal dregs pas khengs pa'i tshig gis ni/ /rang gzhan rgyud dkrugs ngan song rgyu yin pas/ /de 'dra'i tshig bor snying rjes rgyud sbyongs shig /rtog ge ngan pas nga rgyal khong khro yi/ /sgra gcan gdong gi bsil zer 'od sgrib ltar/ /de phyir mi rtag lus 'di myur 'jig pas/ /nus ldan bla ma dam pa myur du snyogs/ /zhes pa dang / lar rtog ge'i chos kyis myur du sangs rgyas mi thob/ sgra tshad bslab long mi 'dug myur du sangs rgya ba la rdo rje theg pa la slob dgos zer nas mkha' la gshegs song bas/ paṇḍi ta 'jigs shing ya mtshan pa cig byung nas/ bla ma la zhus pas/ bla mas zhal nas de ngas kyang shes te/ khyod nga rgyal ba zhig 'dug pas ngas ma lab/ ngas khyod 'dul bar mi nus/ na lend+ra na bla ma rdo rje gdan pa bya ba bzhugs de'i drung du song dang / khong la 'jig skyobs kyi chos gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa du ma yang mnga'/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba'i zab chos la li ta badzra la dngos su zhus pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa thos pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs brlag par byed pa zhig yod pa de zhus la myur du sgrub pa gyis/ mu stegs ngan pa tshos gtad kyang byas dogs yod gsungs/ de nas myur bar rdo rje gdan du byon gandho la la bskor ba byed kyin bzhugs nas bla ma dang mjal dgongs tsa na/ shar phyogs kyi sgo 'gag na bud med gzhon nu ma cig 'dug pa de he he phyag dang bskor ba long mi 'dug zer/ nang du log 'ongs pas sgo 'gag na sngar ngo shes pa'i phyi rol pa gcig dang 'phrad/

des khyod 'dir ci byed kyi yod zer/ bla ma a mo gha badzra la chos zhu ba yin smras pas/ kho mgo gug byas song / de nas bla ma mjal ba zhus pas myur du gnang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ legs skye ba sngon nas las dang 'brel yod pa yin/ da khyod la ci dgos gsungs/ bdag sngar phyi rol pa'i mkhas pa nang pa'i bstan pa la zhugs pa zhig yin/ mu stegs ngan pas gtad byas dogs/ de las skyobs pa'i gdams pa zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ de tsug yin khyod kyi las bsags pa'i lha bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed yin gsungs nas 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas ye shes phab pa'i skabs su byin rlabs zhugs pa'i nyams rtags mang du byung ba dang bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad pa'i zhal gzigs/ bla mas kyang de la brten nas mtshan ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa zhes btags/ phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang gi skabs su rdo rje gri gug gnang nas 'di 'phyar ba tsam gyis dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag par byed pas khyod 'jigs mi dgos gsungs shing dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ rgyud man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa gnang nas/ khyod rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod du song la sgrub pa gyis dang lha 'di dngos grub myur ba yin gsungs/ de nas slob dpon gyis bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa mdzad pas yi dam gyi lhas zhal gzigs nas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ de'i bar la khong gi bla mas gnang ba'i gri gug de 'phyar ba tsam gyis bar chad kyis gtan mi tshugs pa byung zhing / de lta bu'i slob dpon chen po des rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor rnams legs par stsal cing rjes su bzung ba ni grub chen padma badzra ste/ grub chen 'di ni/ yab slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi rnam sprul padma dbang chen zhes bya ba dang / yum ye shes sgron zhes pa gnyis kyi sras su/ las rab brtsegs pa'i rgyal po'i khab na padma bkod pa zhes pa'i grong khyer yod pa der 'khrungs/

chung ngu'i dus su slob dpon bi na ka bya ba zhig la yi ge bslabs pas mtshan ga kṣa ri pa ste/ bod skad du/ yi ge dang ldan pa zhes par grags/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan ni bhi na shrī rakṣi ta/ slob gnyer mdzad pa'i mtshan a bhi dzu ga la ste/ bod skad du mngon par rig pa dang ldan par smra ba'o/ /de nas grub pa brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ yul de na 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grub thob cig yod pa de la bde mchog gi dbang zhus sgrub pa yun ring du mdzad pas grub rtags gang yang ma byung bar thugs mug par yod pa la/ re zhig na bud med dmar mo zhig byung nas/ khyod dang lha 'di la las 'brel med kyis/ khyod kyi las bsags pa'i lha 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed yin pas de'i chos skor zhus la sgrubs dang 'grub sla zer/ 'o na de'i chos skor su la yod gsungs pas/ de na re kho mo'i yul 'di na su la yod mi shes/ dharmā chos kyi gañdza na bzhugs srid kyang khyod kyis lon pa'i skal ba med zer/ slob dpon gyis 'o na da dung bde mchog gi sgrub pa bskyar nas byas la legs sam byas pas/ khyod ci 'dod pa yin zer/ kho bo mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa yin byas pas/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa la yun ring po 'gor/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la cang mi 'gor zer/ der khong gi thugs la bud med 'di 'dra'i blo la gtad ra cig kyang med dgongs pa na/ de bud med des mkhyen nas de tsug yin/ sngon gyi bla ma la zhus na 'thad zer/ bla ma la zhus pas/ khyod kyi ma legs pa chen po byas/ bud med de rdo rje phag mo'i rnam 'phrul yin/ da khyod kyis las bsags pa'i lha rdo rje 'jigs byed yin pas/ de bsgrub na dngos grub myur du thob gsungs/ 'o na chos de thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas/ ngas sngon chad de 'dra thos ma myong / bud med de la dris na des shes gsungs/

de nas khong gis bud med de grong khyer gyi dbus su btsal bas ma rnyed par tshong 'dus su btsal bas/ bud med de zho rdza gang khyer nas tshong 'dus kyi dbus na 'dug pa la/ khong gis zho de nga nyo/ bla ma'i gsung zhig kyang khyed la gnang yod byas pas/ mo na re/ khyod la zho 'thung ba'i skal ba med/ bla ma'i gsung ci yod smros zer/ khong gis bla ma'i zhal nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis chos skor de gang na yod khyed kyi shes gsungs pas/ de nga la khyod kyis ston dang gsungs pas/ bud med de na re/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor de shes pa yul gang na'ang bzhugs/ khyad par du nub phyogs u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang na rgyud 'bum pa bzhugs te khyod kyis spyan drangs pa'i skal ba med/ sngon 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul ba la li ta badzra zhes bya ba zhig gis rgyud de'i nang nas mchog thun mong bsgrub pa'i rtog pa 'ga' re dang / man ngag phra mo tsam zhus nas rdo rje gdan gyi dbus su rgya cher 'phel yod/ khyad par du a mo gha badzra bya ba gcig la dbang rgyud man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa yod de khong ni gshegs/ de'i slob ma ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa bya ba gcig la de rnams tshang ma yod/ khyod kyi las 'brel yod pa'i bla ma de yin pas de la zhus na khyed rang gi ci bsam 'grub/ khong gis the tshom med par bud med de la phyag 'tshal nas rjes su gzung bar zhu zhus pas/ bud med de na re/ khyod gti thug pa la khyod dang nga las 'brel med ma byas pa e yin zer nas/ lag gi zho rdza de rnal 'byor pa na so gzhon pa gos sngon po gyon pa/ lag na tri shu la thogs pa gcig dang mnyam por 'thungs nas gnyis ka mkha' la gshegs song / de nas khong gis phyir log ste bla ma'i drung du phyin lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas bud med de rdo rje phag mo yin/ rnal 'byor pa de he ru ka yin pa la khyod kyis ma shes pa phran bu byung 'dug

da 'on kyang khyod kyi las 'brel bzhag pa'i bla ma ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa yin pas/ de la gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs pa zhus/ nga'i gnas padma bkod pa'i dur khrod 'di ru sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gyis dang dngos grub thob bo gsungs/ de nas khong gis yul dbus kyi ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod du ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin te dbang rgyud man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa gsan nas/ dbang bskur gyi dus su gsang mtshan padma badzra zhes bya bar bla mas btags/ bhi ti pa ti'i phyag mtshan gcig 'dug pa de'i sgrub thabs dang bcas pa gnang nas/ 'di dang bcas bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin dur khrod padma bkod par bsgrub pa rtse gcig tu gyis dang dngos grub thob cing / bar chad phran bu 'byung ba yang phyag mtshan 'di 'phyar ba tsam gyis zhi bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ de nas khong gis bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin dur khrod padma bkod par sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ re zhig na yul mi rnams kyi ngag tu kho bos dur khrod du gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo bskor nas grong khyer ba rnams brlag pa'i grab byed kyin 'dug zer ba rgyal pos gsan nas/ rgyal po yang khros te dmag dpung 'ur rdo dang bcas pa phyin nas slob dpon la bar chad brtsams pa na/ khong nga rgyal skyes te sngon bla mas gnang ba'i phyag mtshan 'phyar bas rgyal po'i mgo gas/ dmag la la rengs/ la la shi/ la la brgyal te kun gyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug padma badzra zhes mthu stobs phul du byung bar yongs su grags so/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon chen po des dpal gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs par stsal cing rjes su bzung ba ni bal po bha ro phyag rdum ste/ 'di ni 'khrungs yul bal po ye rang pa/ yab phyi rol pa'i rig byed smra ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa dbang phyug skyabs bya ba/

yum nang pa'i rigs la gtogs pa sgrol ma mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs nas ming thugs rje bsrung bya bar btags/ 'di cher skyes nas rgyu'i dngos po shin tu 'byor bas phyug po chen por gyur pas kun gyis bha ror 'bod pa zhig yin pas phyis kyang bha ror grags/ yum gyi de rang phyug pa 'di nga nang pa'i lha la dad pa'i stobs kyis yin pas/ da jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku gcig bzhengs dgos zer ba la/ yab kyis mi rigs rgyal pos chad pa 'ongs zer/ yum sras gnyis kyis cis kyang bzhengs pa drag gsungs pas/ yab kyis de la rgyu phun sum tshogs pa dgos zer kyang / yum sras gnyis kyis nged rang la ci 'dod yod gsungs nas lha bzo ba bos pas/ lha bzo bas kyang de la tshegs med de/ rgyal blon gyis gsan na chad pa 'ongs nyen yod zer kyang / yum sras gnyis kyis cis kyang bzhengs dgos gsungs nas/ jo bo kharsa pa ṇi'i sku mi tshad gcig bzhengs te nang phug tu sus kyang mi mthong ba zhig tu bzhugs su bcug de la mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor ba phul gsol ba btab pas/ jo bo bzhugs pa'i gnas de'i 'og nas gter kha zhig brdol nas de las rin po che phun sum tshogs pa mang po 'phel bas/ der yum sras gnyis kyis yab la/ rin po che 'di lta bu 'phel ba jo bo'i byin rlabs yin pas/ da ni 'gro ba la sbyin gtong rgya chen po byed dgos zer ba la/ yab kyis nged rang gi rgyal po 'di sbyin gtong sogs dge ba'i las kho rang yang gcig kyang mi byed/ gzhan byed pa la yang shin tu blo rnag pa zhig yod pas/ 'o skol gyis de 'dra byas na rgyal po phrag dog nas chad pa 'ongs bas da lam cis kyang bshol ba legs/ sras la khyod rang yang ston pa dbang grags can du song la slob gnyer ci yong gyis zer nas/ khong gis kyang der byon nas rig byed smra ba'i grub mtha' la lo kha yar bslabs pas mkhas par dgongs te log 'ongs nas sngar gyi jo bo la mjal du phyin pas/

nang thams cad rin po ches gang nas 'dug pas jo bo la phyag 'tshal mchod pa phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba kun gyi mgon/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa brtsams nas yab yum gnyis dang 'khor tshogs thams cad kyis nyin re bzhin tshar re 'don pa'i dam bca' mdzad/ de nas skye bo la sbyin gtong rgya chen po mdzad pas/ rgyal po phrag dog skyes nas/ nga'i lha dbang phyug chen po yin pa la/ khyod kyis nang pa'i lha kharsa pa ṇi bzhengs pa ci yin zer nas chad pa byung ste/ yab yum gnyis bud med 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bskrad/ sras kyi lag pa gnyis/ rna ba/ sna/ rkang pa ya gcig rnams bcad de srang bar gcig tu bskyur/ dngos po'i rigs rnams rgyal po'i pho brang du 'khyer/ jo bo kharsa pa ṇi me la bsregs kyang ma tshig chu la bskyur kyang ma khyer/ rdo bas brdungs kyang ma thul bar/ lo rgyus rnams rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal po na re/ nang pa'i lha rten 'di rnams ya mtshan che/ rang gnas su bzhugs su chug la mchod pa bag tsam phul zer nas/ de ltar byas pas sngon ltar gyi gter kha brdol ba ma byung / mchod pa 'bul mkhan gyi rgan mo gcig yod pa de la gser bag tsam byung / de nas bha ro lam zan bsgugs kyin yod pa las/ rgya gar nas 'ongs pa'i tshong pa mang po grub chen padma badzra la skyabs su mchi zer ba thos nas/ bha ros de gar yod gsungs pas/ de nub phyogs u rgyan gyi gnas padma bkod pa'i dur khrod na bzhugs zer/ khong ci la mkhas dris pas/ khong gshin rje gshed la mkhas/ khong la las rab brtsegs pa'i rgyal pos chad pa byung yang / rgyal po 'khor bcas bskrad pa la sogs pa nus zer/ khong gi der ngas phyin na ci tsam 'gor byas pas/ tshong pa rnams kyis hai khyod kyi rkang lag gang yang med pa 'dis der ci tsug phyin/ lto yang dud 'gros bza' ba ltar dgos pa la ci sleb zer ba la/ khong gis cis kyang 'gro bas zla ba gcig tsam la sleb gsungs/

'o na khyod cis kyang 'gro na zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ zla bo mang po dang sdebs la song dang lam bar la lto re yang ster/ lam du 'jigs pa yang mi 'ongs zer/ khong gis 'gro mi mchis sam gsungs pas/ ye rang gi tshong pa mang po 'gro yi 'dug zer bas/ khong gis de rnams dang 'grogs phyin pas u rgyan gyi dur khrod du slebs/ grub chen padma badzra dang mjal nas gser bag tsam yod pa phul/ gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas grub chen gyi zhal nas/ khyi dang glo ba 'phrad pa ltar su thod thod la mi 'ongs/ yun du bsrings na 'ongs nyan yod/ re zhig la 'di bsgrub gsungs nas rdo rje phag mo'i dbang bskur/ rgyud man ngag thor re ba zhig gnang nas dur khrod kyi bas mtha' zhig tu sgoms gsungs/ de ltar byas pas zla ba kha yar na byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags bag tsam byung bas khong cung zad nga rgyal nas spyod pa sna re byas pas/ sha za mkha' 'gro zhig gis khong la gtad brtsams nas khong la smyo brgyal byung / de bla mas mkhyen nas ci byed kyin yod pa yin gsungs/ sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bu spyod pa byed pa la tshar bcad rjes bzung gnyis ka dgos pa yin/ ngo mtshar che ba'i ltad mo su thod thod kyis byed rgyu min gsungs/ da khyod 'dod pa'i chos sbyin no gsungs nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas rgyud kyi bshad pa tho re ba zhig dang man ngag rnams gnang nas/ da khyod kyis gnas dur khrod kyi gnas 'di ru lo drug sgoms la sgrub pa rtse gcig tu gyis dang lus 'di la brten nas dngos grub thob gsungs/ khong gis 'di tsam gyi long med/ bdag la rgya siṅga la'i rgyal pos don med kyi chad pa byung ba yin pas rgyal po de brlag pa'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khrul 'khor gcig thugs la 'dogs pa zhu zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu nang gi dgra de ma bsad na/ /phyi'i dgra bo 'dul bar dka'/ /gsungs pa la/ khong gis cis kyang 'khrul 'khor gcig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ yang slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rgya sing ga la'i rgyal po de la phyi rol pa'i mchod gnas mang po yod 'dug pas/ khyod kyis 'khrul 'khor gyi las brtsams kyang 'grub pa dka'/ 'on kyang da res bskrad pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'di zab shos shig yin pas 'di gyis gsungs nas gnang / khong gis de ma thag la bskrad pa'i 'khrul 'khor brtsams pas tshur log nas khong rang bsgrub khang du mi tshugs par 'bros dgos par byung nas lo rgyus rnams slob dpon la zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ smras pa'i ngag la khyod mi nyan thog mar nang gi dgra ma thul bar phyi'i dgra thul bar dka'/ las 'di rnams la'ang rang rang gi bsnyen bsgrub sngon du 'gro dgos pa yin/ de thams cad kyi sngon du bskyed rdzogs gnyis 'gro dgos/ de bas kyang las sngags gsum la gtso cher bsnyen bsgrub ma song na 'khrul 'khor sogs ci byas kyang 'grub dka'/ khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'ba' zhig la dmigs pa ni ma yin/ khyod rang don kho na yin pas 'grub dka'/ spyir bsam pa gtso che ste lo drug tsam mi nus na'ang zla ba drug cis kyang sgrubs gsungs/ khong gis sngar gyi gnas de ru bsgoms pas zla ba gcig gnyis la 'jigs pa chen po byung bas/ slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas khong gi drung du byon te/ bsgrub pa'i nyams rtags ci byung gsungs pa la lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ khyod la bsam pa rnam dag mi 'dug spyir bsgrub pa la bsam pa rnam dag gal che/ 'on kyang 'di rang gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams byung 'dug pas/ bsgrub pa'i dus su 'jigs pa chen po byung kyang 'jigs mi dgos/ gal te 'jigs pa byas na bgegs chen pos gtad byed pas da khyod kyis ma 'jigs par sgrubs dang gtad mi 'ongs gsungs/

khong gis 'jigs pa ma byas par bsgrubs pas zla ba lnga tsam na dur khrod der gnas pa'i mi ma yin rnams dang / stag la sogs pa'i gcan gzan rnams bskrad na bskrad nus/ dbang du bsdu na bsdu nus pa byung nas/ slob dpon la zhus pas/ 'o na de tsug yin legs 'dug nged nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di bsgrub cing rtogs na sangs rgya zer ba de tsug yin/ da dung sgrubs gsungs/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin slar yang bsrings nas bsgrubs pas zla ba drug song ba'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa zhal gzigs nas sku lus la thim pa'i snang ba byung / mnal sad nas rang yang 'jigs byed yin bsam pa'i ngang nas dur khrod du rgyug cing song bas/ der gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo kun kyang skrag nas/ slob dpon la zhus pas/ bha ro ham̐ 'thung grub pa thob nas gda'/ khyed rnams 'jigs mi dgos gsungs/ de rnams kyi nang nas rnal 'byor pa a ye bya ba de la slob dpon gyis khyod 'khor lo bde mchog gi grub thob yin pa la/ khyod la kho bskrad pa'i nus pa med pa e yin gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor a yes kyang bha ro bskrad pa'i chad zhus te dur khrod du phyin nas bskrad par brtsams pas/ bha ros de shes nas kho la sdigs mdzub bstan pas/ khong gi lus shing bzhin du rengs nas g.yo 'gul ma nus/ bha ros dur khrod du stag gcig bzung nas de la bzhon te slob dpon gyi drung du phyin/ slob dpon la phyag 'tshal bstod pa phul bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas nga las khyod nus pa che ba 'dug gsungs/ de nas bha ros khyed nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di thos pa tsam gyis grol ba zhig 'dug zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ spyir de tsug yin te kun la de bzhin yong ba dka'/ khyod kyi sngon las bsags pa'i lha bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed yin pas gzhan mang po bsgrubs pa bas kyang 'di bsgrub sla ba yin/

lar bla med kyi rgyud sde gzhan rnams mchog bsgrub pas thun mong zhar la 'byung bar gsungs kyang / 'dir thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub nas mchog zhar la 'byung ba yin pas gzhan las zab/ mi lus phun tshogs 'di thob nas thun mong gi dngos grub sna re tsam bsgrub mi nus pa'i mi med tshod yin gsungs/ de nas slob dpon gyis rnal 'byor pa a ye la chu la sngags shig btab gtor bas brgyal pa sangs/ a ye la 'khor lo bde mchog gi grub thob yin bsams kyang re 'khos mi 'dug gsungs/ de nas re zhig na bha ros grub pa thob pa sing ga la'i rgyal pos thos nas bha ro gsod par brtsams te gshed ma btang pa/ bha ros mkhyen nas slob dpon la zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'jigs mi dgos/ lag log pa'i rgyal po 'di rigs mngon spyod kyis tshar gcod ma byas na rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i rtsa ltung 'byung nyen che/ 'on kyang da lam 'di tsug gyis/ gsungs nas/ rtog pa bdun pa nas bshad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi dbang gi las sbyor gnang / de nas bha ros yul du 'ongs nas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas la dbang gi las sbyor mdzad pas thams cad dbang du 'dus rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bkod/ sngon gyi yab yum gnyis dang bud med sogs la yang chos bstan pas de rnams kyang grol/ slar yang gser mi khur gsum tsam dang bcas u rgyan du byon slob dpon la gser mang po phul/ rnal 'byor pho mo rnams la gser 'gyed dang bcas pa'i tshogs 'khor bshams/ slob dpon la phyag 'tshal nas dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa'i don sgo yin pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhig zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas nga rnal 'byor ba rab byung gi brtul zhugs bor ba yin pas khyod kyi mkhan po mi 'ongs/ nags khrod ya gi'i shing sdong gcig gi rtsa ba na mkhas pa shanti dzña na garbhe bya ba bzhugs pas khong la zhus/ nga la gser gyi dgos pa med pas gser 'di rnams kyang khong la phul gsungs pas/

bha ros gser cis kyang bzhes pa zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis mdun gyi rdo 'di rnams khyer gsungs shing rdo de dag la gser 'gyur gyi rtsi mdzad pas thams cad gser du 'gyur ba bha ro la gnang ste/ 'di dag khyer la bsnyen rdzogs zhus gsungs nas brdzangs/ bha ro dpon slob lnga tsam yod pa rnams kyis byon nas paṇḍi ta la gser rnams phul lo rgyus zhus pas/ de ltar yin na byar rung gsungs nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ mahā paṇḍi ta shanti bha dra'i mtshan gsol te/ phyi 'dul ba'i sde snod/ nang gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams kyi bshad lung gnang nas/ da rang yul du song la bstan pa la phan thogs gyis gsungs/ de nas slob dpon gyis gser rnams yul de'i rgyal po la byin nas/ bha ro la sangs rgyas 'od srung gi phyag gi 'khar sil gcig snam sbyar gcig rnams gnang nas khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi sgra mi grag pa'i sa phyogs su rgyal ba'i bstan pa la phan thogs rgya cher 'ongs gsungs/ bha ros slar yang slob dpon gyi drung du lan gcig mjal ba la 'ongs zhus pas/ da ma 'ongs nga dang khyod 'phrad pa'i skal ba med gsungs/ nan gyis gsol ba btab pas/ gnang nas slar yang bha ros u rgyan du byon nas slob dpon padma badzra la rdo rje 'jigs byed/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i dbang rgyud cha lag dang bcas pa gsan nas bal yul ye rang gi gnas su byon/ ye rang nyi ma steng zhes bya ba'i dgon pa btab nas bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che la bya ba rgya cher mdzad de/ slob ma'i tshogs kyang phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba skyo sku mched/ rwa lo rdo rje grags/ 'gos lo bsod nams rtse mo/ mal lo blo gros grags/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen pa la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa du ma bskrun par mdzad/ khyad par rwa chen rdo rje grags la dpal gshin rje gshed rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa gnang nas/

rwa chen gyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa la gshin rje gshed rwa lugs zhes deng sang gi bar du grags pa 'di yin no/ /de ltar bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya cher mdzad nas mthar zhi bar gshegs pa'i sku gdung rin po che ye rang nyid du gser 'bum gyi gzungs bzhugs su hril por yod pa rwa pa rnams bzhed/ skyo pa rnams bzhu phul nas thugs la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku byon te/ skyo sku mched kyis phyag tu bsnams nas pham thing du spyan drangs te gser gyi mchod rten gcig bzhengs gsungs/ ba ri ba phung po lhag med du song gsungs pa sogs mi mthun pa mang ngo / /de lta bu'i rgya bal gyis paṇḍi ta lnga po de dag gi ni 'phags pa'i yul du dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor rnams gsal bar mdzad pa yin la/ yang lugs srol gyi gtso bo lta bu gcig ni/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la gdams pa ste/ de yang slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ rgya gar shar lho'i yul sindhu ra zhes par rgyal po gha sa ro pra bha wa zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs te/ byis pa nyid nas gzugs dang shes rab dang / kun tu spyod pa rnam par dag par gyur nas sgra dang sdeb sbyor dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos la sogs pa la rab tu mkhas par sbyangs so/ /cher skyes pa dang rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor nas na lend+ra'i phyogs gcig tu grong khyer rdo 'jog ces bya bar rgyal po shrī dharmā pa las brtsigs pa'i ṭikka zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du mkhan po rnam par snang mdzad bzang po'i slob ma thugs rje dang byang chub kyi sems la goms pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab du ma'i mdzod 'dzin cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don gsal bar 'chad pa la slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i drung du pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs nas/

shrī na lend+rar rigs ldan bshes gnyen gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rtsom pa dang bshad pa sogs byas nas der gnas pa rnams brod pa bskyed do/ /de nas byang phyogs u rgyan gyi gnas su byon te yul de'i phyogs gcig na nor bu'i gling du skyes pa'i nor bu gling pa zhes bya ba'i slob dpon nam/ gzugs sna tshogs su ston pas sna tshogs gzugs zhes kyang bya/ 'jol sgeg rdo rje zhes kyang bya ba de'i drung du/ bya ba dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mang du gsan/ de nas de'i phyogs gcig na gu ni ru zhes bya bar grags pa'i bla ma de'i drung na mnyan te lung mang du gsan no/ /yang yul de'i phyogs gcig na lakṣa mo se na chen mo'i drung du zla ba brgyad kyi bar du bzhugs nas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsan te/ der 'phags pa gnod gnas kyi grub pa thob bo/ /de nas dza lendha rar ba mo pā ta ste/ slob dpon byis pa chung ngu'i zhabs zhes bya ba shes rab kyis rgyud la bsam pa chu klung lta bur gyur pa de'i drung du shes rab gyi rgyud mang du gsan/ de nas lho phyogs nam mkha'i shing ldan kong ka nar ba ling pā ta ste slob dpon bsrung ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba thabs kyi rgyud la bsam pa chu klung ltar gyur pa de'i drung du lo dgu bzhugs te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud chen 'grel bcas zla ba bco brgyad kyi bar du nyan/ de'i tshe bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis 'di kho na nyid kyi don 'di ma rtogs zhes gsungs pas/ de la thugs cung zad chad de/ 'di ma rtogs na gzhan don med snyam nas phyag rgya 'dus pa'i glegs bam du byas nas mgul par btags te/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ku pa tsa zhes bya bar stag dang dred la sogs pa mang po gnas pa'i tshal du byon te zla ba drug bsgoms pas de kho na nyid rtogs so/ /de nas ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i tshe 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'jol sgeg rol pa dang bcas pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i dge slong ma gnyis dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi khang pa chung ngu zhig tu snang bar gyur to/

/de'i tshe slob dpon gyi gsol ba btab pas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas rim pa gnyis pa'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i 'jam dpal zhal lung gsungs/ zhes zhal lung nyid las 'byung yang gtam rgyud kha cig las ni/ bla ma ba ling ta'i zhal nas/ yang kyi the tshom gyi mdud pa de dag rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar 'jam pa'i rdo rje bzhugs pa'i drung du zhus shig des grol bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan nas byon pa'i lam khar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su khang bu gcig gi drung na bud med gcig dang khyi mo zhig gnas pa dang / de dang nye bar na btsun pa chos gos kyis thod byas nas zhing rmo zhing 'dug pas/ kye ma rab tu byung ba bud med dang bcas zhing rmod pa 'di 'dra ba byung bas bstan pa nyams so snyam du dgongs nas thugs skyo bar gyur to/ /de lta na yang snyigs ma'i dus la babs pas der byon nas bsod snyoms mdzad par dgongs pa dang / btsun pa des bud med la rab tu byung ba 'di la dro drongs shig ces bsgos song ba na/ bud med des nya rgya khyer nas chu phran gcig la nya bshor te/ de btsos nas khyi mo'i mdun du shing lo la bzhag nas chos ston drongs zhes bsgos pas/ khyi mo bskyugs pa dang / der sngar gyi nya dang bcas pa drangs byung bas/ slob dpon gyis ched du dmigs pa'i sha dang mi gtsang bar dgongs nas ma gsol lo/ /de nas btsun pa de na re/ kye 'dzam bu'i gling pa la phal pa'i zas drongs zhes bsgo bas/ 'bras chan zho dang bcas pa drangs pa dang / slob dpon gyis gsol nas gshegs par dgongs pa dang / btsun pa de na re/ da 'di na phar song yang do nub sdod sa mi rnyed kyis sang song zer bas der bzhugs so/ /der slob dpon gyis gsang ba 'dus pa zhal 'don du bton pa dang / gang du slob dpon gyis mi shes pa'i sar bud med de mi mgu ba dang / ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur re byed pa dang / slob dpon gyis thugs la 'dis the tshom chod par 'dug dgongs te phyag btsal nas gsol ba btab pa dang /

bud med de na re/ ngas mi shes da ci'i btsun pa de shin tu mkhas pa yin pas de la zhus shig zer ro/ /de gar song dris pas chang nyor song zer/ bsgugs pas phyis red chang gis bzi nas 'khyor bzhin pa 'ongs pa gzigs pas ma dad kyang nga rgyal bcag nas phyag btsal te/ bdag la gsang ba 'dus pa bshad par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur longs shig ces gsungs/ bdag gis dbang bskur thob ces brjod pas/ nga nyid kyis dbang bskur dgos zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyis yo byad btsal nas dbang zhus so/ /der ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad kyi mtshan mo spyil po gzhal med khang du sprul/ de'i dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa mngon sum du bstan nas dbang zhus zhes 'byung ngo / /yang lo rgyus gzhan las ni sngar gyi btsun pa de yang dkyil 'khor drung du 'dug nas/ nga la dbang len nam dkyil 'khor la dbang len gsungs pa la/ dkyil 'khor la dbang len zhus pas/ dkyil 'khor mi snang bar gyur pa dang / dkyil 'khor btsun pa de'i sprul pa yin par mkhyen nas phyag btsal te/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod nas gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor sprul pa la tho rangs dbang blangs zhes kyang 'byung ba yin no/ /gang ltar de lta bu'i slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor rnams legs par gsan nas/ mar me mdzad bzang po la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skor gdams/ des grub chen dpal 'dzin la gnang zhing / grub chen 'dis gshin rje gshed skor gyi yig cha mang du mdzad de na ro pa la gdams/ na ro pas te lo pa la gdams gshed skor gsan/ te lo pas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la gsan pa yin no/ /jo bo na ro ta pas/ a sd+yu la badzra ste zab pa'i rdo rje zhes pa la gdams/

de'i pradzñā rakṣi ta la gdams/ de ltar brgyud pa'i chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi paṇḍi ta pradzñā rakṣi ta la bal po thugs rje chen pos gsan pa yin no/ /'di dag kyang gtso cher rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi brgyud rim ltar bkod pa yin gyi/ dgra gdong gnyis kyi brgyud rim ni rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig rgya mtsho sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig so so las rgyas par 'byung bas/ kho bo'i chos 'byung 'dir ma bkod pa yin pas don gnyer can dag gis gsan yig rnams su blta bar byos shig de ltar mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs nas sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs la brgyud pa na ro ta pa la babs pa dang / yang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma nas te lo pa/ des grub chen na ro pa la babs pa ste brgyud pa'i chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi grub chen pradzñā rakṣi tas rjes su bzung ba'i bal po thugs rje chen po zhes bya ba de yang 'khrungs yul bal po man dza gling pa/ yab sgra dang tshad ma la mkhas shing / khyad par gso ba rig pa la shin tu mkhas pa zhig gi sras/ chung ngu nas sgra tshad la blo sbyong du bcug pas mkhas par gyur nas lung gi chos pha la med par/ gser srang gnyis bskur te 'phags yul du lung slob tu btang pas lung chos la mkhas par dgongs nas bal yul du log snyam tsa na/ jo bo pradzñā rakṣi ta dang mjal nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa ma lus pa gsan/ lo bcu drug zhabs drung du bzhugs nas yid ches par mdzad de bal yul du byon nas sgrub pa mdzad pas bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ gsang 'dus/ gshin rje gshed sogs kyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ slar yang 'phags yul du byon/ na lend+rar bla ma pradzñā rakṣi ta'i drung du mjal lo bdun bzhugs/ rgyud thams cad rtsa rkyang du byas te bshad pa'i lung mdzad/ khyad par gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud la nyams len mngon rtogs kyi rim pa'i dbang du mdzad pas dkrugs te 'chad pa'i lugs mdzad/

gzhan yang gsang sngags la lag len gal che ba yin gsungs nas gdams ngag don du dril nas gsungs pa gsan te/ paṇḍi ta 'di la bla ma mang du yod kyang / pradzñā rakṣi ta nyid bla ma'i gtso bo lta bu mdzad/ 'di dang bal po bha ro phyag rdum gnyis jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang dang / rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus gnyis gcig par gsungs/ rwa chen gyi dngos slob 'u yug pa ban shes chos skyong gis tha dad du bshad/ de la bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsung gis tha dad par 'thad kyang / rwa chen gyis paṇḍi ta thugs rje chen po la dgra gdong gsan zhing / bha ro la ye ma gsan par bshad pa 'di gsung bgros ma zin pa yin gsungs nas don la tha dad par bzhed la/ yang rang lugs kyi rgyud yig 'ga' zhig las de gnyis gcig pa lta bu sogs rnam grangs mang po zhig 'dug kyang bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa bzhed pa bzhin thugs rje chen po dang bha ro gnyis tha dad pa yin pa 'thad par snang ste/ gsan yig rgya mtsho sogs las/ sa lugs kyi brgyud pa 'dren pa na bal po thugs rje chen po dang / rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa 'dren pa na bha ro phyag rdum drangs pa 'dis rtogs nus la/ 'on kyang rwa lo'i di pam̐ ka ra'i sbyin sreg yod/ /de wa a kar shanti yis/ /mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod/ /bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum yod/ /ces di pam̐ ka ra dang bha ro tha dad par gsungs pa dang / 'phags pa rin po ches/ di pam̐ ka ra rakṣi ta/ /bha ror yongs su grags la 'dud/ /ces pa dang / de dang mthun par gsan yig rgya mtsho dang / phyis kyi gsan yig rnams las 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa 'dren pa'i tshe/ di pam̐ ka ra/ rwa lo tsā ba zhes drangs/ dpe 'ga' zhig las/ bha ro phyag rdum/ rwa lo tsā ba zhes bha ro dang di pam̐ ka ra zhes pa lta bu zhig gsungs pa gnyis 'gal ba ltar snang bas dpyad dgos so/

/de bas na 'phags yul du spyir gshed skor dang / bye brag rdo rje 'jigs byed la lam srol mang du byung yang ches dar rgyas yod pa ni ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ro langs ma nas/ la li ta sogs brgyud de bal po bha ro la bka' babs pa 'di dang / mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs nas sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs brgyud nas bal po thugs rje chen po la babs pa'i lugs srol 'di gnyis gtso bo lta bu yin no/ /gzhan gong du bstan pa ltar gyi gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor la lam srol du ma zhig byung bas/ gshed skor 'di 'phags yul bal po dang bcas par rgya bal gyi paṇa grub de dag gis ches dar bar mdzad pa yin la/ de nas bod 'dir bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su lo paṇa rnams rim pas brgyud nas dar ba yin te/ de dag gi tshul ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis 'phags yul du gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor ji ltar dar ba'i tshul bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa dmar po'i skor 'phags yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal birwa pa dang / de'i slob brgyud grub chen dpal 'dzin/ de'i slob ma paṇḍi ta blo zab snying po dang gsum gyis 'di rang gi rgyud so so la brten nas gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma/ lha lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis te gsum bkral zhing dar ba las/ dang po ni/ dpal gshin rje gshed de thabs shes dbyer med yin pas yum logs su ma bgrangs kyang 'gal ba med la/ yang rgyud kyi zhu ba po dang / bsdud pa po yin pas yum rdo rje ro langs ma logs su byas na yang mi 'gal bas/ gang ltar yab yum gnyis med kyi bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la rje btsun birwa pas gsan nas dar bar mdzad pa ste/ de yang spyir 'phags yul du birwa pa zhes pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa la/ rgyal rigs dman pa'i spyod pa mdzad/ /dur khrod rgyu zhing sha chen gsol/

/birwa pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa la sogs pa 'ga' re 'byung yang / 'dir ni grub chen brgyad cu'i bstod par/ chu bo chen po gyen la ldog /chang la nyi ma gtong par bcug /birwa pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i tshul rgyas par na gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan pa de nyid yin la/ 'di yang dus nam gyi tshe byon na/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang nyi shu tsam song ba na/ slob dpon dpal ldan chos skyong 'di byon par bshad cing / 'dis thog mar na lend+ra'i mkhan po mdzad/ dus der zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzad pas/ re zhig na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bdag med mas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te snyan brgyud bzhi'i gdams pas dbang gi ye shes sa dang po'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur nas/ de'i rgyun zhag drug gi bar du bskyangs pas sa bdun pa yan mthar phyin nas slar sa lhag ma rnams bgrod de sa bcu gsum pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa zhig yin kyang / gzhan snang du grub thob tsam gyi tshul bzung ste lam gyi srol chen gnyis tsam zhig phye ba yin te/ gdul bya dbang po brtul po bstan pa la ma zhugs la 'jug 'dod yod pa'i gang zag shar phyogs nag po pa lta bu skal dman rim 'jug pa'i tshul du dkri ba'i lam rim gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa dang / gdul bya dbang rnon grub chen ḍombhi he ru ka lta bu skal ldan gcig car ba'i tshul du dkri ba'i lam rim shin tu spros med kyi gdams ngag gi sgo nas dkri ba dang gnyis las/ phyi ma ni grub chen 'dis gshin rje gshed gyi rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa la brten nas gshed dmar gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung rnams mdzad/

slob ma'i mchog ḍombhi he ru ka la gdams pas grub chen 'di nyid gdams pa de kho nas grol/ de yang ḍombhi he ru ka zhes pa bod skad du g.yung po khrag 'thung zhes pa ste/ rgya gar shar phyogs ra ḍa'i yul gyi mu stegs kyi rgyal po gdug pa can zhig 'dul bar dgongs nas/ rigs ngan ko lpags mkhan g.yung mo'i bu mo zhig phyag rgyar byas/ nags kyi stag smyon pa la rang nyid chibs pa'i rgyab tu phyag rgya bskyon/ dug sbrul gdug pas lcag dang bcas pas rgyal po de btul nas mu stegs thams cad ming med par byas te rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la bkod pa yin no/ /des na g.yung mo'i khyo yin pas g.yung po dpal he ru ka dngos yin pas khrag 'thung zhes grags/ des grub chen dpal 'dzin la gsungs/ des gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang ni grub chen bi ra ḍi pa zhes bya ba byi la pa ste/ des rang gi phyag rgya mo byi la mor sprul pa sogs kyi ma dad pa btul/ bri bya la byi la'i pags pa'i sham thabs yod pa'i grub thob cig 'bri ba de la gnang / de'i ni ka laṅka de ba la gdams/ des bal po ra want+ra la gnang nas rgya bal du dar ba yin zhing / yang shin tu spros pa med pa'i khrid kyi gdams pa ni/ grub chen dpal 'dzin nas ma ti garbha'am/ gambhi ra ma ti la gdams pas khrid kyi brgyud pa la grub chen snga ma de mi dgos pa yin no/ /grub chen dpal 'dzin ni/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po gdug pa can zhig gis dbu bcad pa na/ dpal gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas grub pa brnyes so zhes bstan pa'i phyir ma he'i zhal sprul te gdug pa can de btul bas/ deng sang bri bya la grub thob ma he sngon po'i yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig rgya mtsho las/ sngon lha dang lha ma yin 'thab pa las/ lha phru gu mgo chad pa mthong nas rang gi dbu bcad nas sbyar te lha'i bdud rtsi bskus pas gsos/ ma he shi ba'i mgo bo rang la sbyar bas dge slong gi lus la ma he'i mgo can/

chos ma he'i zhal nas gsungs pa/ chang 'o mar bsgyur bar thod pa dang mgo bcad pa'i gri gug phyag na bsnams pa'i grub thob gcig bri'o zhes 'byung bas cung zad mi mthun pa zhig bshad do/ dbu can du byed pa de yin la/ de gam̐ bhi ra ma ti la gsungs te/ des kyang gshin rje gshed la dngos su gdams pa thob cing mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ de yang gam̐ bhi ra ma ti bod skad du blo gros bzang mo/ yang ma ti garbha zhes kyang bya ste/ bod skad du blo gros snying po zhes bya/ de gnyis ka'i don bsdus nas blo zab snying po zhes pa zhig byung bas na/ ngo bo blo zab snying po zhes bya ba yin mod kyang / rgyud 'ga' zhig las blo bzang snying po zhes pa dang / 'ga' zhig la de gnyis brgyud pa gcig tu byed pa sogs ni ma dag par bshad do/ /de'i darpan ā tsarya zhes pa pa'i sgra las drangs pas na 'gro ba zhes pa dang / da'i sgra las drangs te me long zhes pa yin zhing / ā tsarya ni slob dpon yin pas slob dpon 'gro ba'i me long zhes pa yin la/ 'gyur kha cig las/ dharpan ā tsarya zhes pa 'byung ba ltar na pa'i sgra las drangs pa pañtsa ni lnga yin la/ dha'i sgra las drangs pa dha ra ni 'dzin pa yin pas lnga 'dzin slob dpon zhes pa zhig 'byung ba yin cing / de'i don yang rig gnas lnga 'dzin pa'i slob dpon zhes pa'i don yin par bshad la/ 'di nyid kyis bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir byon/ rdzogs rim shin tu spros med ces pa'i gshed dmar gyi gdams pa 'di bod yul 'dir dar ba khong gi bka' drin las byung ba yin zhing / dgung lo stong dang bzhi brgya bzhugs/ tshems lan nyi shur brjes pa zhig yin par bshad la/ 'di nyid slar rgya gar du gshegs pa yin yang zer/ glo bo lo tsā bas 'di'i shangs mtshal las grub pa'i sku brnyan zhig bzhengs pa de la thim nas bzhugs par yang bshad pas sku'i bkod pa gnyis bstan par sems so/

/des na gshed dmar lha lnga ma bir lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa la/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug nas ḍombhi ba la brgyud pa ni sngar bshad pa de dag yin la/ yang birwa pa nas nag po pa la brgyud pa ni/ paṇḍi ta dā na shrī las/ shi la tsaṇṭa la gsan/ des pa li pa la gsan/ de nyid la grub chen nag po pas legs par gnang ba rim pas brgyud/ da na shi las g.yag sde ba dang / 'jam dbyangs gsar ma sogs la stsal pa de nyid yin la/ yang da na shi las nis ka lang ka de ba ste/ bod skad du rgyan gyi lha'am rol pa'i lham rnyog med lha zhes pa la yang gsan par gsan yig rgya mtsho las bshad do/ /de ltar da na shi la lugs dang / niska lang ka de ba nas ra want+ra pa la babs pa gnyis char bir lugs so/ /yang bir lugs la ma ltos pa'i gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang ni/ grub chen dpal 'dzin nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la dngos su gsan/ grub chen gyi bcu gsum ma'i yig skor gong du bstan pa rnams mdzad/ a nu pa ma rakṣi ta bya ba la gnang / de nas ratna a ka ra shanti/ nā ya ka pa mi khya ta de ba/ shākya shrī bha dra/ da na shi la'i bar du brgyud pa dang / yang grub chen nas/ blo zab snying po 'gro ba'i me long las brgyud pa dang / yang grub chen nas/ byi la'i sham thabs can/ blo zab snying po/ niska lang ka de wa/ ra want+ra rnams la brgyud pa dang brgyud tshul mi 'dra ba gsum tsam zhig gi sgo nas bcu gsum ma 'di 'phags yul du dar bar gyur pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis gshin rje gshed skor 'phags yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa bod yul du bla ma gong ma rnams rim par brgyud de ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ 'o na dpal gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams 'phags yul nas bod yul 'dir dus nam byon zhing dar tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ 'di la yang gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang /

dmar po'i skor ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su ni gshin rje gshed tshe bdag sogs mang du byon kyang / nag 'jigs skor gsum mam/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum zhes pa'i tha snyad ni ma byung la/ des na 'di gsum ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su zhang cog gru shes rab bla ma zhes bya ba bod kyi rgyal po'i zhang rigs yin pas na zhang zhes grags pa des lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku tshe'i smad tsam gyi dus rgya gar du byon nas grub chen a mo gha badzra chung ba la gtugs nas/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bka'/ dkyil chog gshin rje 'byung ba/ dgra nag la sgrub thabs de nyid dang / gdong drug la de wa a ka ra tsaṇḍa'i sgrub thabs dang / 'jigs byed la grub chen la li ta'i sgrub thabs kyi steng nas gsan cing / rgyud gsum char la 'grel pa la ma brten pa'i bshad pa legs po rnams gsan te bod du dar ba la gshin rje gshed zhang lugs zhes grags shing / phyis zhang pa sangs rgyas 'byung la/ 'phags pa rin po che dang / dus 'khor pa ye rin/ 'dzin pa rin shes sogs kyis zhang lugs zhus nas deng sang gi bar du sa skya pa sogs la yang bzhugs so/ /yang bla ma zhang la skyo ston 'od 'byung gis gsan nas skyo pa la yang lugs 'di yod do/ /zhang pa la shes rab bla ma'i rjes su rdo rje rtse mo dang / mar pa chos 'bar la sogs pa mkhas pa mang du byon/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum ka la mkhas kyang / gzhan rnams la 'chad nyan cher mi mdzad par gshin rje 'byung ba la 'chad nyan gyi mthil mdzad par grags la/ mgar ldong gnyos gsum gyi nang gi mgar la/ mgar rdo rje snying po/ zom rong chos bzang sogs mang du byon pa de dag kyang zhang lugs kyi rjes 'brangs yin par bshad/ gang ltar de lta bu'i zhang cog gru shes rab bla ma'i sku drin las/ bod du gshin rje gshed kyi skor 'di thog mar dar ba yin no/

/de nas skyo lugs ni skyo ston 'od 'byung gi sku drin las dar ba ste/ de yang zhang cog grus rgya gar du thengs gsum byon pa'i rjes ma la grub chen a mo gha bod du spyan drangs te 'grig 'tshams su phebs/ de'i tshe rus pa skyo yin pa'i khams pa jo sras sngar shes rab bla ma'i grwa pa yin pa gcig gis/ grub chen la 'bul ba zhabs tog ches che ba byas nas khong rang gi dgon par grub chen gdan drangs te/ mar lam dpal rnam phag pa ri'i ldebs la pa tshab nyi lde bya ba'i dgon pa yod pa der gdan drangs/ rim pas khong rang gi dgon pa yar lung gi mda' gra ma lung zhes bya bar phebs/ der 'bul ba rgya chen po phul nas/ sngar bdag gis grub chen khyed nas brgyud pa'i gshin rje gshed/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor rnams bla ma zhang shes rab bla ma la yang thob cing / da dung bdag la bla ma rang gi yi dam yin pa gang la thugs rtsis che ba zhig gi dbang dang / de'i sgrub thabs las tshogs gcig kyang brtsams nas thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'o na bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar chad bsrung ba la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed 'di shin tu bsngags shing nga'i yi dam gyi mthil yang 'di yin gsungs nas 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gnang ste/ de'i ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su bla ma'i thugs kha nas 'od rdza ma tsam zhig byung nas/ slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam yod pa'i thams cad kyi mgo thog na phar yar 'gro mar 'gro byas pa'i mthar bla ma skyo jo sras gyi thugs kar thim/ de la brten nas bla ma 'di la skyo 'od 'byung du grags/ de nas grub chen gyis skyo ston la 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs brtsams nas de dang / sngar nas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes bya ba yang gnang ngo / /gzhan yang de dus rwa khrid ces ming du btags pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje sgrub byed rdzogs rim shin tu zab pa 'di yang gnang ste/

de nas skyo sku mched/ skyo jo sras khams pa/ skyo phur bu/ gnyan rin chen bstan pa/ gnyan 'od srung / gnyan ston chos rgyal/ 'dzim pa rin shes sogs la brgyud nas deng sang gi bar du dar/ yang gnyan 'od srung la 'phags pa rin po ches skyo lugs gsan/ 'di skor gyi yig cha yang mdzad la/ 'dzim pa rin shes nas brgyud pa'i 'jigs byed skyo lugs kyi dbang khrid yongs rdzogs rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos sa bzang 'phags pa la gsan te slob ma'i mchog mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gung ru shes bzang dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gnang nas dar rgyas su mdzad/ 'di skor gyi khrid kyi brgyud 'debs dang / gzhan yang 'jigs byed kyi yig cha 'ga' re mdzad/ dus phyis rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis 'jigs byed skyo lugs paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la gsan nas skyo lugs kyi khrid yig kyang mdzad de dar rgyas su mdzad pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i zhang lugs dang skyo lugs gnyis char grub chen a mo gha badzra chung ba la thug pas snga phyi phran bu ma gtogs/ zhang lugs kyi gshed skor tshang ma skyo pa la yang bzhugs so/ /yang gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags kyis 'phags yul du byon/ paṇḍi ta ba ling ta a tsarya la bdag na so rgas pas chos mang po mi lob/ bod rnams kha gzan pas shin tu kha chod che ba/ mdo sngags thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pa/ gsang sngags yin pa zhig gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gnang / de nas bdag gi dgon pa de la rtsa gcig na yod pas/ de bsrung ba'i chos skyong zhig dgos zhus pas/ trag shad gnang / bla ma'i chos skyong 'di rtsub po gcig yod pa 'dra bas/ 'di gnon pa'i yi dam khro bo zhig kyang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/

rdo rje 'jigs byed gnang / de'i zhor la dgra nag dang gdong drug kyang gnang ste bod du spel bas gnyos lugs zhes grags pa yang byung / sa lugs ni/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la gnang ba/ nā ro pa nas rim pas bal po thugs rje chen po la brgyud/ de la bla ma mal lo tsa bas dgra gdong 'jigs gsum char gsan nas des slob ma mang po la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor la 'chad nyan dpyis phyin par mdzad/ khyad par 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu ba'i bshad pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ sa chen gyis khong dpon slob sngags btu mdzad par byon pas/ slob ma gzhan rnams shin tu dka' ba'i rnam pas nyan gyi 'dug pa la/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos 'di ltar byas na 'ongs gsungs nas/ mal lo'i bshad pa bzhin tshegs med du gsungs pas/ de dus mal los sa chen slob bu dam tshig pa'i mchog tu dgongs bzhin du/ sa chen la rten 'brel sgrig pa'i phyir cung zad ma mkhyen pa'i rnam pas thog mar bla ma mal lo skag ste bzhengs nas/ shes na dga' ba tshos mi shes/ ma shes na dga' ba tshos shes pa gsungs shing thugs ma mnyes pa'i rnam pas chos thun de grol/ yang lan cig mal lo dpon slob tsho 'jigs byed kyi 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i skabs/ sa chen gyis logs shig tu bzhugs pas de dus rlung chen po zhig langs nas mal lo'i phyag dpe'i shog bu zhig 'khyer ba sa chen bzhugs pa'i drung du babs pa na/ khong dpon slob rnams tab tob tu gyur pa la/ sa chen gyis 'di na bdog zhus nas bla ma la phul nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ rten 'brel legs/ chos kyis phan thog 'ongs pa yin gsungs nas mnyes/ 'on kyang de dus 'khor lo bde mchog sogs gdams pa zab mo rnams dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / gur mgon gyi man ngag rnams ma gnang / de nas sa chen gyis mar byon pa'i lam bar rnams su dbang bskur sogs kyi 'gro don mdzad kyin phebs pas/

lam bar du ka gser srang bcu bdun 'grig pa bla ma la 'bul bar btang pas/ bla ma mal lo tshogs dpon zhig la phebs sar slebs nas jo sras kyis btang pa yin pas/ bla ma la mjal kha dgos zhus pas/ bla mas mkhyen bzhin du zas 'dod pa yin yong / za ma zhig byin la thong gsungs/ nye gnas kyis de bzhin byas pas/ pho nya ba na re/ gser zhig 'bul ba legs pas cis kyang mjal ba dgos zhus pas/ bla ma rang byon nas gser ji tsam yod gsungs/ srang bcu bdun yod zhus pas/ bla ma mnyes nas 'o na 'di yang gyis la tshogs kyi dbus su phul cig gsungs nas bla ma rang gis gser srang gang bsnan nas gser srang bco brgyad phul/ de nas bla ma'i zhal nas/ pho nya de la da khyod song la jo sras khong la khyod dam tshig pa gtsang mar 'dug pa la/ kho bos ma shes pa byung 'dug pas/ da sang phod 'dir cis kyang byon rgad po 'di'i khog pa na zab chos 'dra yod pa khyed la ster ba yin gyis shig gsungs/ de nas sa chen gyis slar yang gung thang na la rtser byon pas/ bla ma mal lo tsā bas bde mchog gur mgon sogs dang / khyad par rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs nag po skor gsum gyi dbang dang / rgyud kyi bshad bka' sogs mtha' chod par stsal/ sa chen gyis rje btsun sku mched la gnang ste dar rgyas su mdzad pa la/ phyis 'jigs byed sa lugs zhes grags/ lugs 'di la dgra nag gi rgyud la grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa'i steng nas bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa dang / gdong drug dang rtog bdun gnyis la 'grel pa la ma brten pa'i mchan gyi bshad pa rnon po dang / dbang bka' la grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil chog la brten nas gsum ka'i dbang dang / dgra nag la grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / gdong drug dang 'jigs byed gnyis la rgyud kyi steng nas sgrub thabs man ngag gis ston pas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i nyams len yod pa yin no/

/rje btsun sku mched nas gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston sogs nas rim gyis bla ma dam pa sogs la brgyud de rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos legs par gsan nas sems dpa' chen po sogs sras kyi thu bo du ma la stsal/ kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams seng ges 'di'i sgrub dkyil gnyis char mdzad/ yang zhwa lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis kyang lugs 'di'i sgrub dkyil sogs yig sna bzhi tsam mdzad cing / 'di gnyis char gyis mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la gsan/ de dag nas rim gyis brgyud deng sang yang 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang dang / rtog bdun gyi bshad rgyun sogs ma chad pa bzhugs pa yin no/ /yang 'jigs byed kyi lugs srol rnams kyi nang nas grags che zhing dar rgyas che bar bzhugs pa'i rwa lugs zhes grags pa 'di ni rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi rgya bal du byon te/ bal po bha ro phyag rdum dang / bal yul man dza gling pa paṇḍi ta thugs rje chen po dang gnyis la so sor gsan nas dar ba la rwa lugs zhes grags pa 'di yin te/ de yang rwa chen 'di 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ la stod snya nam glang yul ba/ yab bla ma rwa dkon mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba gsang sngags rnying ma'i dge bshes mi rabs bdun gyi bar du zam ma chad par byon pa'i brgyud pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi zhal gzigs pa zhig yin la/ de la sras lnga yod pa'i 'di chung ba/ sku lus sbom la thung ba kha dog nag pa mig rtsa dmar ba/ skra ser ba khro bo'i cha lugs can gcig byung bas ming yang rdo rje gtum po dpal zhes btags/ sku bong dang mi ldan yang rnam shes shin tu gsal ba shes rab mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin pas/ lo brgyad pa la phur pa rtsa dum dang / yang dag rtsa ba thugs las gsungs/ de dus 'di thugs shin tu gtum pas thams cad dang ma mthun pa zhig byung nas mtshams byed du bcug pas lo bcu gnyis pa la 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi zhal gzigs/

de'i tshe 'dre grong sum brgya'i nang na rigs dang longs spyod che ba zhig gi bu mo kha dog phun sum tshogs pa 'dre mo dge ma zhes bya ba jo mor blangs pa las/ rwa lo 'di kha dog ma mtshar ba dang / thugs gtum pas mo ma dga' zhing 'grogs ma 'dod nas/ mos glu 'di ltar blangs pa/ slob dpon dkon rdor gyi khang pa na/ /sbal pa gcig dang rma bya gcig /sbal pa de phag na nam tsam phag /rma bya de 'phur na nam tsam 'phur/ /rwa ston gtum po khong 'dzoms gyur kyang / /dge ma'i snying la 'grogs ma shes/ /khyed sngags pa mthu la re mod kyi/ /pha tshan sum brgya zad gyur kyang / /gtum po dpal dang 'grogs ri shi/ zhes zer zhing bla ma bor nas song ba las/ rwa los phyis 'phrang gcig tu bsgugs nas mo byung ba bzung nas mo'i sna rtsa ba nas bcad nas btang / de nas mo'i phyis zangs kyi sna bzos/ de la gser bskus pas 'dre mo gser sna ma zhes grags/ de nas 'dre pha tshan rgya che bas bor cha la ma 'chams te/ rwa chen la zhabs 'dren cher byung nas thugs khros te gser srang phyed dang bcu khyer nas glang yul du mu stegs purna nag po'i drung du byon/ gur glang gi ser ba'i gdams ngag zhus/ bal yul sbrul dong du dka' thub mdzad nas bsgrubs pas/ thog mda' bdun dang ser ba tshan chen po nyi ma phyed dang nam phyed kyi bar phab ste/ 'dre khyim gyi grong khyer thams cad brlag par byas so/ /de nas slar yang gser srang gang khyer nas mu stegs purna nag po la gtad la sogs pa mu stegs kyi ngan sngags zab mo dgu brgya zhus/ mu stegs khong la phyi phyag ma byas par byon pas/ slar mu stegs kyi mthu byung gi dogs nas mu stegs kyi mthu bzlog pa la mkhas pa gang na yod dris pas/ bal po ye rang na bha ro phyag rdum nus pa can du grags pa gcig bzhugs zer ba thos pas/ der byon te gser srang gang phul uṣṇi kha'i phyir bzlog zhus/

bal po'i lo tsā ba chos kyi rnal 'byor bya ba dang mnyam du gser srang gang / dngul srang do phul nas lo tsā bslabs/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum nas rtsa brgyad bar lo lnga bal po bha ro phyag rdum gyi drung du bzhugs te/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang rgyud sgrub thabs la sogs pa man ngag dang bcas pa thams cad dang / phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa zhus shing / der bsgrub pa mdzad pas rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / phag mo zhal gnyis ma gnyis kyi zhal gzigs grub pa thob/ der bha ro la shin tu mos pa zhig byung nas gser lhag ma rnams phul/ bod du gshegs par zhus pas/ 'byon ma bzhed pa la nan gyis zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga mi 'gro paṇḍi ta gcig khyod la cis kyang dgos na/ nga la byin pa'i gser 'di kun khyer la rgya gar nas paṇḍi ta mkhas pa zhig spyan drongs la chos gzhan yang zhus/ des khyod kyi don 'grub par 'ongs kyi gsungs/ rwa chen gyi thugs dgongs la bla ma mi gshegs kyang gser phul ba slar len pa ngo tsha/ de bas rang nyid kyis bod du gser btsal la de nas bla mas gsungs pa bzhin byas na legs pa 'dug snyam nas sngar gyi grogs bal po lo tsā ba'i rtsar byon nas/ nga bod du skyel dgos 'di bzhin byed pa yin gsungs nas sngar gyi lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ bal po lo tsā ba na re/ khyod kyis chos phyir dka' spyad nus pa ngo mtshar che/ grogs cis kyang byed zla ba gcig gnyis la 'dir sdod/ de nas 'grogs la cha zer/ der bal po lo tsā bas mtshams sbyor byas nas tshong dpon phyug po gcig gis rwa chen la dbang bskur zhus/ der yul sde chen po gcig gi mi mang po yang 'dus nas 'bul bar sman mang po byung ba rnams khyer nas dpon slob gnyis kyis bod du byon pas/ sngar gyi mu stegs purnas thos te khong nga la phyi phyag mi byed par 'gro ba zer zhing khong khros nas phur bu mda' 'phen gyi bsgrub pa la zhugs yod do bya ba'i bang chen byung /
