der rwa chen gyis sngar bha ros gnang ba'i phyir bzlog aṣṇi ṣa'i 'khor lo g.yam pa che ba gcig la bris/ rang nyid rdza ma'i nang du zhugs/ 'khor los kha bcad/ mal sa'i logs la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku thang bkram nas sngags bzla zhing bzhugs pas/ srod nam phyed tho rangs gsum la sgra rtsal pa re byung nas nang par bltas pas/ khang pa'i ya them la seng lding gi phur pa dar dmar po btags pa gcig brgyab 'dug de bzhin du mal sa'i bris sku dang / ka gzhu la yang phur pa re brgyab 'dug kyang / bla ma rwa chen la gtan nas gnod ma thub/ de'i tshe snye nam du 'dir dgra thams cad brlag par byas mod kyang / da ni mu stegs kyi mthus kho rang yang shi lo zer ba'i gtam byung nas/ gcen po gnas brtan spre'u yang slebs/ de nas khong gsum gyis bal po nas bod du byon/ rwa chen 'di nus mthu shin tu che bar grags pas snya nam pa dang / la stod pa thams cad kyis bsu ba dang sna len byas/ thams cad yon bdag tu gyur dgra gnyen med par mdzad/ der dbang bskur sogs 'gro don mang du mdzad pas snga phyir 'bul nod byung ba gser srang nyi shu tsam du longs nas/ da ni gser 'di rnams khyer la rgya gar nas paṇḍi ta spyan 'dren pa la 'gro bar bya dgongs tsa na/ yab kyis gtong ma 'dod par/ da ni chos kyang sngar gyi tsho'i chog lho bal gyi tshad nad 'di srog la yang gzan/ nga rgas pas slar 'phrad pa yang dka' bas phar ma 'gro zer nas pha'i ngo la lo gsum bzhugs/ de bal po lo tsā bas bskul ba la brten sngar ni phas bshol btab nas bsdad pa yin/ gser yang mi nyung tsam yod grogs bzang ba'i ring la 'gro bar rigs dgongs nas slar pha la zhus nas byon pas zhag bcu la bal po ye rang du slebs/ phyag rdum dang mjal nas khong gi gsung las/ ngas 'jigs byed dang phag mo gnyis las mi shes pas/ khyod rgya gar du song ba paṇḍi ta mkhas pa zhig cis kyang spyan 'drongs pa gyis gsungs pa bzhin lam du chas pa na/

bal po rnal 'byor pa na re/ paṇḍi ta mkhas pa bal po rang nas rnyed 'ongs rgya gar du bsgrod pa dka' bas bshol ba legs zer bas/ rwa lo'i zhal nas/ nga ni rdo rje 'jigs byed yin/ /khams gsum thams cad dgrar gyur kyang / /'jigs so snyam pa nga la med/ /mngon spyod drag po'i nus pa yod/ /nga yis phar la ma bcom na/ /tha mal gzhan gyis nga mi thub/ /snya nam 'dre khyim sum brgya yang / /nga yis brlag par byas la ltos/ /rgya gar purna nag po yis/ /thog ltar phab pa'i phur bu'i mda'/ /nga la rdug pa ma mthong ngam/ /nga yis brlag par byas la ltos/ /nga ni rdo rje pha lam yin/ /nga ni khro bo chen po ste/ /'jig rten dregs pa su che yang / /nga yis mi thub gang yang med/ /bla ma bha ro'i gsung bsgrub cing / /nga rang dam bca' brtan por bgyid/ /slob dpon thugs khral ma byed cig /ces gsungs nas rgya gar gyi lam du zhugs te bal po'i tshong pa rgya gar du 'gro ba rnams dang 'grogs phyin pas/ lam bar jag pa byung nas tshong ba la la brdungs/ la la khrid/ rwa chen gyi zhabs tog pa la na bza' dang khres po yod pa kun kyang khyer ba na/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas lus rengs par 'gyur ba'i cho ga byas pas jag pa thams cad rengs nas 'gro ma nus par sa la 'gyel/ bla ma dpon slob rnams bde bar byon te rgya gar du phebs tshong pa rnams kyis bla ma la gtang rag phul te/ bla ma tshur 'byon dus nged rnams kyi zhabs tog byed zer/ de nas rwa chen gyis rdo rje gdan dang so ba na tha'i mchod rten/ na lent+ra sogs mjal bas/ na lent+rar bal po thugs rje chen po dang mjal/ de'i drung du rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan shrī badzra kirti zhes pa bod skad du dpal rdo rje grags pa zhes bya bar btags/ de nas paṇḍi ta'i zhal nas/ nga bal yul mañdza gling du 'gro bas/ khyod 'dir sdod na nga'i paṇḍi ta gcig la sgrags la zhog

nga la bla ma byed na nga'i rjes la 'dongs/ kho bos khyod la gsang sngags kyi rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa ster ba yin gsungs pa la/ rwa lo'i thugs dgos la ngas dka' ba spyad nas 'dir 'ongs pa'i don bla ma paṇḍi ta gcig 'tshol ba'i ched yin na/ paṇḍi ta dang mjal nas gzhan 'tshol ba mi 'ongs sngar nas kyi las 'phro yang 'di dang yod par nges pas 'di gar gshegs gar bzhugs su 'gro 'dug bya dgos dgongs nas/ khyed kyi snyan grags la bsam nas 'dir 'ongs pa yin/ chos kyang ci dgos thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ bdag gi phyir bod du yang gshegs dgos zhus pas/ ngas bu khyod kyi don nus sam mi nus blta yi gsungs nas zla ba gcig tu thugs dam mdzad nas gsung ma byon/ de'i bar la paṇa chung buddha shrī bha dra la saṃskṛ ta'i skad bslabs pas mkhas par mkhyen/ de nas paṇḍi ta thugs rje chen pos ngas khyod kyi don nus par 'dug pas sngon la mañdza gling du 'gro de nas bod la lta yi bya gsungs/ bla ma paṇḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dpon slob bcu tsam gyis rgya gar nas bal por byon pas mañdza gling du bde bar phebs/ der zla ba bzhi tsam gyi bar du bzhugs nas paṇḍi ta de nyid la 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud/ lū hi pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gdams ngag dang bcas pa dang / nag po pa'i gzhung drug gi gdams ngag dang bcas pa ste bka' srol gnyis cha tshang ba/ dges pa rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud sgrub thabs gdams ngag dang bcas pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi rtsa bshad sgrub thabs gdams ngag dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud dang gdams ngag tshang bar gsan/ khyad par gshed skor la gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa dang / gdong drug gi rgyud/ de'i yan lag tu gyur pa grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog gdams ngag phra mo 'ga' dang bcas pa legs par gsan te/

mdor na paṇḍi ta de la dbang bskur mi 'dra ba bcu bdun tsam dang / rgyud bshad dang sgrub thabs shin tu mang ba zhig gsan pa'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs re re la gser zho re/ dbang bskur re la gser zho gsum re dang gser srang re re bshig pa'i tshogs 'khor kyang lan grangs du ma dang bcas gsan pa yin no/ /de nas lo tsā ba'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i chos byung nas paṇḍi ta la da bod du gshegs par zhus pas/ paṇḍi tas ngas bod du mi brtol bas paṇḍi ta gzhan zhig btang gis gsungs/ rwa chen gyi thugs dgongs la 'phral gyi zhabs tog chung ba yin nam snyam nas gser srang gang phul nas cis kyang gshegs par zhu gsungs nas nan che bar zhu phul pas/ nga khyod kyi zhabs tog sogs la 'khang pa min/ nga bod du 'gro ba la 'tsher ba yin te/ khyod cis kyang mi nyan na de bzhin bya/ bod du lo gsum tsam las mi sdod/ des khyod la phan thogs na khyod kyi don du 'gro yi gsungs nas paṇa chen la 'khor paṇa chung gnyis zhabs tog pa gsum/ lo tsā ba dpon slob gsum ste dgus bod du byon pas lam bar du sngar gyi bal po rnal 'byor pa dang / tshong pa rnams kyis bsu ma dang sne len rgya chen po byas/ de nas rim gyis bod du phebs/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris sogs kyi bod yul phal che bar byon nas lo paṇa de gnyis kyis sngar 'phags yul nas 'gyur ba'i rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / 'gos lo tsā ba sogs kyi 'gyur rnams la gzhi byas te ma legs pa bag re 'dug pa rnams bcos/ ma tshang ba rnams kha bskangs/ bod kyis bcug pa'i tshig lhag po thams cad phyung ste 'gyur bcos mdzad nas gtan la phab/ rgyud 'chad pa na/ rgya gar gyi 'grel pa man ngag sbas pa'i nag 'byams mang po re zhig bzhag nas/ rgyud kyi don thams cad mngon par rtogs pas bcings/ man ngag tshig gis bkrol nas 'chad pa'i lugs 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/

thugs rje chen po rgyud rkyang mkhan po zhes grags/ de ltar paṇa chen des bod du lo phyed dang lnga bzhugs nas de'i ring la rgyud dag ma dag mang po 'gyur bcos mdzad nas gtan la phab/ lo tsā ba la gnang bas cung zad thugs yus kyi rnam pa la/ rwa chen lo tsā bas gser srang bdun brgya tsam zhig 'khar gzhong du blugs nas paṇḍi ta'i phyag tu phul bas shin tu mnyes/ 'khor paṇa chung gnyis la yang gser srang brgya re phul/ g.yog po gsum la srang lnga bcu re byin/ de nas paṇḍi ta dpon g.yog rnams la slar yang gser mang po phul mnyes te/ paṇḍi tas bod nas bal por byon/ rwa los mnga' ris stod du lo gsum bzhugs pas/ de'i ring la 'bul ba mang po byung ba rnams gser du bsgyur bas gser srang lnga brgya byung ba khyer nas bal po ye rang du bha ro phyag rdum gyi drung du byon nas srang brgya phul/ srang brgya tshogs pa brgya skor re la tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rten mdzad/ bla ma pradzñā rakṣi ta'i dus mchod la srang brgya phul/ bla ma rang dang rnal 'byor pa gzhan gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgrubs pa zla ba drug mdzad pa'i cha rkyen du gser srang brgya dang zho do bshig srang brgyas rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / phag mo sogs kyi bris sku bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen/ grub chen bha ro dang lo tsā ba rang nyid kyis 'jigs byed dang phag mo zhal gnyis ma sogs kyi rgyud 'gyur mdzad pa sogs kyi cha rkyen mdzad/ de nas yang bod du byon/ mnga' ris dang gtsang gi nyang stod sogs su dbang bskur sogs chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad bzhin par bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ khams su spyan 'dren pa byung nas gshegs par brtsams te dbus su phebs lo 'ga' 'gor/ de nas rim gyis gshegs pa na lam bar du yar lha sham po la 'khor gnod sbyin rnga shang can 'bum dang bcas pa dang / ngan lam myu gu tshal gyi klu bdud kyis kha 'tshub/

rlung 'tshub ser ba drag po btang nas gshegs su ma ster ba la/ bla mas thog phab ste de dag thog gis tshar bcad/ de nas khams su phebs pa dang der gdul bya dpag tu med pa la chos mang du gsungs pas/ slob ma'i tshogs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung ste/ dus de tsam na rgya bod gnyis na bla ma rwa lo tsā ba las 'phrin las che ba med ces kyang grags pa yin no/ /de nas yang slar bod dbus gtsang du byon/ khams phyogs su 'bul ba'i dngos po mang du byung ba rnams kyis cha rkyen mdzad de dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi gtsug lag khang dang / gtsang gi gtsang 'gram lha khang sogs la zhig bcos phul du phyin pa mdzad/ de nas rong ngur smrig gi chos dpon mdzad/ de dus 'bum tshar bdun gyis sna drangs pa'i po ti sum brgya dang / lugs sku bal po ma mi tshad bdun/ byis pa lo brgyad pa'i tshad lnga ste bcu gnyis gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol/ gtsug lag khang ji srid gnas kyi bar du mgron zan lo re la zla ba gsum gsum btsugs te de'i cha rkyen la/ g.yu me tog spungs pa zhes bya ba khyad 'phags zhig yod pa des gtsos/ g.yu chung ba brgya ri ba nas che ba stong ri ba'i bar bsgrigs pa'i phreng ba ring thung 'dom gsum tsam yod pa zhig dang / gzhan yang khrab bdun/ tang rtse brgya/ dar yug brgya/ nas khal brgya/ rta sum cu sogs dngos spyad dpag tu med pa sbyor bar mdzad/ de bzhin du bsam yas dang ra sgreng sogs dgon bsam gyis mi khyab pa la chos kyi cha rkyen du dngos po dpag tu med pa 'bul bar mdzad cing / mdor na rgya bal dbus gtsang khams mnga' ris sogs kyi dgon thams cad du bsnyen bkur gyi tshogs bgrang bar dka' ba zhig gi rgyun 'dzugs par mdzad pa yin pas zang zing gi sbyin pa tsam gyi sgo nas kyang 'gro ba thams cad bde ba la bkod pa yin no/ /yang mthu rtsal gyis rang nyid la thugs 'gal sgrub pa po rnams tshar bcad pa yin te/

de yang snga mor bal po thugs rje chen po bzhugs pa'i dus su zangs dkar lo tsā ba bya ba phyag na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod pa des rwa chen la thugs 'gal cher byas pa la brten/ rwa los zangs dkar lo tsā ba la/ khyod kyi lus kyi gnas lag pas mi bsnyogs/ mig gis mi mthong ba'i sar nad drag po gcig btang la bsad kyi gsungs pas/ khong gi sob rub mtshams su lhog pa byung nas zhag bdun song pa na shi'o/ /yang dbus su bzhugs skabs skyo 'dul 'dzin na re/ khyed rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po mdzad pa la/ mkhan por 'os pa'i yon tan ma tshang ste/ mkhan po bya ba bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu lon pa'i dge slong 'dul ba'i sde snod shes pa dgos pa la/ khyed nub kyi rigs su sha chang la longs spyod/ skabs su mi la mthu gtad btang nas gsod/ lkog tu bud med bsten pas gzhan gyi mkhan po byas na bstan pa la gnod zer zhing / gzhan yang mang po'i gseb tu chos gtam la bsnyad btags nas ngan smras mang du byas pa na/ der rwa chen thugs cung zad khros pa'i rnam pas 'di skad gsungs te/ sha chang bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin/ /dam nyams gsod pa sngags kyi dam tshig yin/ /bud med bsten pa las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /nga yis de ltar shes pa'i gnas skabs na/ /'dul 'dzin dge 'dun dag dang 'gal ba med/ /de bas dam nyams log lta can khyod kyang / /zhag bdun tho rangs gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /gsungs pas/ mkhan po de zhag bdun na lus ngag yid gsum rengs nas 'das/ yang lan cig yar lung du btsad po rtse lde'i blon pos bla ma'i zhabs tog pa don gnyer la 'gro ba'i rta 'phrogs/ nye gnas pa brdungs pa na/ bla mas mthu mdzad par brtsams pa na/ gzhan gyis bar byas nas rta yang phul/ mthu yang mi mdzad pa zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes pa na/ zhag kha cig nas btsad po des g.yor po'i mi ngan dang bsdebs nas bla ma chos 'khor mdzad pa'i yul der chom po mdzad pa na/

bla ma'i bu slob tsho khros nas 'o skol la dgra yang yang byas pas bla ma la nus pa yod na da res 'don dgos zer ba la bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga rwa rgan lo tsā rgas sam/ gnam gyi ser ba zad dam/ 'brug gi gre ba ral lam/ 'jigs byed khams su song ngam/ ma mo gro kha yan nam/ sa bdag gnyid du song ngam/ nga la mthu med na su la yod zer nas btsad po dang / g.yor po bsdebs pa'i mi ngan thams cad kyi yul du ser ba phab ste brlag par byas so/ /de dag la sogs pa mdor na mthu dang nus pa'i sgo nas gdug pa can du ma zhig bsgral ba sogs kyi rnam par thar pa dpag tu med pa zhig mnga' ba yin na'ang mdor bsdus pa tsam mo/ /de lta bu'i rwa chen rdo rje grags kyis bal po bha ro phyag rdum dang / bal po thugs rje chen po gnyis la so sor dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs par gsan nas thugs su tshud par mdzad/ 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ bsgom bsgrub kyis nyams su bzhes pas thugs rgyud la yang rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs shing / skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs kyang bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig byon nas kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir gshin rje gshed rwa lugs zhes pa'i sgra bo che 'di lo chen 'di nyid gyi drin las byung ba yin no/ /des rang gi dbon po rwa lo tsā ba chos rab la dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/ mngon 'byung rnam gsum sogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang / de nyid kyis rang gi sras rwa ye shes seng ge dang / rwa dharma seng ge gnyis la gnang ba las/ gcen rwa ye shes seng ges gtsang po'i nub phyogs khu lung gi lung pa'i nang se khyim zhes pa'i gzhis dga' nyos nas der bzhugs/ yab la bzhugs pa'i rwa pa'i chos rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du rang gi sras rwa 'bum seng la gnang / de la sga los zhus/ sga lo ni bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su blon po pam̐ shi bya ba spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar btang pas/

rgyal po'i mchod gnas su gyur pa mi nyag ha shang bya ba de'i brgyud las yar 'brog sgang du mi nyag gzhon nu snying po bya ba byung / de'i sras gzhon nu seng ge de'i sras rig 'dzin snying po/ des rong rgya ma khar byon/ de'i sras rdo rje seng ges rong mkhar phug tu babs/ de'i sras bzhi'i che ba ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sras yin/ khams pa sga lo'i skye ba yin pas mtshan yang sga lor btags/ 'dis kha che paṇa chen/ dpyal lo chos bzang / bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa/ bi bu ta tsant+ra/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal/ 'phags pa rin po che sogs bla ma bcu phrag gnyis tsam zhig bsten nas/ bde kye gsang gsum/ dus 'khor/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag sogs pha rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud sogs rgyud sde mtha' yas pa man ngag dang bcas pa gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes/ 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ khyad par dgra gdong 'jigs gsum po 'di rwa 'bum seng la gsan/ mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge zhang ston bsod nams grags pa/ des gnyan ston rdo rje grags pa dang / bod kyi dpal 'dzin du grags pa'i 'bri khung ba dpal 'dzin la gnang / 'bri khung pa dpal 'dzin 'di'i 'jigs byed skor la man ngag gi skor man ngag gi dpe mang po brtsams nas po ti gcig tsam yod/ 'dis lung kho bo cag gis nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag rje dbang phyug rab brtan las brgyud de thos/ yang rong pa sga lo nas/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bla ma dpal ldan seng ge de la bu ston rin po ches rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang gsan/ de nas mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de la ngor chen gyis gsan/ yang rwa 'bum seng nas/ klokya dbang phyug grags/ des rwa rgya ldong gsum grub mtha' gcig ces grags pa'i nang tshan ldong ston shes rab dpal la gnang / de la bla chen 'phags pas 'jigs byed rwa lugs gsan nas 'di skor gyi brgyud 'debs sogs gong du bstan pa'i yig skor rnams kyang mdzad/

de nas zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub bzang po/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams brgyud nas ngor chen kun dga' bzang po la bka' babs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos rwa lugs kyi gshin rje gshed nag po skor gsum gyi dbang dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim kyi khrid sogs yongs su rdzogs pa bla ma so so la gsan nas 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa yin la/ de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' babs mang du bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nas paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje buddha singha/ rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / shar chen kun dga' bkra shis sogs nas brgyud pa'i rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang dang / las gshin gyi rjes gnang / rwa lugs dang skyo lugs gnyis kyi rdzogs rim gyi khrid so so yig cha gsar rnying gi lung dang bcas pa/ tshar chen chos gyi rgyal po nas brgyud pa'i rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud du grags pa rnams zab rgyas chos kyi spyan ldan lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub kyi drung du kho bos legs par thob cing / de ltar chos skor de dag gnang dgos tshul gyi snyan gsan phab dus/ rje spyan snga rin po che'i mnal lam du las gshin yab yum sa 'og nas byon byung nas dges pa'i tshul mdzad pa sogs kyi mtshan ltas khyad par can byung ba la brten/ nang par rje'i gsung las khyed sa skya pa la las gshin 'di bka' bab cing 'phrin las bsgrub pa 'dug gsungs pa dang / dbang gi sta gon gyi nub mo rje de nyid kyi mnal lam du/ kho bo cag gi mtha' skor du go cha dang mtshon cha'i rigs sna tshogs 'dug pa rmis pas/ 'jigs byed la brten nas gzhan gyi byad kha bzlog pa dang bsrung ba grub pa'i rtags yin gsungs/ yang rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud gnang ba'i dus su nub cig mnal lam du/

'jigs byed dpa' gcig gis khams gsum thams cad gang nas rje rang yang de 'dra'i rnam pa gsal ba dang bcas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad pa'i mtshan ltas gsal bar byung nas/ nang par rje'i gsung las mdang nub kho bo la rmi lam 'di bzhin byung bas khyed la rdo rje 'jigs byed 'di bka' babs 'dug ces thugs shin tu dgyes pa chen po dang bcas gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar gong du bstan pa ltar/ rwa chos rab kyi sras rwa ye shes seng ge nas brgyud pa la rwa nub par grags shing / rwa shar pa ni/ gcung rwa dharma seng ge nas gtso bor brgyud pa ste/ de yang rwa chos rab la rwa dharma seng ges gsan/ des rang gi sras rwa dkon mchog seng ge la gnang / des rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan la gnang / des rgya ston dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gnang / de nyid la rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi sku'i skye ba bzhi par grags pa rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis rwa lugs kyi chos skor ma lus pa gsan/ rwa lugs kyi bla ma rgya bal gyi lo rgyus/ rtog bdun gyi ṭikka sogs yig 'jog shin tu mang ba mdzad/ de nas brtson 'grus byang chub/ kun dga' rgya mtsho/ yon tan chos rin/ brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel la kho bo cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsan/ rje de nyid kyi drung du kho bos rwa lugs lha bcu gsum gyi dbang / las gshin gyi rjes gnang yongs su ma grags pa'i zab khyad can rnams dang / rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud nyams khrid du stsal cing / jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang gi rgyud 'grel sogs kyi steng nas rtog bdun gyi bshad pa sngags btu'i byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ rwa pod yongs rdzogs sogs 'jigs byed kyi chos skor po ti gnyis tsam zhig gi lung dang phyag khrid zhib tu zhus shing bka' drin tshad med bskyangs shing 'di skor la mtha' chod par byas pa yin no/

/de ltar kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir spyir gshin rje gshed nag po'i chos skor la srol mi 'dra ba mang du byung zhing / khyad par 'jigs byed la gong du bstan pa ltar 'phags yul nas lugs srol du ma zhig byon kyang / deng sang bka' ma nub cing dar rgyas su bzhugs pa ni rwa skyo zhang gsum sa lugs dang bcas pa'i bzhi po 'di yin no/ /de rnams kyis nag po'i skor bod du dar ba'i tshul bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa dmar po'i skor bod yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ 'o na gshin rje gshed dmar po'i chos skor 'di bod du nam byon/ dar tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan yan gyi sku ring la ni bod 'dir ma 'gyur la/ phyis bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇa chen gyi sku ngo man chad la skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba lnga'i sku drin las kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir gshin rje gshed dmar po'i skor 'di dar ba yin te/ de yang bod 'dir gshed dmar gyi lam srol yongs su grags shing tshad thub pa lnga byon pa las/ dang po ni/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos bzang po zhes bya bas dpal gshin rje gshed dmar pos dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i bal po paṇḍi ta niska lang ka de wa zhes pa la gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ birwa pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub thabs sogs rgya gzhung mang po yang bsgyur te bod du gshed dmar gyi srol 'di dang por btod/ de'i rdzogs rim shin tu spros med dang / lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bka' ni de dus ma lon la/ 'di nas brgyud pa'i lha lnga mar nges shing / 'di byin rlabs gzhan las che bas rgyal po'i gnod pa sogs 'phral gyi gdon thog tu shin tu bsngags pa yin zhes kyang grags te/ rje btsun sga lo 'dol chung du bzhugs dus cung zad bsnyung ba na/ rgyal po zhig gis bar chad brtsams te/ mgron btsun rgya dpe kong rtse gang khur ba gcig sga lo'i mdun du 'ong nas/

rgya dpe de dag phyung ste mig sngar bstan nas/ khyod mkhas na 'di dag gi don smra bar gyis shig ces zer ba la/ sga lo nga na nas khams bzi bas re zhig sdod cig gsungs pas/ de nas kyang mig sngar dpe ris yag yug shad shud byed kyi 'dug yi ge la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes zer ba dang / mtshan mo gcer bu byas lha khang gi nang du rdza'i dum bu mgo la bzhag nga ni rdza yi khyung mgo yin/ /zhes sdigs pa yang byed pa byung ba dang / yang lan cig sga los ngur smrig tu byon pa'i tshe mnal lam du/ btsun rgan lham mthil rdol 'ba' zhig gi khres po khyer ba zhig byung nas/ ngas lham 'di tsam zad zad btsal kyang ma rnyed pa'i grogs po khyed da snga mor rnyed pa re dga' zer zhing dga' mgu'i tshul byed phyi bzhin du 'brangs pa zhig byung / de nas khong gis dgon par byon pa'i tshe/ yab kyi gsung gis mdang ni 'byung po'i chu 'phrul che ba la/ de ring dge bshes pa byon/ bgegs kyi bar chad 'ongs nyen yod pas 'byung pos phan pa ltar byed pa la thugs ma yengs par thugs dam gtso bor mdzod cig gsungs/ sga lo rang gi thugs la yang 'di lta bu'i 'byung pos phan pa ltar snang yang / phug gnod skyel bar dgongs shing / de'i gnyen por thugs dam la brtson par mdzad pas/ de nas kyang res 'ga' gnyen gyi tshul du bsgyur te/ skye ba mang por 'di dang 'dir gyur pa yin zhes skye brgyud sna tshogs ston/ res 'ga' gtsug lag khang yid du 'ong ba sprul nas/ 'di ni bdag gi ste/ khyod kyis 'di'i bdag bya dgos zer nas gtsug lag khang gi bdag 'chol ba ltar byed/ res 'ga' ni mkhas pa'i tshul bzung nas kho bos gzhung lugs 'di la yun ring du sbyangs pas 'di lta bu'i mkhas par gyur pa yin pas khyed kyang 'di ltar gyis shig zer/ la la ni rdzu 'phrul cung zad re bstan nas grub pa thob pa'i tshul byed/

skabs 'gar bya'i gzugs mi skad 'don pas tho rangs 'dab gshog sdebs pa'i sgra dang bcas/ zla 'od gzhon nu/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'od kyi snye ma zhes 'bod cing / yar la longs shig lta rtog mdzod cig thugs dam mdzod cig gzhung bshor cig ces chos la bskul ba ltar byed pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa'i byang chub kyi bar chad du 'gyur ba zhig yun ring po'i bar du byung ba na/ re zhig gi tshe sga los dpyal lo la gshed dmar gyi dbang zhu bar brtsams te thar par byon pas lam bar du yang de na re/ da ni yul du 'gro bar rigs so/ /yab dang yum la sogs pa na'o/ /de dag lta ba dang 'phrad pa la 'gro bar rigs/ dbang bskur phyis zhu ba 'thad ces smra'o/ /de la sga los phyis thub pa dka'/ da lta zhu ba rang legs zhes smras pas/ ngas de tsam du khyod la bsams nas khyod kyis 'di ltar byed pa mi rigs/ de bas da lta ldeng zer nas khres po'ang btegs pa na/ sga los de ltar na'ang dbang nges par zhu gsungs nas zhu bar thag bcad pas/ khos khres po bskyur te yun ring 'grogs pa'i grogs pos bslus so/ /khyod ci bder gyis/ nga ni 'gro'o/ /khyed kyis skyel thung gyis zer ba ltar sga los thar pa gling gi mo yan sgang khar bskyal bas/ de na rta gcig 'dug pa la bzhon nam mkha' la 'phags nas rta de seng ge'i rnam par gyur/ khong rang dpon gu rum zhes bya ba'i gnas brtan gyi rnam pas lag pas 'gram pa bskyor nas glu len gyin mgo se ye re re la brgal nas song nas de nas bar chad las grol ba yin zhes kyang sga lo'i rnam thar las 'byung ngo / /de lta bu'i sga lo des dpyal lo'i drung du lo gsum bzhugs/ dges rdor dang phag mo sogs kyang gsan/ khyad par gshed dmar gyi dbang gsan pas bshad ma thag pa'i bar chad las grol ba'i byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan mngon gyur du byung ba de yin la/ des rong pa shes bzang la gnang /

de nas rim gyis brgyud kun mkhyen bu ston sogs nas brgyud pa ngor chen kun dga' bzang po la bka' babs/ ngor chen gyis gshed dmar gyi sgrub dkyil sogs gong du bstan pa'i yig skor rnams kyang mdzad de cher dar bar gyur pa yin zhing / yang srol gnyis pa ni chag lo chos rje dpal bya ba dpyal lo las gzhon pa/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa las cung bgres pa zhig gis bal po'i yul du byon pas/ paṇḍi ta niska lang ka ni gshegs/ de'i slob ma bal po ra want+ra la gshed dmar bcu gsum ma dang / lnga ma gnyis ka'i dbang gsan/ sngar gyi dpyal gyis bsgyur pa rnams la 'gyur bcos mdzad/ sngar ma bsgyur ba'i gshed dmar gyi gzhung brgyad tsam bsgyur te lha lnga ma'i dbang dar rgyas su mdzad cing / bcu gsum ma'i srol btod/ lugs 'di ni 'gyur legs shing 'gyur byed nyid kyang mkhas par grags/ lo tsā ba nyid kyis 'di skor gyi yig cha yang mang du mdzad do/ /lo tsā ba de nas g.yung phug pa rgyal mtshan dge ba/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de la rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsan/ chag lugs kyi lha lnga ma 'di chag lo nas/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ gshong lo blo brtan sogs nas brgyud pa dang / shang pa tshul shes nas/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ klokya pa/ spang sgang pa nas ma ti paṇa chen sogs la brgyud pa dang gsum/ yang bla ma dpal ldan seng ge nas bu ston rin po cher brgyud pa sogs brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig gi dbang rgyun ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan cing / de nas brgyud pa'i chag lugs kyi lha lnga ma'i dbang rgyun deng sang gi bar du dar rgyas su bzhugs pa yin la/ yang lo tsā ba de nas brgyud pa'i gshed dmar bcu gsum pa ni/ lha lnga ma g.yung phug pa nas brgyud pa 'dra ba gcig dang / yang g.yag sde ba nas sga lo/ sher seng sogs brgyud nas sa bzang 'phags pa la babs pa gcig ste bka' babs gnyis rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsan/

lam srol gsum pa ni chag lo'i rjes su/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi slob dpon rtog ge pa da na shi la byon pa la g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang pos lha lnga ma'i dbang dang / bcu gsum ma'i dbang yang gsan par rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig rgya mtsho las bshad pas na/ lha lnga brgyud pa ni/ da na shi la nas/ 'jam gsar/ sga lo/ rong pa sher bzang sogs chag lugs ltar brgyud pa ngor chen nas brgyud de deng sang gi bar du 'phel rgyas su bzhugs pa yin la/ paṇḍi ta de nas brgyud pa'i bcu gsum ma'i dbang ni/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ grub chen ze dmar ba/ bu ston rin po che/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal nas/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de la ngor chen gyis gsan la/ gang ltar paṇḍi ta des lha lnga ma dang bcu gsum ma'i dbang gnyis char spel mod kyang / rdzogs rim shin tu spros med ni mi bzhugs par grags/ srol bzhi pa ni chos rje sa paṇa gyi slob ma'i mchog lta bu yang yin zhing / 'phags pa rin po'i che bla ma yang yin pa glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis 'gro mgon sa pa la gnang ba sogs nas 'phel ba yin te/ de yang glo bo lo tsā ba 'di 'khrungs sa glo bo yin zhing / dang po tshong gi lo tsā byas pas bla btags su lo tsā ba zhes grags/ phyis ni gsung rab kyi lo tsā yang mkhas par mkhyen la/ gang ltar yab khams pa mtha' bzhi'i rigs yin pa zhig gis glo bor bskrun pa zhig yin pa las/ des bal por tshong la byon nas sog po dang bal po sogs kyi skad shes nas tshong gi lo tsā byas pas khong la glo bo lo tsā bar grags/ khong gi thugs la nga'i lo tsā shes rgyu med pa'i lo tsā ba'i ming 'di mi rung / de bas lo tsā don mthun gcig bslab par rigs dgongs nas/ thog mar bal po bha rant+ra la sgra bslabs nas lo tsā thub par mdzad cing / de nyid la gshed dmar lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang yang gsan/ de nas phyis spu hreng gi sku mkhar nyi zung du paṇḍi ta darpan ā tsarya spyan drangs nas rdzogs rim shin tu spros med kyi khrid zab mo 'di legs par gsan/

rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rdzogs rim gzhung gsum dang / dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bcu gsum po phal cher bsgyur te dar bar mdzad/ darpan gyi 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid kyang bsgyur cing / de rnams kyi man ngag rnams kyang thugs su tshud par mdzad/ lo tsā ba nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi yig skor yang mang du yod do/ /de lta bu'i lo tsā ba des rang gi sras 'gro mgon sa pa zhes pa la gnang / 'di ni lo tsā ba nyid rab tu ma byung gong gi sras yin la/ 'khrungs yul glo bo stod pa sa zhes par 'khrungs pas sa par grags pa yin par 'ga' zhig las bshad/ yang kha cig las 'di 'phags pa rin po che'i bla ma'i sras yin pas thugs dges dges kyi sa yod pa'i dam kha zhig 'di la gnang bas mtshan de ltar du grags pa yin zhes pa yang 'byung ngo / /dasi mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros la gdams te/ 'di ni mang mkhar lo tsā bar grags pa mang mkhar khra tshangs dang / dkar lcog la sogs par bstan pa spel/ 'phags pa rin po che'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ de'i tshe mtshan de nyid kyang khong rang gi 'dod zhus ltar btags pa yin par bshad la/ de'i mang mkhar khra tshangs ni thog mar lam 'bras pa blo bzang dkar mo sogs kyi gnas de nyid de/ de nyid kyang gnas cung zad de 'phos pa deng sang bsam 'grub dgon gsar du grags pa kho bo cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi skabs kyi bzhugs gnas mdzad pa 'di yin no/ /lo tsā ba des bla ma dpal ldan seṅge la gdams/ /des bu ston rin po che la/ de'i drung du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nam rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ 'dis kyang spros med kyi khrid yig sogs mdzad/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis dang / jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal la gsungs/ de gnyis nas brgyud pa so sor gyes pa ni/

shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ des mus chen sems dpa' chen po la gdams pa yin la/ yang theg chen rin po ches bla ma dam pa'i drung du gshed dmar gyi khrid bka' gsan/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rnam bshad sogs yig cha yang mang du mdzad de 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gnang / de nyid dang sems dpa' chen po gnyis char la bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan te/ de ltar brgyud pa'i chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i bar du brgyud/ tshar chen nyid kyis 'di skor la 'chad nyan rtsal du ston pa mdzad pa'i slob ma yang mkhas pa'i dbang po mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho dang / bo dong mkhyen brtse ba sogs byon pa las/ 'di gnyis char gyis tshar chen gyi gsung la zin bris mdzad pa'i gshed dmar gyi bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad/ khog phub/ spros med kyi khrid yig sogs cha tshang ba re re yod cing / mkhas pa'i dbang po mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis 'di'i dbang / spros med kyi byin rlabs sogs dang / de'i khrid de'i rgyab chos rgya gzhung tshad thub birwa pa dang / dpal 'dzin sogs kyi mdzad pa bod gzhung ngor chen kun dga' bzang po sogs kyis mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i gshed dmar skor po ti gcig tsam gsan/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi drung du kho bo cag gis spros med kyi khrid smin rgyas dang / rje rang nyid kyis klu sgrub rgya mtshor gsan pa'i gshed dmar gyi po ti yongs rdzogs kyi lung / 'di skor gyi spros med kyi byin rlabs/ 'od gsal gyi byin rlabs/ de'i yig cha rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung / bdud rtsi byin rlabs sogs chos skor cha tshang ba'i bka' drin thob pa yin no/

/brgyud pa'i rim pa 'di ni lugs srol gcig yin zhing / gzhan yang mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas/ kun mkhyen chen po/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje btsun dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ des chos kyi spyan ldan lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub la gnang / de'i drung du kho bo cag gis gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang / rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig cha'i steng nas spros med kyi lung khrid sogs thob cing / gzhan yang yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i drung du sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas gsan nas snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen sogs la gnang nas de nas brgyud pa yang da lta bzhugs so/ /sa lo chen pos 'di'i sgrub thabs dang / spros med kyi khrid yig kyang mdzad/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos kyang gshed dmar dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs mdzad cing / lhag pa'i lha 'di la bye bsnyen yang mthar phyin par mdzad pa sgrub thabs de'i mdzad byang gis rtogs pa yin no/ /des na glo bo lo tsā ba 'dis gshed dmar gyi dbang darpan ā tsarya la gsan pa'i bgros gang du yang ma byung bas/ lugs 'di'i dbang gi brgyud pa la darpan ā tsarya 'dren pa 'di ji ltar yin brtag par dgos pa tsam du snang la/ bal po bha rant+ra la bcu gsum ma'i dbang tsam gsan zhes pa lo rgyus kun las 'byung bas/ smin byed bha rant+ra la gsan pa des go chod mdzad nas darpan la smin byed ma zhus pa yin nam snyam ste dpyad glo bo lo tsā bas gshed dmar gyi dbang bla ma gzhan la thob rjes su darpan ā tsarya dang mjal dus/ gshed dmar gyi khrid rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang bcas pa gsan/ des na 'di'i dbang bka' khrid bka' brgyud pa tha dad du byed/ par bya'o/ /srol lnga pa ni/ gshong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi gcung po gshong blo brtan gyis paṇḍi ta bi ma la shrī la lung blangs te gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa 'di bsgyur te/

de'i lung da lta yang bzhugs pa yin la/ rgyud 'di'i le'u dang po nas lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bstan cing / brgyad pa nas lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor bstan par bshad/ bu ston rin po ches bsgyur pa'i rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa nas mchog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha lnga ma kho na ston/ rgyud de na gzhan na med pa'i rdzas kyi sbyor ba la brten pa'i las tshogs shin tu mang ba zhig bzhugs par bshad do/ /srol lnga pa 'di la rgyud kyi lung bshad kyi rgyun lung tsam ma gtogs dbang dang khrid sogs med la/ des na de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i lam srol de dag las glo bo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa 'di khungs btsun zhing khyad par 'phags pa bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs pas de ltar du shes par bya'o/ /de bas na bod yul 'dir grub chen shrī dha ra ste slob dpon dpal 'dzin nyid kyi dbang chog dang bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung sogs gzhung phran rnams bsdebs pas de nyid kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'i bcu gsum ma'i lam srol tshang la ma nor ba gcig dang / glo bo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung rnams bsgrigs nas brgyud pa so so nas byung ba'i lha lnga ma'i lam srol cha tshangs ba gcig ste/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i lam srol yongs su rdzogs pa gnyis deng sang gi bar du yang dar rgyas su bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ sgrib gnyis kun bral ye shes nyi ma yis/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bzhengs pa'i/ /bla ma gshin rje dgra yis slar yang skyongs/ /lha mchog gang gi bstan pa rin po che/ /'phags pa'i yul dang bod 'dir byung ba'i tshul/ /legs par bshad pa'i sngon med ngo mtshar gyi/ /gtam 'di gcig tu bstan la phan phyir bshad/ /de lta na yang dus ngan cher snyigs pas/ /deng sang dus kyi sngags par rloms pa rnams/ /lto chos lag len phra mo ma gtogs pa/

/zabs yang chos tshul don gnyer re re tsam/ /rgyu mtshan des na bsam sbyor rnam dag gis/ /nyin mtshan kun du dam pa'i chos bshad kyang / /don gnyer med pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /'dab chags rna bar dril bu'i sgra dang mtshungs/ /'di 'dra mthong tshe kho bo sgyid lug kyang / /'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen dang / /skal bzang re re tsam la phan rung snyam/ /legs sbyar 'di la nyes pa med snyam sems/ /'di brtsams dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyis/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /tshe ring nad med bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rgyas byed shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /slar yang gang 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa 'dzin gyur cig /ces dpal gshin rje gshed skor gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang / dpal sa skya pa chen po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can/ rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa/ grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa la sogs te yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya lo snron gyi zla ba'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i shākya'i dge slong rab 'byams smra ba mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas shing gsung rab mang po'i mgrin pa can/

lhag pa'i lha 'khor lo bde mchog dang / dpal gur gyi mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma gnyis la bzlas brjod bye ba'i pha mthar son pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa bsam gtan rgya mtshos gus spro dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bgyis so/ /'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'bad med lhun gyis grub nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /ma hā mu tra pa ra ma siddhi praptā ku ru sarba su kha bha wantu/ dge legs 'phel// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 96 a myes zhabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed skor gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 95
